Lumolight is an open-source flashlight app that can perform both front and back flash. The app is designed based on the "Material You" design system and it looks stunning. The app supports both light and dark themes and supports dynamic theming.
 It uses the screen as a front flash by brightening up and showing some static colors that the user chooses and it uses the flashlight for the torch mode. It has "Tile support" where you can use the front flash without even opening the app, and also adjust the brightness using the volume keys
 The customization option is one of the strong parts of this app. For the front flash, you can choose:
 Colors: Which color do you want to light up
 Duration: For how long it will be active.
 Brightness: The level of brightness you want.
 For the back flash:
 Duration: For how long it will be active.
 BPM (Blink per minute): You can blink your flashlight and also adjust its value.
 Flash-strength: You can also adjust the flashlight's strength. (Supported devices only)
 We are constantly improving our app by adding exciting features and fixing any issues that arise. With this app, you can be sure it will bring a good user experience.

izzyondroid:com.onefishtwo.bbqtimer.name: BBQ Timer
izzyondroid:com.onefishtwo.bbqtimer.summary: A combined interval timer/stopwatch that works on the lock screen
izzyondroid:com.onefishtwo.bbqtimer.description:
Combined interval timer/stopwatch = periodic alarms + elapsed time. Reminds you periodically to turn the food and tracks the total cooking time.
 Quick access via lock screen notification , pull-down notification , and home screen widget .
 Editable menu of interval times . Quickly access your favorite timers with notes.
 Changeable alarms while it’s running.
 No ads.
 Type in the interval time: minutes , minutes:seconds , or hours:minutes:seconds .
 Example intervals 
 10 = 10 minutes
 7:30 = 7 minutes, 30 seconds
 3:15:00 = 3 hours, 15 minutes
 Short forms 
 12:00 = 12:0 = 12: = 12 = 12 minutes
 0:09 = :9 = 9 seconds
 2:00:00 = 2:0:0 = 2:: = 120 = 2 hours
 Tips 
 Tap the checkbox to turn the periodic reminder alarms on/off.
 Tap the time display to cycle between stopped → running → paused → stopped .
 Add the BBQ Timer widget to the home screen. Tap the widget’s elapsed time to start/pause/stop.
 Tap the widget’s background or its countdown time to open the app.
 Resize the widget (long-press it then drag its resize handles) to see more or less info.
 To remove the widget, long-press and drag it to “× Remove”.
 While BBQ Timer is running or paused , it appears on the lock screen and in the pull-down notification so you can see and control it in those places. To put it on the lock screen, put it in Pause or Play mode by tapping buttons in the app or the home screen widget.
 Long-press the app’s home screen icon, then tap the “Pause at 00:00” shortcut (on Android 7.1+) to make it Paused and ready on the lock screen.
 Tap ▲ in the alarm interval text field for the menu of interval times. Tap “Edit these intervals…” in the menu to customize the menu.
 Long-press ▲ to customize the menu.
 The app, home screen widget, and pull-down notification show the countdown interval time as well as the total elapsed time (requires Android 7+).
 In the app, the phone’s volume keys adjust the Alarm volume.
 You can change BBQ Timer’s “Alarm” sound in Settings / Notifications. Don’t pick “None” if you want to hear the interval alarms. To restore the app’s cowbell sound, uninstall and reinstall the app.
 Note: These System Settings are required to hear and see BBQ Timer alarms: 
 Audible “Alarm volume” level.
 Lock screen / Show all or non-private notifications.
 Apps / BBQ Timer “Show notifications”, not Silent. (Optionally override “Do Not Disturb”.)
 Apps / BBQ Timer “Alarm” notification category / “Show notifications”, not “Silent”, “Make sound and pop on screen”, sound choice not “None”, Importance “High” or higher to hear and see on the lock screen and in the notification area.
 Apps / Special app access / Alarms & reminders / Allowed.
 Notifications / App settings / BBQ Timer / On.

izzyondroid:com.tortillum.signalid.description:
There’s an incredible amount of radio signals. It’s impossible to know them all, let alone recognize them. So why not get help from SignalID? 
 At the moment, it recognizes about twenty signals (complete list in the application). With only 5 seconds of recording time, it tries to recognize the signal. To use it:
 Set the frequency and bandwidth properly.
 Selecting the frequency range. (0-30 MHz / Other)
 Place the microphone of the telephone near the loudspeaker. (The quieter the environment is around, the fewer errors will occur)
 Press the big button that dances.
 Wait 5 seconds. (Time required for record)
 Tips: 
 The algorithm is based on frequency, a wrong tuning of your radio/SDR will result in an erroneous detection.
 The recording is limited to 5 seconds, for practical reasons. Recognition of a signal may require several attempts.
 Note: author no longer provides APKs, and development sopped in 2020, so there won't be any updates here.

fdroid:com.devwithzachary.completelinuxi.name: Complete Linux Installer
fdroid:com.devwithzachary.completelinuxi.summary: Run Ubuntu, Debian, Arch & Alpine with XFCE desktop & tabbed terminal. No root!
fdroid:com.devwithzachary.completelinuxi.description:
Run genuine, full-featured Linux distributions natively on your Android phone or tablet: 100% rootless!
Complete Linux Installer (Linux on Android) brings a multi-distribution Linux ecosystem, concurrent multi-tab terminal, graphical XFCE desktop, and 1-click developer stacks to your device without root access, unlocked bootloaders, or custom ROMs.
Powered by a native PRoot user-space virtualization engine and POSIX PTY terminal bridge, Complete Linux Installer transforms your device into a portable Linux workstation, server host, desktop computer, or learning environment.
🔒 100% ROOTLESS & COMPLETELY SAFE
• Runs entirely in Android user-space via PRoot ptrace system call virtualization.
• Zero root access, unlocked bootloaders, or system partition modifications required.
• Completely sandboxed: cannot brick your device and never touches Android system partitions or personal files.
• First-launch welcome guide explaining container architecture and security.
🐧 MULTI-DISTRIBUTION LINUX CATALOG
Install, run, and switch between multiple independent Linux distributions:
• Ubuntu 26.04 LTS: Official long-term support base for general computing and development.
• Debian 12: Rock-solid stability with vast package repositories.
• Alpine Linux 3.21: Minimalist musl/busybox environment (~10MB rootfs) with instant boot times and tiny memory footprint.
• Arch Linux ARM: Bleeding-edge rolling release with the pacman package manager.
• Kali Linux CLI Tools: Security auditing and network forensics environment.
• Void Linux: Independent general-purpose distribution with the fast XBPS package manager.
📑 CONCURRENT MULTI-TAB TERMINAL
• Run and manage multiple interactive terminal sessions simultaneously.
• Dynamic tab strip with live status indicators, session highlights, and custom tab renaming.
• Independent PTY subprocesses maintain full interactive state in the background.
• Pinned extra-keys toolbar with Ctrl, Alt, Esc, Tab, Paste, and directional arrows.
• Viewport resizing preserving cursor and prompt on software keyboard resize.
• Custom font families (JetBrains Mono, Ubuntu Mono) and 16-color ANSI themes.
🖥️ FULL GRAPHICAL DESKTOP (XFCE4 & VNC)
• Install a complete XFCE 4 Desktop Environment in one tap.
• Built-in TigerVNC server with 1-touch launch guidance.
• Connect via any Android VNC viewer app or external monitor for a windowed desktop PC experience on mobile.
🎛️ MULTI-CONTAINER DASHBOARD & SYSTEM MONITOR
• Manage multiple containers side-by-side with per-container storage tracking.
• Live animated RAM and storage gauge dials.
• Real-time child process inspector (ps aux) with 1-tap kill confirmation.
• Active TCP network port listener detecting SSH, VNC, NGINX, and web ports with 1-tap browser launcher.
• Dedicated container deletion screen with real-time progress feedback and back-gesture safety.
🛠️ 1-CLICK SOFTWARE & DEVELOPER STACKS
• Web Server & Database: NGINX HTTP server with unprivileged port 8080 binding + SQLite3.
• Remote Access: OpenSSH Server for remote logins from your PC or laptop over LAN/Wi-Fi.
• Python 3 Stack: Python 3, pip, virtualenv, and C/C++ GCC build-essential tools.
• Node.js Stack: Node.js, npm, Yarn, Git, build-essential GCC, and Neovim.
• Android Dev Tools: OpenJDK 17, Gradle, ADB, and Android platform-tools inside Linux.
• Native multi-package manager support across apt, apk, pacman, and xbps.
🌐 STORAGE & MULTI-ARCHITECTURE
• Native support for ARM64 (aarch64), x86_64 (amd64), and ARMv7 (armhf).
• Automatic external storage mounting for SD Card access (/sdcard).
• 1-tap container backup (.tar.gz) export and import.
• Custom DNS configuration (/etc/resolv.conf) with quick presets.
📜 15 YEARS OF OPEN-SOURCE HERITAGE
Evolved from the original Complete Linux Installer project launched on XDA Developers in 2011. Built with open-source Jetpack Compose Material 3 and modern C++ PRoot engine technology.
License: Released under GNU General Public License v2.0 (GPL-2.0).

fdroid:com.elektropepi.bootboi.name: BootBoi
fdroid:com.elektropepi.bootboi.summary: Turn on/off your remote machine without leaving your couch!
fdroid:com.elektropepi.bootboi.description:
Ever wanted to turn on your remote machine (laptop, Raspberry, NAS), but didn't want to leave the couch? Well I for sure
understand this problem to the heart. But fear no more, as BootBoi is here to save you from the gruesome task of standing up
and pushing a button.
BootBoi features remote power on / power off / reboot for as many remote machines as you can imagine with the
combined power of SSH and Wake On Lan.
Preparing your Remote Machine
* Before you can use BootBoi with your remote machines, you have to prepare them for **remote** rebooting and powering them on/off.
Power On
* To power a remote device on, BootBoi uses Wake On Lan .
* This needs to be enabled in the BIOS of the machine you want to power on, read more here .
Power Off / Reboot
* BootBoi uses SSH to execute whoami, poweroff and reboot on the remote machine.
* So make sure that
 * Those binaries are available and in $PATH
 * The SSH user has sudo access to whoami, poweroff and reboot
 * Either by allowing the user sudo access only to those binaries via the sudoers file (recommended)
 * E.g. `echo "my_ssh_user ALL=(ALL) /sbin/reboot,/sbin/poweroff,/usr/bin/whoami" >> /etc/local/sudoers`
 * Or by using root as SSH user in BootBoi

fdroid:com.jjrapps.constanza.name: Constanza - Good habits
fdroid:com.jjrapps.constanza.summary: Habit reminders you answer without opening the app. No cloud, no ads.
fdroid:com.jjrapps.constanza.description:
Constanza is a habit-tracking app that opens and works in seconds. No account, nothing synced to any cloud, no ads and no analytics: it does not even declare the internet permission, so it could not connect even if it wanted to.
Each habit gets its own colour -from a palette of 21, or a custom one from its own hue/saturation/brightness picker- and its own schedule: every day, several times a day, a number of times a week, specific days of the week, a day of the month, or every N days. Any schedule can carry one or several reminder times.
The Today screen groups what is due now, what is due later, and what you have already answered, and you can step back to any past day to see what happened. Answering is one tap: Yes or No, no dialog to open. And when a reminder arrives, you can answer it right from the notification -Yes, No or Snooze- without even unlocking the phone.
A day you do not answer does not disappear: at midnight, any slot left unanswered becomes "Missed". Constanza does not hide what you let slip to make you feel better about it; it records it, and that record is what the streak and the compliance number are built from. Progress shows the current streak, the best streak, and the last-30-days compliance percentage for each habit.
Reminders survive a phone reboot and a time or timezone change: you do not need to reopen the app to keep them firing. If your phone does not grant the exact-alarm permission by default, Constanza tells you without blocking anything and takes you to the setting; if you would rather not grant it, reminders still arrive, just with a few minutes of slack.
At 23:30 by default, if something is still unanswered, a review notification reminds you before the day closes; and at 7:00, another one tells you how yesterday went and opens its list. And in Settings you can change how long a snooze lasts, pick the language (following the system, English or Spanish), and export or import all your data as a file, through the system's own file picker: it is your copy, not ours.
The interface is dark, always, with no light mode. That is not an oversight: the background is deliberately neutral so the only colour on screen is the one you gave each habit.
What you get:
• Habits with six schedule types and one or more reminder times.
• 21 colours plus a custom hue/saturation/brightness picker.
• Reminders answered Yes/No/Snooze right from the notification.
• An unanswered day is recorded as "Missed" at midnight, never hidden.
• Current streak, best streak, and last-30-days compliance per habit.
• A nightly review notification, configurable, or only when something is pending.
• Data export and import to a file, through the system picker.
• Reminders that survive reboots and time changes.
• English and Spanish.
• No accounts, no cloud, no ads, no tracking, no internet permission.

fdroid:com.secninjaz.octolab.name: OctoLab
fdroid:com.secninjaz.octolab.summary: Unofficial GitLab client for gitlab.com and self-hosted instances
fdroid:com.secninjaz.octolab.description:
OctoLab is a free and open-source, unofficial GitLab client for Android. It works with gitlab.com and self-hosted GitLab instances (Community or Enterprise Edition).
FEATURES
Accounts
* Sign in with gitlab.com in your browser (OAuth), or with a Personal Access Token on any GitLab instance
* Multi-account: self-hosted and gitlab.com side by side
Role-aware
* Shows only what your GitLab role allows (Guest, Reporter, Developer, Maintainer, Owner)
* Actions your role doesn't allow are hidden or explained
Issues and merge requests
* Browse, create, edit and comment on issues
* Filter by label, assignee or milestone
* View merge requests, comment and review diffs
* Subscribe to or unsubscribe from issues and merge requests
* Epics (GitLab Premium and Ultimate): a group's epics with their child items, comments and reactions
To-dos and notifications
* To-dos | Participating: your to-dos, and new comments on issues and merge requests you take part in
* Group by project, filter, mark as done or read
* Notifications for new to-dos and comments, with counts per account
Activity
* Your projects' and starred projects' activity, and your own; show only issues, merge requests, comments or pushes, newest or oldest first
Projects
* Browse files, README, branches, tags, commits and releases
* Search a project's code
* Projects and groups by your role or visibility, with search
* Images, videos and files open in the app
Also
* Bookmarks for projects, groups, issues, merge requests, commits and snippets
* Snippets, groups, Explore and search
* Dark and light theme
* Markdown rendering: GFM tables, task lists, code blocks, images
No tracking, no analytics, no proprietary services.
OctoLab requests the "install packages" permission solely to let you install release APKs you choose to download from a project's Releases page within the app — it is never used automatically or in the background.
OctoLab began as a GitLab-focused fork of OctoDroid (gh4a), an open-source GitHub client, and is maintained by SecNinjaz. OctoLab is not affiliated with or endorsed by GitLab Inc. GitLab is a trademark of GitLab Inc.
Source code: https://github.com/secninjaz/OctoLab

fdroid:com.vitorpamplona.amethyst.name: Amethyst
fdroid:com.vitorpamplona.amethyst.description:
Amethyst brings the best social network to your Android phone. Just insert your Nostr
private key and start posting.
 Nostr 
is an open protocol that is able to create a censorship-resistant global "social" network, transferring
notes and other stuff using relays. It doesn't rely on any trusted central server, hence it is resilient;
it is based on cryptographic keys and signatures, so it is tamperproof; it does not rely on P2P techniques,
therefore it works.
 What you can do with Amethyst 
 Post text, photos, videos, long-form articles, polls and voice notes to the relays you choose.
 Follow people, reply, repost, react and quote.
 Send private, end-to-end encrypted direct messages and join group chats.
 Browse dedicated feeds: articles, pictures, short videos, live streams, podcasts, music, communities,
classifieds, calendars and more.
 Send and receive Bitcoin Lightning zaps.
 Track your training and share a workout — see below.
 My Fitness — track your training 
 Amethyst includes a personal training dashboard. Open the left drawer and tap My Fitness ,
under You . It summarises the workouts you have logged in Amethyst, and — with your
permission — the ones your watch or fitness app has already saved to Android Health Connect
(Samsung Health, Google Fit, Fitbit, Garmin Connect, Strava and others all write there). It shows
you:
 How much you trained this week, and whether that is up or down on last week.
 Your four-week weekly average for time, distance, steps and climb.
 Where your time goes — running, cycling, walking, hiking, swimming, rowing, the gym.
 Your best efforts: longest distance, longest workout, biggest climb, most steps, highest heart rate.
 How many days you trained, and your current streak of consecutive active days.
 All of it is computed on your phone and shown to you. Nothing is uploaded to produce it, and you
never have to post anything to use it.
 Sharing a workout (optional) 
 If you want to tell your followers about a particular session, tap Share this workout on any
row. Amethyst opens a post pre-filled with that workout's figures; you review it and decide whether to
publish. One workout at a time, always with your confirmation, never automatic.
 The Health Connect integration is read-only. Amethyst never writes to Health Connect, never reads in
the background, never asks for your exercise route or location, and only ever looks at the last four
weeks. You can revoke access in Health Connect at any time. Full details are in the privacy policy at
 github.com/vitorpamplona/amethyst .
 Amethyst is free and open source (MIT). There is no Amethyst server and no Amethyst account: your
posts go straight to the Nostr relays you configure.

fdroid:eu.veldsoft.brainstonz.description:
Object of the Game 
Be the first player to fill a row, column, or diagonal with 4 stones.
 Setting Up the Game 
First select the options on the right-hand side of the screen. Below
is an explanation of the controls:
 Type 
Select the type of player. A player can be a human or a computer. You
can play against a friend or the computer. You can even watch the
computer play itself!
 Skill 
If this player's type is "Computer," this option sets the skill level
of the computer's Artificial Intelligence. (Don't be disappointed if
you cannot beat the computer at the hardest setting—it's impossible!)
 How to Play 
Black is the first player to take a turn.
The very first turn consists of only one move. Player 1 (black) gets
to place a stone anywhere on the board.
For the next turn, Player 2 (white) gets to place 2 stones on the
board. If Player 2 completes a pair of symbols, he/she can remove
Player 1's stone from the board.
All subsequent turns are like Player 2's first turn and follow this
pattern:
The current player places a stone on the board.
If the symbol on the board position just played matches a symbol
under any of the current player's other stones, he/she must
immediately remove a stone from the other player.
The current player places a second stone on the board.
If the current player completes a second pair of symbols, he/she
removes another stone from the other player.
The game ends when either:
A player completes an entire row, column, or diagonal with 4 stones.
It is impossible for the current player to move (a tie).

fdroid:superfreeze.tool.android.description:
Android app making it possible to entirely freeze all background activities of any app.
 A note to everyone who was supporting SuperFreezZ over the years:
 SuperFreezZ was my first "real" programming project, and I was incredibly happy about strangers donating to me and translating the app into languages I never heard of, and all the positive feedback I received. My start into the world of free and open source software couldn't have been better.
 It is hard to imagine now that back in 2018, when I made my first commit, I barely knew how to program at all. I didn't know where to start, so I just forked an app called "APK Extractor", and started finding out. I learned how to organize a (small) codebase, how to interact with a small-but-supportive community, and how to stay focused when there are lots of nice features that could be implemented.
 But the time has come to slowly wind down SuperFreezZ. These days, Android devices make it harder and harder for an app like SuperFreezZ to work properly. Also, Android devices are anyways restricting the amount of time an app is allowed to run in the background, making an app like SuperFreezZ less essential (without giving the user control over it, though). Myself, I am mostly busy working on other projects these days (mainly "Delta Chat" and "Chatmail").
 It's not over yet, though! If you have an old and slow phone, or if you like that SuperFreezZ gives you control over which app runs and which does not, then enjoy. And who knows, maybe one day, I will revisit this first project of mine, adding more of the features that were asked for over the years, or maybe someone will fork it.
 If SuperFreezZ does not work for you, here are a few alternatives I found on F-Droid (though I can't personally vouch for them):
 "Force Stop Helper": Similar to SuperFreezZ, with less features but still maintained, and you need to press "Force Stop" by yourself
 "Drowser": Uses Root to prevent apps from running in the background
 "Shelter": Allows you to isolate apps (and optionally to keep them from running in the background), but requires some extra storage to work
 Thanks again for being part of this!
 If you want to try out SuperFreezZ, here you go:
 SuperFreezZ
 Get back control over what runs on your phone
 Enhance battery life and reduce mobile data usage by freezing rarely used apps
 Especially useful while you are on a tour, where you need only some apps but a long battery life
 Greenify can also do this, but it is not Open Source.
 SuperFreezZ is not yet another task manager promising to delete 10 GB of data per month or making your device 2x as fast. This is impossible.
 Instead, SuperFreezZ is honest about its disadvantages: Freezing daily used apps probably drains your battery a little faster. Also, these apps will take longer to start when you use them the next time: SuperFreezZ will super freeze your apps, it takes about 1-3 seconds to un-freeze them. Greenify has the same disadvantages, except that the author of Greenify does not warn you about it. So: Just do not overdo it, and SuperFreezZ will be super useful.
 Examples for apps that deserve to be frozen:
 Untrusted apps (that you do not want to run in the background)
 Apps you rarely use
 Annoying apps
 Features
 Optionally works without accessibility service as this slows down the device
 Can freeze only apps not used for a week (can be configured)
 Choose a white list (freeze all by standard) or a black list (do not freeze anything by standard)
 Can freeze apps when the screen goes off
 Options to freeze system apps and even SuperFreezZ itself
 Completely open source and free software

apple-itunes:449655162.name: Gett: Book black taxis
apple-itunes:449655162.description:
Gett -The Black Taxi App
Ride iconic black cabs across London with Gett - your go-to rideshare app for quick family trips, airport transfers, and everyday journeys. Available on demand or reserved in advance, with an average wait time of under 4 minutes in central London.
Download Gett now and book black cabs that come to you.
Book an Iconic Black Cab
Experience London's most comfortable and convenient ride in a spacious 5 or 6-seater black cab. Enjoy fast, door-to-door rides in premium vehicles, with a separate driver compartment for privacy and air conditioning that you control.
Reliable Airport Transfers
Book a taxi to and from all the major airports in London, including Heathrow and Gatwick. There's plenty of room for all your luggage! Fast airport rides with priority booking available.
Family-Friendly Taxis
Black cabs are perfect for families with spacious interiors, room for strollers, and kid-friendly features. Book quick, safe family rides across London with drivers you can trust.
Order for Family and Friends
Hail taxis for your loved ones with Gett Family. Book, pay, and track your taxi all in one place - from pickup to arrival. Whether you need to arrange a school drop-off, a hospital trip for an elderly relative, or simply a ride home late at night, they won’t need to download a thing.
Priority Booking & Fast Rides
Black cabs use bus lanes to beat traffic, making your journey faster than regular taxis. Need a ride urgently? Choose the Gett Priority option for even quicker pickup times.
Fully Accessible Rides
All black cabs are wheelchair accessible as a standard feature. Book accessible rides with confidence - every journey is designed to be comfortable for all passengers.
Get There Faster
Booking a black cab means getting a driver who has passed The Knowledge - the world's toughest taxi exam. Cabbies know the city better than a GPS and can beat the traffic by using bus lanes - making black cab trips the quickest way to travel by taxi.
Passenger Safety
At Gett, your safety is our priority. Vehicles and drivers are licensed by TfL, and their details are confirmed before arrival. You can track progress from order to destination. Additionally, we offer a range of safety features such as driver ratings and ride location sharing to support you on your journey.
Eco-Friendly Electric Cabs
Gett donates 1p to Trees for Cities, a registered charity (number 1032154), for every ride a customer books and completes through the app. We also offset all the CO2 emissions from those rides with certified carbon offsetting projects. You can also choose the e-black cab vehicle class to book an electric black taxi.
Pre-Book & On-Demand
Book a ride ahead of time, or hail a cab virtually with on-demand booking. Priority booking available for urgent journeys.
Price Estimates
See the estimated meter fare for your taxi trip before you book and pay cashless through the app.
Rate & Tip Your Driver
Give your cab driver a rating up to 5 stars and let other travelers know how they did. Leave drivers a tip directly in the app if you're happy with your trip!
Customer Support
Need help or have a question? You can reach our team, who are available 24/7 via the live chat function in the app.

apple-macos:6752560738.description:
PDF Converter is a simple and practical PDF tool for mobile file processing. It helps you convert, merge, split, preview, save, and share PDF files directly from your phone.
Whether you are working with office documents, study materials, contracts, receipts, or image files, PDF Converter makes common PDF tasks easier and more efficient.
Key Features:
PDF to Word
Convert PDF files into Word documents for easier editing and reuse.
PDF to Excel
Convert PDF files into Excel spreadsheets, useful for table-based documents.
PDF to Images
Export PDF pages as clear images for viewing, saving, or sharing.
Images to PDF
Create PDF files from photos, screenshots, documents, receipts, notes, and other images.
Merge PDFs
Select multiple PDF files and combine them into one complete document.
Split PDFs
Split PDF files by page range and extract only the pages you need.
Preview and Share
Preview converted files, save them to history, and share them with other apps.
History Management
Keep conversion records for quick access and reuse.
PDF Converter is designed for everyday mobile PDF work, with a clean interface and straightforward operation.

apple-macos:1450874784.description:
Transporter is the simple and easy way to deliver content to Apple. Easily send apps, music, movies, TV shows, or books for distribution on the App Store, Apple Music, Apple TV, Apple Books, or iTunes Store.
 • Drag and drop your content into Transporter to get started.
 • Validate and upload multiple files simultaneously for fast delivery.
 • View delivery progress, including validation warnings, errors, and delivery logs, so you can quickly fix any issues.
 • See a history of past deliveries, including date and time.
 • Get push notifications when your app completes delivery, starts processing, and imports successfully or fails to import.
An App Store Connect, iTunes Connect, or encoding house account is required.

apple-macos:1185905221.name: Map Area Calculator - Marea
apple-macos:1185905221.description:
Marea turns any map into a precise area and distance calculator. Measure fields, plots, rooftops, lawns and lakes — anything you can see from above — in seconds.
FOUR WAYS TO MEASURE
- Tap to drop pins around a region and get its area instantly.
- Draw a freeform shape with your finger and Marea traces the outline.
- Walk the perimeter and GPS drops pins automatically as you go.
- Auto-detect plots — tap to find buildings, fields and parks already on the map and turn one into a measurement in a single tap.
RESULTS IN EVERY UNIT
Area in square meters, square feet, acres, hectares, square kilometers and square miles — plus the distance between every point.
TRACTOR MODE
Turn your phone into a field-coverage guide. Set your implement width and speed, then drive: Marea records each pass, draws your covered area live, and tracks total distance and worked acreage. Pause, resume and save passes.
GRID OVERLAY
Drop a measured grid over any plot to plan rows, sections or spacing — horizontal, vertical or both, with the spacing, direction and color up to you.
PROJECT AN AREA
Pin a saved plot to the centre of the screen at its real size, then pan and rotate around it to plan, compare or align on the ground.
ORGANIZE & ESTIMATE
- Save your areas and revisit them anytime
- Drop labeled markers on the points that matter
- Keep a to-do list for every area
- Add notes and attach photos
- Estimate prices by multiplying any rate by the measured area
SHARE ANYWHERE
Send a web link to any saved area — anyone can open it in a browser to see the polygon, its size and details. You can also export a KML file or share a map image or PDF.
BUILT FOR THE FIELD AND THE JOB SITE
Made for farmers, agronomists, roofers, pavers, landscapers, surveyors and real-estate pros:
- Estimate roofing, asphalt, paving, turf and seeding quantities
- Check property lines, lot sizes and parcels
- Plan plots, gardens and farmland
Subscription terms:
- The subscription auto-renews at the end of each term.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy policy and Terms of Use: https://mapareacalculator.com/privacypolicy/

apple-macos:1437100857.name: Health XML Splitter
apple-macos:1437100857.description:
Health XML Splitter is a tool that will split large health exports generated by Health.app into smaller, individual chunks. Health exports can be quite large, and breaking it up can be difficult if not impossible in a text editor. With this app, all you need to do is drag and drop your export.zip or export.xml right into the main window, and the app will take care of the rest.
This app was built specifically for use with Health Data Importer, the iOS app that you can use to import your Health data when migrating to a new device.

apple-macos:6479644903.name: PoweReader: AI RSS Reader
apple-macos:6479644903.description:
PoweReader is an RSS reader for iPhone and Mac. Lots of feeds, the essentials in minutes: AI picks the articles worth reading, summarizes them and reads them to you, and translates articles in other languages. It also works with your Feedbin, Miniflux, FreshRSS, NewsBlur, Tiny Tiny RSS or Fever account.
DAILY PICKS
The main stories in your feeds, in minutes. Open Discover and AI picks a few stories from your feeds. Each comes with a summary, key developments, what sources say and the articles that covered it. You can also listen to it as a briefing.
AI SUMMARY
The key points of an article in seconds, with an optional illustration. Summaries can also be generated on your device with the offline model. You can also summarize a category, a feed or the unread list: the list summary is split by topic, and you can tap any link to open the article.
AUDIO SUMMARY
When you can't look at the screen, AI reads an article's summary aloud. Playback starts a few seconds after you tap play.
TRANSLATION
Foreign-language articles are translated paragraph by paragraph, with the translation below each original paragraph. You can also show the translation only. Choose online AI translation, Apple Translate or offline translation.
YOUR OWN AI SERVICE
With Premium, connect the AI service of your choice and use your own API key for summaries, images and translation.
RSS SERVICES AND FEEDS
Sign in with Feedbin, NewsBlur, Miniflux, FreshRSS, Tiny Tiny RSS or any Fever API server, and unread and starred articles sync both ways. Or start right away with the built-in local account, no sign-up needed: the Feed Library has 130+ feeds by topic, or paste any feed address.
ICLOUD SYNC
With Premium, feeds, read status and starred articles sync between iPhone and Mac through iCloud.
READING
Read articles offline or in dark mode, with code blocks and mathematical formulas displayed correctly.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

apple-macos:6779244466.name: Nudgr Books
apple-macos:6779244466.description:
Nudgr: Books is a fast, private way to catalog and track your personal book collection.
Scan an ISBN barcode and the book is added in seconds — title, author, cover and details filled in automatically. Then keep track of what you
own, what you're reading, and who you've lent books to.
WHY YOU'LL LIKE IT
• Add books instantly by scanning the ISBN with your camera — or a Bluetooth barcode scanner
• Covers and details fetched automatically; edit anything by hand
• Track reading status (unread / reading / read), reading lists and ratings
• Remember who you lent a book to, and when
• Take or search for cover photos, and crop them right in the app
• Organize by author, series, genre and publisher; sort and group your shelf
• Stocktake mode: scan your shelf to see what's missing and fix incomplete entries
• Import an existing collection from CLZ
• Works offline and syncs across your devices
• Available in English, Swedish, German, Danish, Finnish, French, Spanish and Norwegian
Nudgr: Books is free to use. Some features may become paid in the future — we'll let you know in advance.
Your library is yours: data syncs to your private account, and you can delete your account and all your data at any time.

apple-macos:6767903343.name: Zywa: Fitness & Coaching
apple-macos:6767903343.description:
Zywa is one app for two kinds of people: anyone who wants to train with a clear plan, and coaches who want to run their whole coaching business from their phone.
Z AI — START TRAINING TODAY
• No coach yet? Z AI builds your starter workout plan and daily calorie and macro targets in about two minutes, from what you've already told us.
• Ask for changes in plain English, like "swap the squats" or "make it 3 days", and your plan updates. Or edit it yourself, any time.
• An optional body check measures front and side photos on your phone and deletes them straight away.
• Z AI uses Apple Intelligence and runs entirely on your iPhone, so your chat and answers stay on your phone. Requires an iPhone or iPad that supports Apple Intelligence. Available in English for now.
• Z AI isn't a coach, doctor or dietitian. Check with a professional before starting a new exercise or eating plan.
TRAIN ON YOUR OWN
• Build weekly routines or repeating cycles (2 on, 1 off, and more) with a dated calendar of what's next.
• Log every set with a Live Activity on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island — no need to unlock your phone mid-set.
• Log sets straight from your Apple Watch, with a rest timer and personal-record alerts on your wrist.
• Personal records tracked automatically: heaviest set, estimated 1RM and session volume, celebrated when you beat them. Optional RPE per set.
• Nutrition that fits how you eat: calorie and macro targets, food logging with barcode scanning, recipes, supplements and water.
• Progress you can see: streaks, charts, measurements, and a Home Screen widget.
• An exercise library with a 3D muscle explorer, plus your own custom exercises.
• Works with Apple Health: reads steps and active energy, writes your workouts.
TRAIN WITH A COACH
• Your coach's program appears in the app, session by session, with notes on every exercise.
• Check-ins go straight to your coach.
• Real chat: replies, read receipts, voice notes, photos, videos and files.
• Book sessions in your coach's available slots, in your own time zone.
FOR COACHES
• Build and assign complete programs from your phone — templates, multi-week programs, supersets, per-exercise notes. Edit a single upcoming session without touching the rest.
• A command center that shows who checked in, who missed a session, and who is drifting — with one-tap nudges.
• Design your own check-in forms and review submissions in one inbox.
• Session booking: set your availability, clients book themselves.
• Grow with sub-coaches who see only the clients you assign them.
• The same tools on a bigger screen at coach.zywa.ae.
PRICING
Zywa is free for everyone who trains. Coach accounts are free too, for up to 10 active clients — and every coach you refer earns you 5 more.
Available in English and Arabic.
Zywa is built in Dubai. Questions or ideas: hello@zywa.ae

Why Choose icTrainer?
- All-in-one indoor cycling, spinning, and training platform.
- Ideal for home fitness, cyclers, and those who love structured training, bike workouts, and HIIT cycling.
- Covers every level with training plans, indoor rides, cycling routes, and road challenges.

- Trusted worldwide by cyclers, triathletes, and biking enthusiasts who love training smarter.

From bike workouts to racing preparation, every ride, session, and route helps you train smarter, ride stronger, and stay fit. Whether you love spinning, rowing, treadmill workouts, or cross-training, icTrainer adapts to your training style.
Start today with icTrainer Indoor Bike Training. Train smarter, track every mile, and achieve your fitness goals. Try it free for one month!

flathub:io.github.cboxdoerfer.FSearch.description:

 Ignore case (e.g. searching for " fsearch " will match "FSearch" as well)

flathub:io.github.savantsavior.lettersfa.description:
When you combine the video game Tetris with the board game Scrabble you get LettersFall 110%! Letters rapidly fall and you must correctly spell American English words to clear them.
 LettersFall 110% is a free, open-source educational word puzzle arcade game for Linux. Features nice graphics, good sound effects, and a great music soundtrack. Also has easy to play mouse controls and fun and challenging gameplay.
 Plus multiple game modes with varying difficulty and a saved high score table for each mode. Features a 450,000+ word American English dictionary. Do you have the skills to battle your way to the end and win? "Learn To Have Fun!"

 It is used as ordinary car racing game, as AI racing game and as research
 platform.

fedora-packages:flent/flent-doc.description: Documentation for users of The FLExible Network Tester The FLExible Network Tester is a Python wrapper to run multiple simultaneous netperf/iperf/ping instances and aggregate the results. Tests are specified as config files (which are really Python), and various parsers for tool output are supplied. At the moment, parsers for netperf in -D mode, iperf in csv mode and ping/ping6 in -D mode are supplied, as well as a generic parser for commands that just outputs a single number. Several commands can be run in parallel and, provided they output timestamped values, (which netperf ping and iperf do, the latter with a small patch, available in the misc/ directory), the test data points can be aligned with each other in time, interpolating differences between the actual measurement points. This makes it possible to graph (e.g.) ping times before, during and after a link is loaded.

fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.name: flexmark-java-ext-media-tags

fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.description: Flexmark-java is a Java CommonMark (spec 0.28) parser using the blocks first, inlines after Markdown parsing architecture. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains an extension for embedding media using HTML5 media tags, in particular the audio, embed, picture, and video tags.

fedora-packages:gensio/gensio.name: gensio
fedora-packages:gensio/gensio.description: This is gensio (pronounced gen'-see-oh), a framework for giving a consistent view of various stream (and packet) I/O types. You create a gensio object (or a gensio), and you can use that gensio without having to know too much about what is going on underneath. You can stack gensio on top of another one to add protocol functionality. For instance, you can create a TCP gensio, stack SSL on top of that, and stack Telnet on top of that. It supports a number of network I/O and serial ports. gensios that stack on other gensios are called filters. You can do the same thing with receiving ports. You can set up a gensio accepter (accepter) to accept connections in a stack. So in our previous example, you can setup TCP to listen on a specific port and automatically stack SSL and Telnet on top when the connection comes in, and you are not informed until everything is ready. A very important feature of gensio is that it makes establishing encrypted and authenticated connections much easier than without it. Beyond basic key management, it's really no harder than TCP or anything else. It offers extended flexibility for controlling the authentication process if needed. It's really easy to use. Note that the gensio(5) man page has more details on individual gensio types.

firefox-addons:506646.name: Privacy Badger
firefox-addons:506646.summary: You need more than an ad blocker. Stop companies from spying on you with an extension developed by member-supported digital rights nonprofit EFF.
firefox-addons:506646.description:
Privacy Badger automatically learns to block hidden trackers. Whether you want to protect yourself from data brokers or don’t want Big Tech profiting off your browsing, Privacy Badger puts you in control of your data. When you install Privacy Badger, you join a movement of millions taking a stand against online tracking.
Privacy Badger sends the Global Privacy Control signal to opt you out of data sharing and selling, and the Do Not Track signal to tell companies not to track you. If trackers ignore these signals, Privacy Badger will learn to block them.
Besides automatic tracker blocking, Privacy Badger replaces potentially useful trackers (video players, comments widgets, etc.) with click-to-activate placeholders , and removes outgoing link click tracking on Facebook and Google , with more privacy protections on the way.
To learn more, see the FAQ on Privacy Badger's homepage .
EFF takes the fight for your privacy beyond the browser to the courts, legislatures, and the streets. Join us .

firefox-addons:788743.name: Cyclonis Password Manager
firefox-addons:788743.summary: Password manager, designed to allow you to create, store and access website login passwords and other sensitive information in your personal encrypted vault.
firefox-addons:788743.description:
Organize and manage all your passwords. Store them in your vault, which is encrypted with a recognized encryption standard – AES-256. Don't wait. Get started today! Enjoy the peace of mind of never worrying about remembering your many passwords.
IMPORTANT: This extension will only work if you have the Cyclonis Password Manager desktop application already installed on your computer. You may download the desktop application at www.cyclonis.com .
Using just a single password for multiple online accounts? Is keeping track of your many passwords an impossible task? With Cyclonis Password Manager, you can manage, organize and control all your passwords in one central place. Cyclonis Password Manager stores your data in a personal vault, that is encrypted with AES-256 bit, an encryption algorithm used by governments, financial institutions, and in military applications. 
Cyclonis Password Manager encrypts your vault using your master password. Your master password is for your eyes only – your data cannot even be accessed by Cyclonis staff or servers as we never transmit or store your master password.
Signing up to a new social media website? This means that you should create a new and unique password. Let Cyclonis Password Manager take care of this tedious process for you. Using Cyclonis Password Manager’s password generator, you can create complex passwords that are designed to help avert the most popular password-cracking methods. Of course, no password, no matter how complex, can be 100% guaranteed against being compromised. Best of all, you can save your new social media account’s login details to your Cyclonis Password Manager vault, accessible directly from your web browser. The next time you visit that social media website, Cyclonis Password Manager’s browser extension can auto-fill your username and password, and even log you in automatically.
There's no point in having your data consolidated if you can't easily access it. This is where the Cyclonis Password Manager browser extension comes in. It automatically connects to the Cyclonis Password Manager desktop application and enters your login details for you for each website that you have stored in your vault, saving you time and the frustration of having to manually type your login details. Just navigate to the website and let Cyclonis Password Manager’s browser extension automatically fill in the username and password fields. It can even be configured to log you in automatically by activating the “Sign in” button. There’s no typing, no copying, and no pasting. 
Cyclonis Password Manager doesn’t just store usernames and passwords. You can also store and manage your payment and personal profile information in the Cyclonis Password Manager encrypted vault. You'll be able to use Cyclonis Password Manager’s convenient auto-fill features to move through checkout pages and registration forms more quickly. 
Cyclonis Password Manager stores your data in your personal encrypted vault. Your vault is encrypted with AES-256 bit encryption, as used by military & government organizations worldwide. Only your master password can unlock your vault. Significantly, your Cyclonis Password Manager master password is never even transmitted to Cyclonis staff or servers. As a result, we have no access to your decrypted data, and we have no way to reset or recover your master password. If you forget your master password, Cyclonis Password Manager cannot decrypt your data and cannot restore access to your passwords or any other data stored in your vault. Make sure you don't lose or forget your master password. 
Key Features: 
- View, add, edit, delete, and manage your passwords from a searchable vault.
- Use your passwords in multiple browsers on multiple devices.
- Search your vault and navigate to your favorite websites with just a few clicks.

bluejetty:00127889:ios.description:
Reflectly is a journaling app that's like your best friend. Vent your thoughts & feelings to improve your mood and practice mindfulness. Write down how you feel each day in your own mood diary — an intelligent journal & mood tracker that gives you personalized prompts and motivation the more you use it.
THE BEST JOURNAL APP FOR SELF-CARE AND MINDFULNESS
How you’re feeling on a daily basis matters. Reflectly is a personal journal driven by AI to help you deal with negative thoughts and increase positivity.
Be prepared for stress relief, reducing anxiety & depression in your life. Your self-care and mental health should always be a priority.
Reflectly uses positive psychology, mindfulness, and cognitive behavioral therapy (cbt) to help you thrive. It gives you the tools and mindset to build a positive cycle with our habit tracker. Fancy a bit of self-dating? Reflectly supports your self-love journey.
Never journaled before? No need to worry, our intelligent journal system gives you personalized prompts and reminders. If you want to build a health-focused lifestyle, increase motivation & gratitude, practice mindfulness, or combat anxiety, our personalized questions encourage deeper reflection. 
RECOMMENDED BY PROFESSIONALS
Journaling is a respected method to improve your mood, productivity, and mental health. Psychologists, therapists, and industry experts reaffirm this. It’s time to invest in your self-care routine.
HOW REFLECTLY WORKS
• Write down how you feel each day. Morning daily motivation quotes & challenges, evening daily insights, and whenever you need to vent.
• Using AI & smart tech, Reflectly’s mood tracker helps by showing you mood correlations and graphs. Been stressed for the last 10 days and can’t pin-point why? Reflectly has answers.
• We ask personalized questions based on your diary entries so you can reflect deeper.
• Read or edit previous journal entries.
• Receive daily, weekly, and monthly overviews with personalized insights and reminders.
REVIEWS
- "It’s a really amazing app. It’s the one app I go to write about my feelings and how my day was :) I really recommend this app to ANYONE."
- "I love that this app lets me keep all my entries to read later. I also love that it gives some direction for people like me who want to journal but don’t know where to start."
REFLECTLY PREMIUM
Unlock Reflectly and become your own hero.
• Create unlimited stories in your personal planner
• Get a new question and reminder each day to help you reflect
• Unlock advanced statistics, actionable insights, and much more!
Reflectly offers auto-renewing subscriptions. Pricing is shown in the app before you purchase and varies by region.
After free trial, the total amount for the subscription will be charged to your iTunes Account. The subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal at the total subscription price within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions and auto-renewals may be managed or canceled via your iTunes Account settings. Any unused portion of free trial is forfeited after purchase. Special introductory offers only apply to first billing term.
Read more about our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy here:
• https://kodeon.ai/privacy-policy
• https://kodeon.ai/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00156946:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00156946:ios.description:
Get the best out of your rides by transforming your smartphone into a motorcycle tool using the BMW Motorrad Connected app.
Use our app to plan your dream routes or import routes as a GPX file.
Thanks to the networking with your motorcycle, you can record all the relevant information about your ride if you want.
If your BMW motorcycle is equipped with a TFT display and Connectivity, simply connect to your motorcycle with Bluetooth to do this.
If your BMW motorcycle does not have a TFT display but does have a Multi-Controller and navigation preparation, then get the ConnectedRide Cradle and turn your smartphone into a motorcycle display.
No matter whether you choose the option of “fast” (direct route) or “curvy” (route with a lot of turns), you can always keep your route reliably in view thanks to voice announcements to your communication system and navigation instructions that are easy to see in the display. By using the intuitive Multi-Controller, you can control everything safely without having to take your hands off the handlebars.
Want to keep your friends up to date? Then easily share your riding data and photos on social media.
We are continuously refining our app for you. Stay tuned to discover the latest functions. 
Here is an overview of all the features that the BMW Motorrad Connected app currently offers you:
#Route Planning.
• Route planning and storage with waypoints
• Motorcycle-specific navigation with "winding route" route criterion
• Weather information for current location
• Route import and export (GPX files)
• Free map download for offline use
#Navigation.
• Motorcycle navigation suitable for everyday use
• Arrow navigation in the 6.5” TFT display
• Map navigation in the 10.25” TFT display or ConnectedRide Cradle
• Voice announcements possible (if communication system present)
• Turn-by-turn instructions, including lane recommendations
• Current traffic data
• Speed limit display
• Point-of-Interest search
#Tour Recording.
• Recording distances traveled including vehicle data
• Analysis of performance values such as banking angle, acceleration and engine speed
• Route export (GPX files)
• Sharing recorded journeys and photos on social media
#Vehicle Data.
• Current mileage
• Tank capacity and remaining range
• Tire pressure (with TPM optional equipment)
• Online service appointment scheduling
Application Notices.
• The app is part of BMW Motorrad Connectivity and can only be used in combination with vehicles with a TFT display or ConnectedRide Cradle. The connection between smartphone, vehicle/cradle and—if present—communication system is established wirelessly via Bluetooth. It can be operated with the Multi-Controller on the handlebars. To output music, telephony and navigation information, the use of the BMW Motorrad communication system is recommended.
• A mobile Internet connection is necessary to receive traffic data. This can result in costs in accordance with the contract between the customer and provider (such as roaming charges).
• Be aware that the functionality of your smartphone and the connection to the vehicle also depend on national requirements and conditions, and therefore cannot be guaranteed by BMW Motorrad at all times.
• The BMW Motorrad Connected app is displayed in the language configured in the smartphone. Please note that not all languages are supported.
• Continuous use of GPS localization in the background may lead to a reduced battery life.
Make Life a Ride.

bluejetty:00041400:ios.name: Remote for Hisense Smart TV.
bluejetty:00041400:ios.summary: Can't find your Hisense TV remote again? Is your original remote broken or unresponsive? This app transforms your iPhone or iPad into a fully functional Hisense TV remote control, supporting VIDAA U6, U7, U8 series and Android TV models inc
bluejetty:00041400:ios.description:
Can't find your Hisense TV remote again? Is your original remote broken or unresponsive? This app transforms your iPhone or iPad into a fully functional Hisense TV remote control, supporting VIDAA U6, U7, U8 series and Android TV models including A6, A7, H8, H9, and H10 series.
Designed for Hisense smart TV owners who need reliable control without hunting for physical remotes or dealing with broken buttons.
HOW IT WORKS
The app connects to your Hisense TV through your home Wi-Fi network using the same protocol as your original remote. Once connected, it sends infrared-equivalent commands directly to your TV's receiver. The interface mirrors your physical remote layout but adds smartphone advantages like a full QWERTY keyboard for typing Netflix passwords or YouTube searches.
COMPATIBLE HISENSE TV MODELS
- VIDAA Smart TVs — U6, U7, U8, U9 series running VIDAA 4.0, 5.0, or 6.0 operating systems
- Android TV Models — A6, A7, H8, H9, H10 series with Android TV 9.0 or newer
- Roku TV Models — R6, R7, R8 series with built-in Roku platform
- 4K ULED Models — H65, H75, H85 series with quantum dot technology
KEY FEATURES
- Power and Volume Control — Turn your TV on and off, adjust volume, and mute audio instantly without reaching for the physical remote.
- Channel Navigation — Browse channels using number pad input or channel buttons, plus access your favorite channel list.
- Smart TV Menu Access — Navigate through Hisense's VIDAA interface, Android TV home screen, or Roku channel grid using directional pad controls.
- Keyboard Input for Apps — Type login credentials for Netflix, Hulu, Amazon Prime, and YouTube using your phone's full keyboard instead of navigating letter by letter.
- App Launch Shortcuts — Directly open Netflix, YouTube, Amazon Prime Video, Disney Plus, and other streaming apps without scrolling through the home screen.
WHO USES THIS APP
- Families with multiple Hisense TVs who want one smartphone solution that works with all their TVs in different rooms.
- College students whose original Hisense remote got lost during a move or broke from heavy use and need an immediate replacement.
- Parents whose kids constantly misplace the TV remote and want a backup solution that's always available on their phone.
- Seniors who find smartphone keyboards easier to use than navigating letter-by-letter on TV screens when entering passwords for streaming services.
HOW TO GET STARTED
1. Download the app and ensure your iPhone and Hisense TV connect to the same Wi-Fi network
2. Open the app and select your specific Hisense TV model from the compatibility list
3. Follow the pairing instructions to establish connection between your phone and TV
SUBSCRIPTION
Annual Plan: $9.99 per year — less than $1 per month for unlimited touchpad and playback controls
Payment charges to your iTunes account upon purchase confirmation. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage subscriptions in iTunes account settings.
DISCLAIMER
This app is designed as an independent remote control solution, not an official Hisense product. Hisense is a trademark of Hisense Group. VIDAA is a trademark of VIDAA USA. Android TV is a trademark of Google LLC. Roku is a trademark of Roku Inc.
Privacy Policy: https://hiremote.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://hiremote.app/terms

bluejetty:00038661:ios.name: Rally Tripmeter
bluejetty:00038661:ios.summary:
Rally Tripmeter turns your phone or tablet into a rally trip computer. Built by a rally driver and used on recce, on the road sections and on the stages.
WHAT IT DOES
• Two independent trips plus stage and section distances, in digits you
bluejetty:00038661:ios.description:
Rally Tripmeter turns your phone or tablet into a rally trip computer. Built by a rally driver and used on recce, on the road sections and on the stages.
WHAT IT DOES
• Two independent trips plus stage and section distances, in digits you can read at a glance while driving
• Stage timer with average and maximum speed
• Regularity / TSD (time, speed, distance) mode for regularity rallies: enter the speed chart, record time controls and see live whether you are ahead of or behind the ideal time
• Recce mode with speed limits per section and a warning when you exceed them
• Pacenotes (early access, free during the beta): record your recce drive and the app writes a note for every corner, with live and spoken calls, replay, editing and a printable pacenote book
• Liaison mode with a time card: last TC, allowed time, next TC and a countdown to it
• Map with route recording and sharing, plus live location sharing for your service crew
• Custom layouts: build your own screen from components in your own colors, on phone or tablet
• Bluetooth buttons to reset trips without touching the screen
• Rally Raid mode with heading
• Calibration factor, metric or imperial units, 14 languages
ON YOUR WATCH
Apple Watch and Wear OS apps:
• Rally Time: the official rally clock, free
• Liaison: countdown to the next TC
• Stage timer with a double tap to finish
• Regularity: SPEED UP or SLOW DOWN, with the time to the next section
• Recce: the speed-limit sign
• Complications and a Wear OS tile
The watch app is part of Pro; daily Pro fuel lets you try it.
FREE AND PRO
The basic tripmeter is free with a daily mileage allowance. Free daily Pro fuel lets you drive the Pro modes too. Pro removes the limits.
Works without cell service, GPS is all it needs. A reliable backup next to a professional rally trip, and the main instrument at club events and at historic and classic rallies.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://rallytripmeter.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00125412:android.description:
MixVideo is a professional and easy-to-use video editor & video maker with all powerful features. Recording your life, sharing funny moments or just unleashing your creativity, MixVideo is always your best video editor choice. Basic video editing functions like trim, split, reverse, flip, rotate and crop. Additional video editing decorations, adding text, music, effects, stickers, filters, transitions, PIP, animations make videos unique and cool!
As a user-friendly video editing app, beginners can quickly edit and export videos without quality loss and share videos seamlessly!
 👍🏻Professional video editor
【💡Powerful editing features】As a pro video editor app, MixVideo offers tools to trim/split/reverse/flip/rotate video. Crop video arbitrarily according to a custom ratio or social media ratio. 
【Add text】Edit text to video, modifying styles like color, fonts, bubble, animation, stoke, background and shadow.
【✨Effects & Transitions 】Amazing glitch effects, dark effects, variety effects, dream effects, love effects, transition effects make videos editing more different and aesthetic.
【🎵Music & Sound】Music and sound effects are well-selected. You can even record your voice-over to follow the video. 
【Audio extract】Extract the music in any video, and edit it in a new video.
【Flexible speed control】Conventional speed supports 0.25x to 4x video speed change. Curve speed supplies an interesting way of editing video speed for special moments. Its video speed ranges from 0.1x to 10x at any time. In this video editor, speed up or slow down can vary at different time zones.
【🖼️Filter & Adjust】Edit videos with art filters deigned for portraits, food, scenery. Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness, temperature, and other professional editing features.
【😜Massive stickers】Edit videos with a huge selection of animated stickers like celebration, vlog, flowers, heart, animals, facial decorations, butterflies…
Export video
【Custom export resolution】 Export video in 480P, 720P, 1080P and 2K. Quickly export video to phone at any time with no quality loss.
 Share video
【One-click share】Share videos to Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, WhatsApp, and more. Share wonderful videos with friends!
🎬【Pro Video Editor】
* Merge multiple videos/pictures into one video. 
* Basic editing tools to trim/split/reverse/flip/rotate video.
* Intuitive timeline and tabs allow you to easily edit the position and application time.
* Special video editing elements like text, stickers, effects, music, animations, transitions, background/PIP to make video full of style. 
* Edit the video speed arbitrarily according to your needs.
🎬【Fashion Templates Editor】
* Add your pictures or videos, and get an exquisite video full of cool effects and popular music. 
* Pro video editor app allows to replace/trim/crop video clips, custom video volume.
* Music, effects, and transitions follow the video rhythm, precise card points.
🎬【Video Collage Editor】
* Quick collage several videos or pictures and synchronized playback. 
* Several arrangement layouts are available.
* Freely edit video layout borders and video play order.
🎬【Edit Drafts】
* Edit your video drafts again anytime, anywhere, without limitations.
As a pro video editor app with music and effects, MixVideo makes video editing so easy. Everything related to video editing can be found here. Don't hesitate, let's get started!🚀

bluejetty:00177440:ios.summary:
TomTom – GPS Navigation App for Every Driver
Meet your new go-to navigation app. Whether you're planning a weekend road trip, commuting to work, or simply exploring new roads, TomTom provides the GPS navigation experience drivers trust. Bui
bluejetty:00177440:ios.description:
TomTom – GPS Navigation App for Every Driver
Meet your new go-to navigation app. Whether you're planning a weekend road trip, commuting to work, or simply exploring new roads, TomTom provides the GPS navigation experience drivers trust. Built with the latest maps, real-time traffic alerts, and precision routing, this navigation app is designed to get you where you need to go—faster and safer.
Navigate With Confidence
Enjoy detailed turn-by-turn GPS navigation globally. TomTom’s regularly updated maps offer accurate road geometry, lane guidance, and intersection views—so you never miss a turn. It’s smart, flexible, and ready for the road.
Real-Time Traffic Information
Avoid delays and bottlenecks with accurate traffic data updated in real time. Receive warnings about road closures, congestion, and incidents ahead. With live traffic updates, the app automatically adjusts your navigation route to keep you moving efficiently.
Complete Driving Support
• More than just a GPS tool, TomTom is your all-in-one driving companion.
• Get speed camera alerts and current vs. limit speed info
• Choose multiple route types: fastest, shortest, or most efficient
• View real-time traffic flows and lane suggestions
Apple CarPlay Compatibility
Project your GPS navigation experience to your car’s screen with Apple CarPlay. The clean interface is distraction-free—no ads, no pop-ups—just clear maps, directions, and traffic info designed for safer driving.
Smart Features for Smarter Navigation
TomTom helps you make the most of your drive with essential navigation tools:
• Detailed maps for cities and rural areas alike
• Community-powered reports for hazards and speed traps
• Location-based suggestions for rest stops, food, and services
• Reliable ETAs powered by live traffic and real-time rerouting
Safe, Private, and Ad-Free
Focus on the road ahead. With TomTom, your data stays private, and your navigation is never interrupted by ads or tracking.
Download the TomTom GPS Navigation app now – drive smarter with real-time traffic, precise maps, and expert-level GPS navigation.

bluejetty:00073919:ios.name: Hurricane Center
bluejetty:00073919:ios.summary: Hurricane Center gives you a focused, modern way to track tropical weather when it matters most. Follow active hurricanes, tropical storms, depressions, and monitored NHC basins with live storm details, forecast tracks, cones, satellite ima
bluejetty:00073919:ios.description:
Hurricane Center gives you a focused, modern way to track tropical weather when it matters most. Follow active hurricanes, tropical storms, depressions, and monitored NHC basins with live storm details, forecast tracks, cones, satellite imagery, advisories, outlooks, and alert tools built specifically for hurricane season.
Designed around official tropical cyclone monitoring, Hurricane Center helps you quickly understand what is active, where it is headed, and what changed since the last advisory.
Features include:
- Active storm tracking for hurricanes, tropical storms, and depressions
- Official National Hurricane Center advisories and outlooks
- Forecast cone, track, wind, surge, and satellite map layers
- Basin-based storm monitoring
- Followed storm alerts for advisory changes
- Recent alert history with read and unread status
- Map Pro premium overlays for advanced storm tracking, available as an in-app purchase
- Synthesized NOAA Weather Radio stations available as an in-app purchase
- Universal iPhone and iPad support
- Dark hurricane-focused interface built for quick scanning
Hurricane Center is built for people who want a serious tropical weather app without clutter. Whether you are watching one storm or monitoring an active basin, the app keeps the most important hurricane information close at hand.
For support, questions, or feedback, contact us from inside the app.
Hurricane Center is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by NOAA, the National Hurricane Center, or the National Weather Service. Alert delivery and timing depend on notification settings, connectivity, Apple services, and upstream data. Use multiple sources of emergency information.

bluejetty:00042111:ios.summary: Mitra is the AI assistant that represents you on phone calls. It makes and answers calls, follows your instructions, and helps you get things done. It learns your preferences and keeps track of the details, with an emphasis on privacy, secu
bluejetty:00042111:ios.description:
Mitra is the AI assistant that represents you on phone calls. It makes and answers calls, follows your instructions, and helps you get things done. It learns your preferences and keeps track of the details, with an emphasis on privacy, security, and control.
Key features
• Make and answer calls: Let Mitra coordinate plans, arrange appointments, resolve questions, and follow through on your behalf.
• On your own number: Mitra makes and answers calls using the number people already know.
• Talk naturally: Tell Mitra what you need by text or voice. It remembers the context and preferences you share.
• Stay involved: Listen live, read transcripts, or join a call. Choose when Mitra should ring you.
• Review conversations: Find recordings, transcripts, and summaries after your calls.
• Manage your day: Keep your to-dos, plans, and important updates together.
• Connect your apps: Let Mitra find information, send emails, update your calendar, and work with your files.
• Use a secure browser: Get help finding information and completing tasks on websites.
• Set your boundaries: Choose what to share, what to connect, and approve actions that need your permission.
• Make it yours: Customize your assistant or create separate assistants for different responsibilities.
Terms of Use: https://www.getmitra.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.getmitra.com/privacy-policy

Measure and track your heart rate using your smartphone and keep a history of your pulse readings.
Blood Pressure Log

Log your blood sugar and glucose levels to better understand your health patterns.
Health History
All your measurements are securely stored so you can track changes and progress over time.
Share Your Results

It is a single interface for all the workforce, including full-time/hourly Employees and contractors to manage all their work related activi
bluejetty:00042449:ios.description:
OntheJob is a platform for Enterprises to manage their people operations and employee engagement. 
It is a single interface for all the workforce, including full-time/hourly Employees and contractors to manage all their work related activities seamlessly and effectively. It aims to make the work life of employees better and easy to manage. 
Employees can access their work schedules from their employers. 
Real time updates for schedules and leaves are provided
Tasks can be assigned to employees and teams and can be tracked based on progress
System wide announcement feature provides for quick communication in case of emergency or general matters 
Managers and administrators can conduct surveys and polls for employee engagement
Employees can communicate with their team and managers through the Chats feature 
Employees can receive awards and recognition based on their performance which is reflected in the Leaderboard
Employees have the ability to set their notification preferences to determine when they shall receive particular notifications
The app has multilingual support in English, Spanish, French, Urdu and Arabic. More languages can be added based on requirement. 
Login is SSO enabled and has a biometric feature to prevent users from typing their credentials every time they want to login
To use this app, the employer needs to be signed up with OntheJob

bluejetty:00080111:ios.summary: Dive into the delightful world of PiKuBo, a captivating puzzle game that brings the excitement of cubic nonograms to your iOS device. With a unique twist on a beloved classic, PiKuBo challenges you to carve out shapes from a larger cube by
bluejetty:00080111:ios.description:
Dive into the delightful world of PiKuBo, a captivating puzzle game that brings the excitement of cubic nonograms to your iOS device. With a unique twist on a beloved classic, PiKuBo challenges you to carve out shapes from a larger cube by removing unnecessary blocks. You can think of it as a 3D Minesweeper.
• Interactive Puzzle Fun: Engage with over 400 puzzles, each offering a cute shape to uncover.
• Adaptive Controls: Whether you’re right-handed or left-handed, our controls are designed for easy, one-handed play.
• Progress at Your Pace: Save your progress effortlessly and return to solve puzzles whenever it suits you.
• No Guesswork Needed: All puzzles are solvable through logic alone—perfect for puzzle purists!
• Customizable Markers: Use up to four paint colors to mark and manage your strategy without losing track of your solution.
• Immersive Experience: Enjoy soothing bossa nova tunes that enhance your puzzle-solving ambiance, whether at home or on the go.
• Flexible Viewing: Choose between portrait or landscape modes to suit your play style.
• Shared Fun: Purchase level packs once and share them with your entire family group.
• Visual Rewards: Relish the thumbnails of completed puzzles, a colorful testament to your puzzle prowess.
Whether you have a few minutes or a few hours, PiKuBo is the perfect game to relax and test your brain. Start solving today!
NOTE: The first pack, which consists of 31 puzzles and 5 tutorials, is provided for free. The rest of the packs are available as in-app purchases within the game.

bluejetty:00061143:ios.name: Flightview - Flight Tracker
bluejetty:00061143:ios.summary: Free Flight tracking app from the leaders in real-time flight information. Track upcoming and in-air flights, and receive status alerts via push notification. Check gate assignments, delays and cancellations and use the attractive flight
bluejetty:00061143:ios.description:
Free Flight tracking app from the leaders in real-time flight information. Track upcoming and in-air flights, and receive status alerts via push notification. Check gate assignments, delays and cancellations and use the attractive flight map to see a flight's progress. Forward your itinerary confirmation emails and Flightview will automatically load them into your Trips. See your Trips across mobile devices and at www.Flightview.com. View a North American airport delay map with radar weather overlay. Wherever life takes you, count on Flightview to help you travel smarter!
 "Easy-to-use app that should be an essential for air travelers" - Practical Travel Gear
 "I highly recommend this App, even if you only fly a few times a year it would be incredibly useful." - AppShouter
 "There are a lot of flight tracking apps for the iPhone - but most of them sell for $4.99 to $9.99. FlightView is significantly cheaper - and even more reliable. The new app also has a great user interface. It's easy to use, has great visuals and makes information easily available for the on-the-go users." - Fresh Apps
Flight Tracking Features:
 • Track flights on a map showing flight path and current radar weather
 • My Home page gives an easy view into your home airport's current status and your next trip
 • Flight Status Push Alerts for flights stored in My Trips
 • View terminal, gate and baggage claim information
 • See where the plane for your flight is coming from and check its status via Aircraft's Previous Flight 
 • Driving Directions to Airport integration with iPhone Maps
 • Easily find alternative flights by viewing flight schedules between cities
 • Search flights up to 350 days in the future and save them
 • See My Next Trip information on the iOS 'Today' view
My Trips Features:
 • Forward your itinerary confirmation email to Trips@Flightview.com, and it will be automatically loaded into your My Trips on your device
 • Trips are synced between devices and with www.Flightview.com so you can quickly reference their statuses everywhere
 • Add notes to flights or trips, such as car rental and hotel reservation numbers, and keep all of your day-of-travel information in one place
 • While in-flight, review your saved itineraries in Airplane mode
Airport Delay Information Features:
 • View a color-coded map of airport delays in the US & Canada with weather overlay to see how your travel plans could be affected
 • View list of airports suffering the Biggest Departure Delays right now 
 • View Flightview's proprietary Airport Delay Index for 180 major airports in the US and Canada
 • View FAA Airport Closures & Delay Programs for major airports in the US
Calendar Integration:
 • Post your Flight or the Flights within a Trip to your iPhone Calendar 
Sharing Features:
 • Share trip itineraries via email or share flights via email or SMS/text
 • Post your Trip Itinerary or Flight Information on Facebook
 • Login to Flightview using Facebook login
Weather Features:
 • View current weather conditions at arrival and departure airports on the Flight Details screen
 • 7-Day Weather forecast so you can see the weather forecast for both ends of your trip
Other Great Features:
 • Call an airline reservation number directly from the Flight Details screen
 • In the Help section, read the Frequently Asked Questions and their answers, Flight Tracking Tips, Flight Status definitions and Flight Tracking terms
Tired of Ads?
 • If you would like to avoid seeing ads, then check out our Flightview plus application in the paid section of the App Store - no ads there!
