bluejetty:00120723:ios.name: Wildland Toolkit
bluejetty:00120723:ios.summary:
Designed for wildland firefighters, this app has something for newbies as well as seasoned professionals. This is a tool you will use for years, during the off season, at camp, and even on the fireline. 
Wildland Toolkit provides a plethor
bluejetty:00120723:ios.description:
Designed for wildland firefighters, this app has something for newbies as well as seasoned professionals. This is a tool you will use for years, during the off season, at camp, and even on the fireline. 
Wildland Toolkit provides a plethora of wildland fire reference material, including the actual IRPG 2025, ICS forms, quizzes that cover NWCG courses, photos of tools and aircraft types, etc. Learn new things, and reinforce what you already know.
If you’ve had S290 or S390, you know how hard it is to calculate things like FDFM, PIG, rate of spread, flame length, etc. With this app, those numbers are spit out instantly as you take the weather! Now you can store all your weather logs for all your fires right on the app. The goal has always been to make recording the weather easier than paper.
Even better, you can share those weather logs from the field if you have network coverage, or wait until later and pull them up on your iPad or M1-based Mac, where all the data is synced, and do further analysis and sharing.
Just enter the fuel, weather, and topography information and Wildland Toolkit will generate:
--RH and Dewpoint
--Fine Dead Fuel Moisture
--Probability of Ignition
--Flamelength
--Rate of Spread
--Scorch height
--Direction of Max Spread
--Effective Windspeed
All 54 of the new fuel models are supported, with a guide to select the proper fuel model, complete with sample photos.
NOTE: There are no known calculation errors in this version. We will immediately fix any problems reported to us directly. 
Wildland Toolkit is not a tutorial on wildland fire behavior, so if the terms above do not make any sense, then this application will not teach you. It is assumed that you know the same background information that is presented in an S290 or S390 class. The calculations done in the Wildland Toolkit are similar to what is done with the BEHAVE software, but you will find the user interface much easier to use.
--In addition, numerous safety checklists and reference guides are included, such as watchouts, fire orders, safety zones, watchouts, structure defense, sizeups, crew briefing, after action reviews, LCANS, and complexity analysis etc. 
--Photos and diagrams are provided for cloud types, hand signals, common wildland tools, firefighting aircraft, and ICS org charts. 
--Interactive practice quizzes are included for basic wildland fire, CPR, NIMS IS-700, S230 and S290.
--ICS reference guide with position descriptions, an index of forms, and incident typing
--Pack Test Timer guides you through your pack test and tells you your current pace and expected finish time ***
--Cool Slope Calculator uses your phone to tell you slope
--And if that's not all, the IRPG is provided in PDF form
*** Pack Test timer uses GPS. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. GPS is not used if the Pack Test is stopped.

bluejetty:00088332:ios.summary:
ChristmasListApp is your smart and fun solution to gift giving this Christmas season! Create Christmas gift lists, share them with family and friends, claim items to purchase and set a budget. 
The ChristmasListApp experience is festive, f
bluejetty:00088332:ios.description:
ChristmasListApp is your smart and fun solution to gift giving this Christmas season! Create Christmas gift lists, share them with family and friends, claim items to purchase and set a budget. 
The ChristmasListApp experience is festive, fun and easy for anyone to use. Receive notifications when new Christmas wish list items are added so you can be the first to claim! No more coordinating gift lists between family members. 
What sets us apart? We offer a web application, from any device, anywhere. Easily add gifts from any online store or snap a pic of a gift in store on the shelf and upload. Curated gift list ideas and deal alerts available. Created by a family, for families! 
Check out our tutorial videos to see ChristmasListApp in action!
So many features!
-Create a gift list (for yourself or others)
-Add items from any online store
-Take pictures of items on shelf in store and add to your list
-Share your list with family and friends easily
-Claim items on other lists (no more duplicate gifts-yay!)
-Track your spending budget
-Manage your shopping list, mark items as bought
-Find gift ideas and suggestions
-Receive deal alerts and save money
-User friendly design (all ages can use it!)
-Great customer service 
-Well maintained and updated
Can I create a list for another family member?
Yes, absolutely! One of the most useful features of ChristmasListApp is the ability to create a list for your children to share with family members. You can easily create a list for those kiddos and family members that are not able to set one up on their own!
Can others see the items that are claimed or that I add to their list?
No! We take every precaution to keep the element of surprise alive and well. Any items that are ‘claimed’ or ‘reserved’ will not be shown to the recipient.
Can I add items to a list that I didn’t create?
Yes! You can add gift ideas to lists for others to claim or even for yourself to claim. The recipient will not see these additions and will be surprised on Christmas morning!
Can I track my spending budget?
Yes! You can set a budget per person. Mark items as ‘bought’ and easily enter the price you paid. Our tracker will show you how much you have left to spend!
When should I create my list?
Anytime, and the sooner, the better! As you walk through stores and think “that would be a great Christmas gift” add it to your list so you don’t forget. When you put ideas on your list, others can start their shopping early!
What if I or a family member need help?
No problem! We have chat available through our website and can also be contacted at info@christmaslistapp.com. We will respond promptly to your questions or concerns. 
About us!!
We are a husband and wife team and the creators of ChristmasListApp. In 2012, we decided we needed a better way to share our gift lists with both sides of the family, so we started the ChristmasListApp website. It was originally just for our family and close friends, but started to grow organically. Our user base has exploded over the last couple of years and it has been super exciting! We are happy that we can now offer our users mobile apps. We continue to roll out new, trend setting features which is why this will be the best year yet for ChristmasListApp. It is very important to us that everyone has a great experience with the website and our mobile apps. So, if there is anything we can do for you, please ask! Best wishes for a wonderful holiday season!

Yes! You can add gift ideas to lists for others to claim or even for yourself to claim. The recipient will not see these additions and will be surprised on Christmas morning!

Can I track my spending budget?
Yes! You can set a budget per person. Mark items as ‘bought’ and easily enter the price you paid. Our tracker will show you how much you have left to spend!

When should I create my list?
Anytime, and the sooner, the better! As you walk through stores and think “that would be a great Christmas gift” add it to your list so you don’t forget. When you put ideas on your list, others can start their shopping early!

What if I or a family member need help?
No problem! We have chat available through our website and can also be contacted at info@christmaslistapp.com. We will respond promptly to your questions or concerns. 


About us!!
We are a husband and wife team and the creators of ChristmasListApp. In 2012, we decided we needed a better way to share our gift lists with both sides of the family, so we started the ChristmasListApp website. It was originally just for our family and close friends, but started to grow organically. Our user base has exploded over the last couple of years and it has been super exciting! We are happy that we can now offer our users mobile apps. We continue to roll out new, trend setting features which is why this will be the best year yet for ChristmasListApp. It is very important to us that everyone has a great experience with the website and our mobile apps. So, if there is anything we can do for you, please ask! Best wishes for a wonderful holiday season!

bluejetty:00072877:ios.summary:
Words Chain Reaction brings you the ultimate word-linking puzzle experience with SIX addictive game modes, daily challenges, timed competitions, wordle chain, and seasonal events!
Connect common everyday words to complete chains, sharpen yo
bluejetty:00072877:ios.description:
Words Chain Reaction brings you the ultimate word-linking puzzle experience with SIX addictive game modes, daily challenges, timed competitions, wordle chain, and seasonal events!
Connect common everyday words to complete chains, sharpen your vocabulary, and challenge your brain in this uniquely satisfying puzzle adventure. From relaxed Classic mode to intense Chain Rush battles - there's a perfect challenge waiting for you!
SIX GAME MODES TO MASTER
CLASSIC MODE
Take your time linking 6-word chains with 3 lives per puzzle. Resume anytime with auto-save - perfect for strategic thinkers who love solving at their own pace! 250+ puzzles and growing!
DAILY CHALLENGE - Fresh Puzzles Every Day
New word chains daily with exclusive rewards! Build your streak, collect bonus coins, and prove you're the daily champion. Never miss a day!
DRAG CHAIN - NEW 67 Method Challenge
Complete 6 puzzles every day for 7 days straight! Master all 42 puzzles to unlock massive bonus rewards: 500 coins + 50 gems per day completed. Drag letters from the shuffled pool to fill each word - addictive new mechanics!
CHAIN RUSH - Beat the Clock
Race against time to link as many word chains as possible! Fast-paced 4-word puzzles test your speed and vocabulary. Compete for the highest score on global leaderboards!
WORDLE CHAIN - Color-Coded Challenge
Revolutionary mashup of Wordle and word chains! Get green, yellow, and grey feedback as you guess the connecting words. Limited attempts make every guess count!
EVENT CHAIN CONNECT - Seasonal Campaigns
Play exclusive 17-level seasonal events like Christmas, Halloween, New Year and Easter, and more. Drag-and-drop letter mechanics bring fresh gameplay twists with every celebration!
Watch out for seasonal notifications.
GAME FEATURES
SMART HINT SYSTEM
Letter Hints - Reveal individual letters when stuck
Synonym Clues - Get contextual word definitions
Keyboard Reveals - Eliminate wrong letters (Wordle Chain)
Purchase or watch ads for more help
DUAL REWARD SYSTEM
Earn coins for puzzle completion
Collect gems for achievements and streaks
Daily bonuses keep rewards flowing
Special event rewards during campaigns
Complete daily goals for bonus rewards
ACHIEVEMENTS & LEADERBOARDS
Track your best scores across all modes
Compete globally in Chain Rush rankings
Unlock 18 achievements for milestones (10, 20, 50, 100+ completions)
PREMIUM UPGRADES AVAILABLE
Unlimited Hints packages
Coin & Gem bundles for power players
Special limited-time offers
Remove Ads for distraction-free gameplay
HOW TO PLAY
You're given the FIRST and LAST words in a 6-word chain. Your mission? Find the 4 connecting words that link them together!
Each word connects with the one before and after it to form compound words or common phrases. It's simple to learn but deliciously challenging to master!
Gameplay Tips:
Start with the second or fifth word - your choice!
Think of everyday compound words and phrases
Use hints strategically - they're precious in Rush mode!
Classic Mode: Watch your 3 lives carefully
Daily Challenge: Complete it early for maximum rewards
Drag Chain: Complete all 6 daily puzzles for big bonuses
Chain Rush: Speed is everything - think fast!
Wordle Chain: Use color feedback to narrow down options
Event Chain: Drag letters from the pool to fill words
SUPPORT & FEEDBACK
We constantly add:
New seasonal event campaigns
Fresh daily puzzles
Additional puzzles to all modes
Quality of life improvements
Performance optimizations
Love the game? Rate us 5 stars!
Need help? Contact our support team - we respond to every message!

bluejetty:00133503:ios.description:
Access state of the art physical therapy and injury prevention workouts online in the comforts of your own home or gym! [P]rehab is a team of world renown Doctors of Physical Therapy & Certified Strength Coaches dedicated to helping you take control of your health with exercise & education from the palm of your hand.
The Prehab app is the anti-barrier solution to keeping your body healthy. Prehab programs & workouts are safe & effective; they feature preventative rehabilitation exercises & education that teach you how to get out of pain, avoid injury, and optimize your health.
GET OUT OF PAIN WITH DIGITAL PHYSICAL THERAPY
 • Avoid common problems associated with going through the traditional healthcare system
 • Save an average of $2,800 with easy-to-access exercise & education material compared to your average costs of in-person healthcare services for a similar duration.
PREVENT INJURIES AND OPTIMIZE YOUR BODY WITH DOCTORS YOU CAN TRUST
 • Learn how to exercise properly to get out of pain, avoid future injuries and maximize your performance & health.
 • Easy to digest physical therapy education videos & resources to learn about your body
TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR HEALTH ANYWHERE AT ANYTIME
 • Zero wait times, no hidden fees, no barriers to entry!
 • Remember, these programs are available to you at your fingertips from 
 anywhere in the world
KEY FEATURES
1) 55+ Programs - Unlimited access built on principles of load management, specificity, progressive overload, muscle group ratios, and many more scientific principles
2) 100+ Classes - Follow along class style videos led by a Doctor of Physical Therapy or a Strength Coach
3) 130+ unique workouts - Mobility, warm up, strength, performance & more!
4) 4000+ Exercise Video Library - Search through detailed step-by-step instructional videos that teach you how to move properly, perform, what to feel, and which mistakes to avoid.
5) BodyScan - Find your perfect program with the help of our intake BodyScan built to pinpoint exact solution for your needs.
6) Custom Workout Builder - Build your own custom workouts & save your favorite exercises/routines
7) Programming that fits you - Choose from rehab, prehab, mobility, performance, and fitness programs
8) Alternate Exercises - every exercise can be swapped to an alternative exercise if its too challenging
9) Growing Library - New exercises, programs, workouts and guides added regularly so you always have fresh content to consume.

bluejetty:00082489:ios.summary:
La Presse est un média d’information qui regroupe la plus grande salle de rédaction francophone indépendante en Amérique du Nord et dont la mission est d’offrir une information de qualité, gratuite et accessible pour tous. 
La Presse+ est
bluejetty:00082489:ios.description:
La Presse est un média d’information qui regroupe la plus grande salle de rédaction francophone indépendante en Amérique du Nord et dont la mission est d’offrir une information de qualité, gratuite et accessible pour tous. 
La Presse+ est une application gratuite pour tablette qui propose chaque jour une édition préparée avec attention par son équipe éditoriale, pour vous offrir le contenu le plus pertinent de la journée dans une expérience immersive et unique. 
L’application est également disponible sur Mac avec puce Apple. 
POURQUOI TÉLÉCHARGER LA PRESSE+?
Au-delà de l’actualité, La Presse+ vous offre des contenus variés, tous les jours. 
Des affaires aux arts, en passant par l’environnement, les grands sujets de société, les finances personnelles, les sports et l’automobile, il y en a pour tous les goûts dans l'application La Presse+ pour tablette! 
Découvrez des idées pour vos vacances, vos menus de la semaine, vos sorties au resto et votre propriété, en plus de nos entrevues, nos critiques, nos suggestions de sorties et nos photoreportages à couper le souffle. 
Retrouvez notre couverture riche et diversifiée de l’actualité dans La Presse+ et découvrez ce qui en fait une application incontournable et coup de cœur pour ses utilisateurs. 
LES SECTIONS COMPRENDRE, DIALOGUE ET CONTEXTE
Vous avez perdu le fil de l’actualité dans le brouhaha du quotidien? Chaque lundi, le rendez-vous Comprendre vous propose une sélection de contenus en rappel qui vous permettent d'y voir plus clair sur des sujets qui ont retenu notre attention. 
Du lundi au vendredi, retrouvez dans La Presse+ notre section conçue pour discuter, s’ouvrir à l’autre et donner du sens à notre monde. Dialogue se matérialise dans l’esprit d’un souper entre amis au cours duquel tous les enjeux de l’heure font l’objet de discussions animées. Et vous êtes tous conviés à table! 
Chaque dimanche, la section magazine Contexte décortique l’actualité et donne carte blanche à ses collaborateurs dans des rubriques divertissantes. 
UNE EXPÉRIENCE IMMERSIVE ENGAGEANTE ET UNIQUE
Des contenus diversifiés, approfondis et étoffés grâce aux photos, aux vidéos, aux graphiques, aux images interactives, aux dossiers à onglets et plus encore. 
LES JEUX QUOTIDIENS
Retrouvez chaque jour trois grilles de mots croisés, trois sudokus et deux grilles du jeu Le mot pour convenir à tous les niveaux dans la section Jeux, météo, etc. 
LISEZ LES HORS-SÉRIES
Les hors-séries de La Presse+ sont des numéros spéciaux et des contenus thématiques accessibles en tout temps tout à fait gratuitement. Accédez-y dans la vitrine d’accueil. 
DÉCOUVREZ LES FONCTIONNALITÉS DE L'APPLICATION : 
ACTIVEZ LES NOTIFICATIONS
Recevez les grands titres du jour et les alertes de dernière heure directement sur votre tablette. 
PERSONNALISEZ VOTRE LECTURE
Augmentez la taille des caractères, activez le mode nuit ou le défilement automatique pour une lecture plus confortable. 
DES NOUVELLES EN DIRECT
Suivez les nouvelles en temps réel grâce au panneau En direct qui vous informe tout au long de la journée. 
SAUVEGARDEZ ET REPRENEZ VOS LECTURES
En mode connecté, vous pouvez enregistrer des articles à partir d’une édition, les retrouver dans la rubrique « Sauvegardes » et reprendre la lecture d’une édition là où vous l’aviez laissée. 
ACCÉDEZ AUX ÉDITIONS ANTÉRIEURES
Replongez dans les éditions passées en quelques gestes simples. 
La Presse+ vous suit partout 
Une fois votre édition téléchargée, vous pouvez la consulter où que vous soyez, même dans une zone sans accès internet.

La Presse+ est une application gratuite pour tablette qui propose chaque jour une édition préparée avec attention par son équipe éditoriale, pour vous offrir le contenu le plus pertinent de la journée dans une expérience immersive et unique. 

L’application est également disponible sur Mac avec puce Apple. 


 
POURQUOI TÉLÉCHARGER LA PRESSE+?
Au-delà de l’actualité, La Presse+ vous offre des contenus variés, tous les jours.  

Des affaires aux arts, en passant par l’environnement, les grands sujets de société, les finances personnelles, les sports et l’automobile, il y en a pour tous les goûts dans l'application La Presse+ pour tablette!  

Découvrez des idées pour vos vacances, vos menus de la semaine, vos sorties au resto et votre propriété, en plus de nos entrevues, nos critiques, nos suggestions de sorties et nos photoreportages à couper le souffle. 

Retrouvez notre couverture riche et diversifiée de l’actualité dans La Presse+ et découvrez ce qui en fait une application incontournable et coup de cœur pour ses utilisateurs. 


LES SECTIONS COMPRENDRE, DIALOGUE ET CONTEXTE
Vous avez perdu le fil de l’actualité dans le brouhaha du quotidien? Chaque lundi, le rendez-vous Comprendre vous propose une sélection de contenus en rappel qui vous permettent d'y voir plus clair sur des sujets qui ont retenu notre attention. 

Du lundi au vendredi, retrouvez dans La Presse+ notre section conçue pour discuter, s’ouvrir à l’autre et donner du sens à notre monde. Dialogue se matérialise dans l’esprit d’un souper entre amis au cours duquel tous les enjeux de l’heure font l’objet de discussions animées. Et vous êtes tous conviés à table!   

Chaque dimanche, la section magazine Contexte décortique l’actualité et donne carte blanche à ses collaborateurs dans des rubriques divertissantes.  


UNE EXPÉRIENCE IMMERSIVE ENGAGEANTE ET UNIQUE
Des contenus diversifiés, approfondis et étoffés grâce aux photos, aux vidéos, aux graphiques, aux images interactives, aux dossiers à onglets et plus encore. 


LES JEUX QUOTIDIENS
Retrouvez chaque jour trois grilles de mots croisés, trois sudokus et deux grilles du jeu Le mot pour convenir à tous les niveaux dans la section Jeux, météo, etc. 


LISEZ LES HORS-SÉRIES
Les hors-séries de La Presse+ sont des numéros spéciaux et des contenus thématiques accessibles en tout temps tout à fait gratuitement. Accédez-y dans la vitrine d’accueil. 

 

DÉCOUVREZ LES FONCTIONNALITÉS DE L'APPLICATION : 

ACTIVEZ LES NOTIFICATIONS
Recevez les grands titres du jour et les alertes de dernière heure directement sur votre tablette. 

PERSONNALISEZ VOTRE LECTURE
Augmentez la taille des caractères, activez le mode nuit ou le défilement automatique pour une lecture plus confortable. 

DES NOUVELLES EN DIRECT
Suivez les nouvelles en temps réel grâce au panneau En direct qui vous informe tout au long de la journée. 

SAUVEGARDEZ ET REPRENEZ VOS LECTURES
En mode connecté, vous pouvez enregistrer des articles à partir d’une édition, les retrouver dans la rubrique « Sauvegardes » et reprendre la lecture d’une édition là où vous l’aviez laissée. 

ACCÉDEZ AUX ÉDITIONS ANTÉRIEURES
Replongez dans les éditions passées en quelques gestes simples. 



La Presse+ vous suit partout 

Une fois votre édition téléchargée, vous pouvez la consulter où que vous soyez, même dans une zone sans accès internet.

bluejetty:00156798:ios.name: AI Video Eraser: Remove Object
bluejetty:00156798:ios.summary: Video Eraser (AI Video Eraser: Remove Object) is an AI-powered iPhone and iPad app that removes people, objects, logos, text and other unwanted elements from videos. Mark what you want gone, and the AI reconstructs the background behind it
bluejetty:00156798:ios.description:
Video Eraser (AI Video Eraser: Remove Object) is an AI-powered iPhone and iPad app that removes people, objects, logos, text and other unwanted elements from videos. Mark what you want gone, and the AI reconstructs the background behind it – no video editing skills required.
REMOVE OR COVER: CHOOSE YOUR WORKFLOW
• Remove people and moving objects with Dynamic Tracking.
• Mark stationary text, logos or distractions with Fixed Area. Moving text and changing subtitles may need extra edits.
• Edit with Prompt: describe the change you want and choose the model suited to your clip.
• Video Editor: combine mosaic, crop, filters and adjustments on your device. Save directly to Photos without using credits. Mosaic covers the marked area; it does not reconstruct the background.
• Pinch to zoom and pan with two fingers for more precise marking. Trim your clip and preview the result before saving.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Import a video and select the part you need.
2. Choose an AI tool to remove or edit content, or open Video Editor for local edits.
3. For AI processing, check the credit cost before starting. Review the result before saving.
BEFORE PROCESSING
Works on iPhone and iPad with iOS 18 or later. Clip duration, supported input and output resolution depend on the selected mode and model; check the current limits in the app. AI removal and prompt editing require an internet connection. Processing time and results vary; complex scenes can retain visible artifacts. Keep your original video and inspect the edited areas before sharing.
DOWNLOAD AND CREDITS
Free to download. Cloud AI removal and prompt editing use credits; check the cost shown in the app before starting. Editing and saving in Video Editor do not use credits. Plans and credit packs are available in the app. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled in your App Store settings.
Support: feedback@globalpixelstudio.com
PRIVACY
Videos are processed securely and automatically deleted from our servers within 1 hour. We never use your videos for anything else.
=== IMPORTANT ===
Video Eraser is intended for personal content or footage you have permission to edit. Removing copyrighted graphics or logos without authorization may violate the law. The developer is not responsible for misuse.
Terms: https://docs.qq.com/doc/DWGxoWUhYRWVaWUZm
Privacy: https://docs.qq.com/doc/DWHpKbVVzVFVTREdL

* 3 different themes
* VLC player
* Rapid streaming
* Easy access
* Simple interface
* Movie poster plus movie trailer
* Information and poster support in movies and series
* Language selection in movies and series
* Language selection for subtitles in movies and series

- You must provide your playlist link to watch online video streaming
- Incase you dislike any uploaded content or channel, you can modify or hide it later
- Check your internet speed. If you have a poor internet connection, the application might face a lag or disconnects for a while. The App is not responsible for this error in connection but it will definitely serves you with a better view
- Video supported: Supports all video formats like m3u8, ts, rtmp, mms, mmsh, httphost, UDP,etc...
- IBO Player App has no collaboration or affiliation with a third-party provider
- All copyrights are reserved and protected under the holder’s permissions

Join Thailand’s most trusted on-demand wellness platform, with 50,000+ satisfied customers.

Every RLAX professional is fully certified, undergoes a background check, and completes a rigorous onboarding process to ensure a 5-star wellness experience.

1. Choose Your Service – Select your preferred service and time through our app.
2. Confirm Your Booking – Receive instant confirmation and get ready to relax.

* Office Syndrome Relief
* Body Scrub & Nourishing Facial…and more!
Nails

Real-time monitoring
The APP provides a more user-friendly reading format, making it easy to quickly identify health conditions.
Share report
Share your health report with your relatives or doctors to enjoy more efficient health management.
Multi-user management
The APP supports health management for multiple users, helping you take care of your family members.
Support Apple Health

AI Flash
-Automatically correct lighting issues in photos taken under low light, backlight, or harsh light conditions.
-Enhance image exposure, contrast, and shadow detail to restore natural and aesthetic visuals.
-Give your photos a retro digicam vibe or polished glow with realistic flash simulation.
Nail Repair
-Fill in chipped or missing nail areas caused by daily wear for a flawless finish.
-Customize nail color and texture for a natural and polished look.
Full-Body Highlight
-Enhance your skin with three natural glow options designed for the body.
-Create a radiant, healthy-looking effect that mimics real light reflection.
-Brighten the full body subtly for a photo-ready finish with a natural shine.
AI Skin Enhancement
-Instantly boost skin radiance and texture with one-tap AI skin glow tools.
-Smooth fine lines, reduce redness, and remove scars, spots, and wrinkles for a high-end retouch finish.
-Achieve a natural-looking tan and explore a range of skin tone shades effortlessly.
AI Photo Editing & Retouching
-Enhance your photos with intelligent brightness, contrast, and clarity adjustments.
-Smooth skin, brighten eyes, and remove blemishes with precise AI retouch tools.
-Apply filters for pictures and effects to transform your edits.
Face Retouch & Reshape
-Perfect your selfies with advanced face retouching tools.
-Reshape face contours and adjust specific features like eyes, lips, and nose.
-Slim your face, refine jawlines, and enhance facial symmetry.
-Achieve a flawless, natural look with AI-powered adjustments.
Makeup & Hairstyle Try-On
-Experiment with a variety of trendy makeup styles and hairstyles.
-Try different hair colors or virtual haircuts with AI precision.
-Explore bold new looks with realistic digital hair dye and color filters.
Body Reshape & Enhancement
-Reshape body curves effortlessly to match your desired proportions.
-Enhance posture and appearance with AI body editor tools.
Collage & Video Maker
-Create professional-quality photo collages with stylish templates.
-Combine your favorite photos into videos with music, transitions, and effects.
-Use the live collage feature to merge images instantly.
AI Capture & Enhancement
-Capture stunning photos and videos with AI-powered tools.
-Enhance image quality instantly with AI photo enhancer features.
Filters, Effects & Presets
-Transform your photos with creative photo filters, effects, and presets.

bluejetty:00144657:ios.summary:
Dividend Tracker is a powerful and easy-to-use app designed for dividend investors. Track your portfolio, monitor dividend changes, forecast future income, and make informed investment decisions with confidence.
An advanced estimation syst
bluejetty:00144657:ios.description:
Dividend Tracker is a powerful and easy-to-use app designed for dividend investors. Track your portfolio, monitor dividend changes, forecast future income, and make informed investment decisions with confidence.
An advanced estimation system projects your future income from your positions, dividend history, taxes, and commissions. Compare it with historical yield data and see your estimated net dividend income up to 10 years ahead.
Dividend Tracker is fully usable for free. You can create multiple portfolios and add up to 1000 positions without a subscription.
Features and Benefits of Dividend Tracker
Dashboard
Set your monthly income goal and track your progress toward financial independence. Monitor dividend growth over time, view projected income, and get insights into your portfolio performance.
Portfolio Tracker
Add transactions with price, date, and commission to your stocks. Instantly see how your portfolio value, dividend yield, and income projections evolve.
Broker Sync (Premium)
Connect supported brokerage accounts and automatically sync your portfolio transactions. Keep your portfolio up to date without manually entering buys, sells, dividends, and other account activity.
Dividend Information
Access detailed dividend data for each stock in your portfolio, including recent dividends, upcoming payments, current yield, historical yield, yield on cost, payout ratio, and other key metrics.
Event Calendar
Follow everything that happens to your positions in one calendar: ex-dividend dates, payments, new dividend declarations, dividend increases and cuts, earnings, and stock splits.
Event Notifications (Premium)
Get notified on the day a position goes ex-dividend, pays its dividend, or splits, with an optional reminder the day before an ex-dividend date. Each event type is turned on separately.
Dividend Reinvestment (DRIP)
Enable DRIP to see how reinvesting your dividends compounds your income over time, with fractional shares and taxes taken into account.
Import and Export
Import your existing portfolio from a CSV file, export your transactions at any time, and keep a local backup of your data.
Performance & Analytics (Premium)
Unlock advanced portfolio performance charts, dividend history charts, payout history charts, valuation metrics, and additional portfolio analytics to better understand your investments.
Simple, Fast and Intuitive
Dividend Tracker is designed for both new and experienced investors: a clear interface focused on what matters most, optimized for smooth navigation and quick access to your data.
Continuous Improvement
We continuously enhance the app and add new features. Premium subscribers get access to all current and future premium features as they are released.
Important Information
Dividend Tracker is not a broker: we do not provide trading services and do not facilitate the buying or selling of securities. The app provides portfolio tracking and dividend analysis tools to support your investment decisions.
Privacy Policy: https://divtracker.net/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://divtracker.net/terms.html

bluejetty:00014301:ios.name: Indeemo: Mobile Ethnography
bluejetty:00014301:ios.summary: Indeemo's Digital Ethnography / Diary Study app and Qualitative Research platform makes it easy for researchers and participants to capture, diary and share in-the-moment experiences and behaviors with researchers and brands in real time.
bluejetty:00014301:ios.description:
Indeemo's Digital Ethnography / Diary Study app and Qualitative Research platform makes it easy for researchers and participants to capture, diary and share in-the-moment experiences and behaviors with researchers and brands in real time. 
Indeemo is being used by researchers and user experience professionals as a supplement to traditional methodologies or as a standalone methodology for the following purposes: 
- Pre-task / post task assignments
- Diary Study research
- Video Diaries
- Mobile Ethnography
- Digital Ethnography
- Product Testing
- Ad / concept testing
- Customer Journeys
- Customer experience (CX) research
- User Experience (UX) research
- Shopper Research
An ideal supplement to traditional research methodologies such as in-depths / IDIs or focus groups, indeemo turns research assignments into a fun and engaging respondent user experience. 
Tasks are assigned to respondents and respondents complete their tasks by uploading in-the-moment videos, photos and notes. Researchers analyse and moderate responses in real-time using the Indeemo Researcher Dashboard. 
Filters and tags allow researchers to organise and code responses. Indeemo enables researchers to capture contextual, spontaneous, in-home and out of home behaviours that yield richer insights. 
Private, one-to-one social media style comments delivered using push notifications turn your research project into a social, engaging and insightful experience that allows researchers to probe and understand the micro moments where brand propositions come to life.
Multimedia responses can be integrated with client presentations to bring research and insights to life. 
Respondents register after being invited by researcher agencies. 
If you are a research agency or brand and would like to get a demo of the app and dashboard, please contact support@indeemo.com for a free demo.

• Keep track of every player’s life total with tasty text and chonky buttons.
• The user interface is designed to be usable from all viewing directions. Just place your iPhone or iPad in the middle of your play surface and you’re good to go. 
• Multiple-touch support. Your whole play group can use it at the same time.
TRACKS COMMANDER DAMAGE
• We know that tracking commander damage is a *huge* pain. With Moxtopper, it couldn’t be easier. At any time a player can swipe horizontally on their play area to see how much commander damage they’ve taken from all the other players’ commanders.
• Commander damage is tracked per *commander*, so it works great with partner commanders, too! 
• If you’re using partner commanders, just swipe down on your play area and press the “Partners” button to toggle partner commander mode on or off.
GREAT FOR EVERY PLAY GROUP
• Moxtopper is optimized to work great not just for 4 player games, but also for any game of 1 to 10 — yes, ten! — players. That means it’s right at home during one-on-one games of Friday Night Magic as well as gigantic Multiplayer Planechase House Rules Banlist Slugfests.
• Configurable with a total of 32 possible seating arrangements so that layout of play areas on the screen always comfortably matches the way your play group likes to sit around the table.

• Customize each player’s area with awesome digital “playmats”, similarly to how you are probably rolling out full art playmats on your game table in real life.

• APP ICONS — Bling out your homescreen with a bunch of alternate app icons.
• SCRYFALL — Scryfall search box integrated into the main options menu.
• MADE BY A FAN — Moxtopper is made by a fan of the game, just one guy (me, the one writing this, howdy) who really really likes artisanal, hand-made, bespoke, fussy, delightful little apps with big dreams. Seriously I appreciate all the support ya’ll send my way.

bluejetty:00137381:ios.description:
Order official New Jerseyand New York lottery tickets right from your mobile device with Lotto.com.
Lotto.com is a secure online lottery service that lets you easily play Mega Millions®, Powerball®, and other great state-offered lottery games – all form one simple app!
With Lotto.com, buying lottery tickets is fast and safe. Just create an account, verifyyour identity and location, choose your lucky numbers (or use Quick Pick), and you’re in the game! We’ll purchase your official ticket at a licensed retail location and upload a digital image of the ticket directly to your account.
Win a prize? We’ve got you covered.
Smaller winnings are deposited straight into your account. Big win? Our Big Winners experience includes secure ticket delivery – either in person or by mail if you prefer a low-key option.
Lotto.com also makes it easy to stay in control with automic ticket subscriptions, win notifications, and built-in responsible gaming tools.
LOTTO.COM MOBILE APP
• Play Mega Millions®, Powerball®, and other state-offered draw games
• Get notified in-app and by email whenever you win
• Buy tickets automatically with our subscription service
• Withdraw winnings easily via online banking
• Play responsibly with our easy-to-use responsible gambling program
PICK YOUR GAME
Choose your lottery game, pick your favorite numbers, or use our Quick Pick tool for a random set of numbers. We will then purchase the ticket on your behalf and upload a digital image of the ticket to your account – so you always know your numbers are safe.
Never miss a draw by enrolling in a subscription.
IMPORTANT - LOCATION REQUIREMENTS
Lotto.com uses the location services on your device to confirm you are physically located in New Jersey or New York, as required by state regulations.
Please ensure location services are enabled on your device while using the app. Visit our support center for step-by-step instructions.
CUSTOMER SUPPORT
Live chat available 7 days a week, 10am-9pm Email us anytime at success@lotto.com
RESPONSIBLE PLAY
Lotto.com is officially a member of the National Council on Problem Gambling (NCPG) and certified for responsible gaming through NCPG's assessment program (iCAP).
If you think you or someone you know needs help, call 1-800-GAMBLER (24/7)

bluejetty:00037182:ios.summary:
Scan anything on paper and turn it into a clean, professional PDF in seconds. Scan Studio is the scanner that lives in your pocket, ready whenever a receipt, contract, or handwritten note needs to become a proper document.
Here is the prob
bluejetty:00037182:ios.description:
Scan anything on paper and turn it into a clean, professional PDF in seconds. Scan Studio is the scanner that lives in your pocket, ready whenever a receipt, contract, or handwritten note needs to become a proper document.
Here is the problem with paper: it gets lost, it fades, and it is never with you when you need it. Scan Studio fixes that. Point your camera at a page and the app finds the edges, straightens the angle, removes shadows, and gives you a sharp scan that looks like it came from an office scanner. Keep snapping and a 20 page contract becomes one tidy PDF, ready to email before you have even left the room.
WHY YOU WILL WANT IT ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
SAVE TIME EVERY DAY
Scanning takes seconds, not minutes. Capture page after page without stopping, so long documents are no longer a chore. Import photos or existing PDFs and work with everything in one place. It works just as well on iPad as on iPhone, so you can scan with whichever device is in your hand.
LOOK PROFESSIONAL
Smart filters powered by machine learning clean up your scans, sharpen the text, and remove artifacts, so the PDF you send to a client or a landlord looks polished. Set page sizes, reorder pages, and export exactly what you want.
ONE APP FOR ALL YOUR PDF JOBS
Stop juggling a different app for every little task. Merge several files into one, split a long PDF into parts, compress a heavy document so it actually sends, add a watermark, or lock sensitive files behind a password. From the moment you point your camera at a page to the moment the finished PDF lands in someone's inbox, everything happens in one place.
KEEP EVERYTHING ORGANIZED AND PRIVATE
Store your documents in folders in the built in library, so the receipt from last March takes seconds to find, not an afternoon. Back everything up privately with iCloud, using your own Apple account and no third party servers. Your documents stay yours, and only you can access them.
WHAT PEOPLE SCAN WITH SCAN STUDIO
Receipts and expenses for tax season. Contracts, agreements, invoices, and bills. ID cards and passports. Homework, lecture notes, and whole textbook chapters. Recipes, warranties, whiteboards after a meeting, and the kids' drawings you cannot bear to throw away. If it fits in front of your camera, it fits in Scan Studio.
EVERYTHING INSIDE
• Fast scanning with automatic edge detection, plus manual crop when you want full control
• Automatic shadow and artifact removal for clean, readable pages
• Color, grayscale, and black and white filters tuned for documents
• Multi page scanning into a single PDF
• Search inside your documents
• Merge, split, and reorganize PDFs
• Compress PDFs to save space and add watermarks
• Password protect sensitive documents
• Convert images to PDF, or PDF pages to images
• Document library with folders to keep everything tidy
• Private iCloud backup and sync across your iPhone and iPad
• Export and share as PDF or JPG, print, or upload to your favorite cloud drive
WHAT USERS SAY
"By far the best scanner app I've come across! And I've downloaded and used a ton of different ones, this one has simple yet effective options and layout. I would highly recommend this to anyone that wants a straight to the point scanner app!" - Bwallis52
"I downloaded this a few days ago as I needed to scan a document. It had 20 pages and I wanted one file. This was so easy to use." - BendedKnee
"Beautiful and fast scanner app, try it and see for yourself." - halabibk
SCAN STUDIO PRO
Go Pro to unlock the full toolkit, including exports, merging, and iCloud Backup and Sync. Subscriptions are easy to manage, and you can cancel any time from the app settings.
HERE TO HELP
Questions or ideas? Support is built right into the app and a real person will get back to you. We read every message.
Download Scan Studio and clear the paper off your desk today.

bluejetty:00073256:ios.description:
Are you keen on various word games and word puzzles? These and much more you will find in our free word game Associations! Once word games were played on paper. People bought crossword magazines and enjoyed playing different word games. Today we made a very fun word puzzle for your phone. Associations is one of the word games that can be enjoyed anywhere - at home, on vacation or in nature, while waiting or before going to bed. Whenever you start to play Association, it's always the right time.
How to play a word association game? The rules of this word puzzle game are not that tricky, yet challenging:
● each game level opens a set of words
● combine words from one group
● build a strategy for completing the level
● find all words from each topic
● words from the same word association can be far apart, pay attention
● complete word puzzle
At first glance it looks like a search word and you really have to search for words sometimes. But the logic of the association game is different. You don't have to guess the word, you search for the right word and complete the association row.
With each level the puzzle game becomes more difficult, there are more word riddles. Switch on logic and ingenuity to win! Playing a fun casual game Association is free, and you will improve your logic skills, enrich vocabulary and have lots of fun.
Our word game helps:
● To improve logical thinking
● To build logical word chains
● To strategize
● To expand words knowledge & vocabulary
● To improve spelling skills
The Associations word puzzle game provides you with a fun way to flex your brain. Use your knowledge, erudition and vocabulary to succeed.
Why you will love Associations:
● multiple game levels to play
● tons of word riddles to solve
● word associations from different topics and areas
Wait no more! Let’s dive into Associations and play this word game for free.

An easy and convenient way to manage your lawn and garden watering.  you need
CUSTOMIZABLE

⋅ Instant Matches: Receive daily match recommendations tailored to you.
⋅ Global Search: Connect and chat with people from around the world.
⋅ Nearby Connections: Easily find and chat with people in your local area.
⋅ Unlimited Likes: Send as many likes as possible to maximize your chances.
⋅ Free Premium Features: Access features like sending direct chats without waiting for a match, with daily limits to prevent misuse.

⋅ Privacy Protection: Your personal information is secure, with easy account deletion and blocking options.
⋅ Photo Verification: Enhance authenticity by verifying your account with a photo pose, helping to limit fake profiles and improve trust.
HOW TO USE MINGLE2?
⋅ Sign Up: Create your profile in just 30 seconds!
⋅ Search Locally or Globally: Find someone special in your area or anywhere in the world.
⋅ Start Chatting: Begin conversations with people you like.
⋅ Filter Preferences: View members that match your criteria.
⋅ Online Users: Chat with online users worldwide.
⋅ Mutual Match: Play and meet someone wonderful.
⋅ Other Features: Explore constantly improving features designed to help you find meaningful relationships, regardless of your location or relationship goals.
SECURITY & PRIVACY
⋅ Scam Fight System: Our advanced system combines automatic tools, human oversight, and AI for 24/7 monitoring and continuous improvement.
⋅ Dating Safety Hub: Safety tips to protect yourself, avoid scams, and safeguard personal information are displayed on every chat screen.
⋅ 24/7 Customer Support: Chat directly with our support team anytime.
⋅ Report Suspicious Profiles: Use the "report" feature for automated and human review.
⋅ Absolutely NO Seeding Profiles: We do not create fake profiles or associate with scammers. Although high-tech scammers may generate fake profiles, we monitor and remove them swiftly, constantly improving our system to combat them.
FREE vs PAID FEATURES
With Mingle2, you can enjoy premium features for free with daily limits to prevent misuse. Send direct chats without needing mutual matches, and utilize features like Rewind and Nudge. Additionally, you can send unlimited likes, maximizing your chances of finding a compatible partner. On the free plan, ads are shown to help fund the product's maintenance and development. You don't need to pay to enhance your search or find a meaningful relationship. However, a paid subscription is available to save you time and add convenience, offering an even smoother experience.

⋅ 12-month subscription: $69.99
Notice:
⋅ Prices are in U.S. dollars, may vary internationally, and are subject to change. Payments will be charged to your iTunes account and automatically renew 24 hours before the current subscription period ends (3/6/12 months). You can turn off auto-renewal through your Apple device or iTunes store. If auto-renewal is turned off, your subscription will expire at the end of the current period.

bluejetty:00180027:ios.description:
As seen in 10% Happier, Atlantic Magazine and The New York Times.
Find happiness by contemplating your mortality with the WeCroak app. Each day, we’ll send you five invitations at randomized times to stop and think about death. It’s based on a Bhutanese folk saying that to be a happy person one must contemplate death five times daily. 
The WeCroak invitations come at random times and at any moment just like death. When they come, you can open the app for a quote about death from a poet, philosopher, or notable thinker. 
You are encouraged to take one moment for contemplation, conscious breathing or meditation when WeCroak notifications arrive. We find that a regular practice of contemplating mortality helps spur needed change, accept what we must, let go of things that don’t matter and honor things that do.
We’ve also added features to make WeCroak work with your modern life. 
• WeCroak only sends notification between 7 AM and 10 PM
• Open the app once per week to keep receiving your five daily WeCroak invitations at randomized times
Join the WeCroak Leap Monthly Subscription to go even deeper with death based mindfulness
• Access WeCroak's Daily Review tool and track what matters most to you each day
• Enjoy more and harder-hitting WeCroak quotes that are only for subscribers
• Receive weekly death mindfulness challenges 
• Make your own Memento Mori images with your photos
Subscription Information:
WeCroak contains an optional, monthly, subscription, called "Leap".
Payment of $1.99 per month will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your App Store account settings after purchase.
For More Information, please visit our (A). Terms of Use and (B). Privacy Policy.
(A). http://www.kkitcreations.com/wecroak-terms-and-conditions/
(B). http://www.kkitcreations.com/wecroak-privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00200007:ios.name: 608 Practice
bluejetty:00200007:ios.summary:
Prepare for your Section 608 certification exam with the most comprehensive study app available. Whether you're going for Type I, Type II, Type III, or Universal certification, 608 Practice has everything you need to pass.
Hundreds of Prac
bluejetty:00200007:ios.description:
Prepare for your Section 608 certification exam with the most comprehensive study app available. Whether you're going for Type I, Type II, Type III, or Universal certification, 608 Practice has everything you need to pass.
Hundreds of Practice Questions Study from a massive question bank covering all four exam sections: Core, Type I, Type II, and Type III. Every question has four answer options and a detailed explanation, just like the real exam. New questions are added regularly.
Pressure-Temperature Chart Questions Practice reading PT charts the way you will on the real exam. An interactive chart covering R-22, R-134a, R-410A, R-404A, and R-32 is built right into the questions. Calculate superheat, subcooling, identify refrigerants, and compare pressures across different refrigerants.
5 Study Modes Per Section
Cram Mode - Read through every question with the correct answer and explanation shown. Absorb the material before testing yourself.
Study - Answer questions at your own pace with instant feedback. Your position is saved so you can pick up where you left off.
Smart Practice - The app tracks what you get wrong and builds focused sessions around your weak spots. 75% of questions come from your weakest areas, 25% from material you haven't seen yet. Questions you master (3 correct in a row) are excluded so you spend time where it matters.
Mock Exam - Simulate the real exam with 25 random questions. 72% required to pass, just like the actual certification test. Review your answers with full explanations after each attempt.
Most Missed - See which questions you get wrong most often, organized by section. As you master questions, they leave the list automatically.
Track Your Progress
Study streak counter to keep you motivated
Per-section readiness scores
Mastery tracking for every question (3 correct answers in a row = mastered)
Best test scores by section
Full history of practice and test results
Study Reminders Set daily or weekly notifications to keep your study habit consistent. Choose your preferred time and frequency.
Works Offline All questions are stored on your device. Study anywhere, anytime, with no internet required. Questions sync automatically in the background when updates are available.
Built for the Real Exam
72% passing score, matching the actual Section 608 exam
25 questions per test, same as the certification
Four answer options per question, just like the real thing
Covers all current regulations including the AIM Act and 2026 rule changes
Privacy First No account required. No personal data collected. All your progress stays on your device.

bluejetty:00026089:ios.summary: - Lunar Calendar and Widget is a highly intuitive and user-friendly iOS app that allows users to track the lunar calendar with ease. The app offers a sleek and minimalistic interface that provides a clutter-free experience and allows users
bluejetty:00026089:ios.description:
- Lunar Calendar and Widget is a highly intuitive and user-friendly iOS app that allows users to track the lunar calendar with ease. The app offers a sleek and minimalistic interface that provides a clutter-free experience and allows users to focus solely on the lunar events and phases. The app offers a variety of views, including a monthly, weekly, and daily view, allowing users to easily view upcoming and past lunar events.
- One of the app's most unique features is its customizable widget that can be added to the user's home screen. The widget displays important lunar information, such as the current lunar phase, upcoming lunar events, and the time of the next full moon, providing users with quick and easy access to this information without having to open the app.
- One more advance feature is reminder of upcoming new moon and full moon phases. This function ensures that users never miss any important lunar event and can plan their activities accordingly. With customizable push notification options, users can set reminders for specific lunar events or choose to receive notifications for all lunar phases
- Lunar Calendar and Widget is an excellent tool for anyone interested in tracking the lunar calendar. The app's intuitive interface, customizable widget, and various customization options make it a valuable resource for anyone who wants to stay up-to-date on the moon's phases and events.

bluejetty:00026670:ios.description:
Meet Forma—your AI-powered PDF editor that lets you fill, sign, scan, and edit documents.
Contracts to sign, forms to fill, files to convert—and no laptop in sight. With Forma, all you need is your phone: edit text, fill out forms, add your signature, scan paper, and convert between formats without disrupting the layout. When a document needs more than editing—a summary, a rewrite, a draft from scratch—the built-in AI assistant will take care of that too.
From the creators of iScanner, trusted by 145M+ users.
With Forma, you get:
• A clean interface that keeps PDF work intuitive.
• A built-in scanner with OCR that turns paper into searchable, editable files.
• An AI assistant that summarizes, catches mistakes, and generates content.
• Secure cloud storage synced across iPhone, iPad, and web.
Here's what that looks like:
EDIT PDFs WITHOUT LOSING THE LAYOUT
Need to update a figure in a proposal or fix a heading before a deadline? Tap any text to edit it—Forma auto-matches fonts so the document looks untouched. You can also highlight sections, add notes, insert images, and split or merge files.
VIBE EDIT PDFs WITH A TEXT OR VOICE PROMPT
Instead of manually editing PDFs, let the app do the work. Tell Vibe Edit what you want to change by typing a message or recording a voice command, and get your updated PDF right away. 
FILL & SIGN FORMS WITHOUT PRINTING
Tax form, lease, job application—complete any form right in the app. With autofill, you can speed through repetitive fields. Draw or type your electronic signature once, save it, and apply it whenever you need. 
TURN PAPER DOCS INTO FILES
Not every document starts digital. Unlike most PDF editors, Forma has a full scanner built in—point your camera at an agreement, a receipt, or a note, and it becomes a clean, searchable PDF with OCR.
CONVERT FILES BETWEEN FORMATS
Client needs your PDF as a Word document? Professor wants the assignment in a different format? Convert seamlessly between PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, and TXT in both directions.
LET AI DO THE HEAVY LIFTING
Long contract before a meeting? Email that needs a different tone? Summarize lengthy documents, rewrite and polish text, or catch grammar and logic mistakes. Plus, generate cover letters, emails, and more with ready-made templates. 
CREATE AND SEND INVOICES ON THE GO
Project done, time to get paid. Add line items, taxes, and terms, then share with a link or export as a PDF—built for freelancers and remote workers who invoice on the go.
BUILD A RESUME THAT STANDS OUT
Enter your details and career goals—the AI handles layout, formatting, and design. Whether you're a student entering the job market or making a career move, the result is a professional CV ready to send in minutes. 
KEEP YOUR FILES SAFE AND SYNCED
Store documents securely in the cloud and access them across every Apple device. Blur confidential information before sharing, add watermarks to protect your work, and lock folders with a PIN for added peace of mind. 
Edit, sign, fill, scan, and convert—Forma is the PDF editor that turns your phone into a document workspace. Download it today.
FAQ
Q: Can I use Forma offline?
A: Yes. Editing, form filling, and signing all work without a connection. Cloud sync and AI features require an internet connection.
Q: Who can see my documents?
A: Only you. Files are encrypted in cloud storage and never shared with third parties.
Q: Can I use Forma on both iPhone and iPad?
A: Yes. Your files sync automatically between devices through secure cloud storage.
Forma PRO
– Subscribe to get Pro access to all features. You will be charged after the purchase confirmation.
– Subscriptions auto-renew 24 hours before the expiration date. You can manage them in your Account Settings on the App Store.
Privacy Policy: http://bpmob.com/forma/privacy/en/ 
Terms of Use: http://bpmob.com/forma/terms/en/ 
For any questions or inquiries about Forma, our PDF reader, contact us at http://bpmob.com/forma/support.

bluejetty:00145311:ios.description: Since 1975, we at Classical Numismatic Group, LLC (CNG) have dedicated ourselves to serving your needs in the fields of ancient, medieval, and British numismatics. We aim to help you build your collection at reasonable prices, to supply the books that enable you to increase your knowledge and understanding, and - when the time comes - to help you sell individual items or your entire collection. When you become a customer of our firm, we hope that it is for the long term. CNG is an international firm with offices in Lancaster, Pennsylvania and London, England. We conduct biweekly Electronic Auctions, as well as several Feature Auctions per year, focusing on Greek, Central Asian, Roman Provincial, Roman Republican, Roman Imperial, Byzantine, Early Medieval, Islamic, World, British, and US coins and medals. With the Classical Numismatic Group app you can preview, watch, and bid in our auctions from your mobile / tablet device. You may participate in our sales while on-the-go, and gain access to the following features:   • Follow upcoming lots  • Set up push notifications to keep you up-to-date on items of interest • Leave absentee bids • Bid live using a simple “swipe to bid” interface  • Track your bidding history and activity  • Watch live auctions • Consign your coins for sale The numismatic hobby sets us apart from the rush and pressures of day-to-day life, so we invite you to sit back, relax, and explore our shared numismatic heritage. We hope you find the time to enjoy our app today.

bluejetty:00147165:ios.description:
Draw like a pro, easily! All you need is your phone, a piece of paper, a pencil, and a spark of creativity to get started!
Turn your phone into a drawing assistant with our AR app! It projects any image onto paper so you can trace it effortlessly. No special equipment is required! Simply place your device on a cup or glass, and you're all set! For even easier sketching, you can turn on the grid and flashlight features.
Explore a library of hundreds of images, neatly organized into categories like Animals, Cars, Nature, Anime, Architecture, Doodles, and more. Each category features drawings of varying complexity to suit artists of all skill levels.
Want to draw something personal? Upload an image from your phone's gallery — any photo, your own digital sketch, or a picture you found online — and bring it to life on paper with our app.
Use the built-in AI tool to generate unique artwork. Just type a description of what you want to see, and the AI will turn your idea into an image you can then draw on paper!
Record your drawing process as a video! It's perfect for sharing your creativity on social media, tracking your progress, or creating art tutorials. You can also make time-lapses and photos.
Whether you're looking to sharpen your drawing skills or simply want to enjoy a relaxing, creative activity, this app makes it easier than ever!

bluejetty:00128926:ios.description:
Welcome to Skip Solitaire! This is a brand new fun-filled, exciting card game in which players use strategies to play out your stock card piles.
GAME RULES:
The deck consists of 162 cards, which comprises of cards with numbers 1 through 12 and WILD cards, which may be played as any number.
Each player is dealt 10 cards for their pile with the top card visible, and a hand of five cards. The remaining cards are placed face down to create a common draw pile. The main play area allows up to four build piles, which must be started using either a ‘1’ card or a ‘WILD’ card.
Each player also has up to four personal discard piles. Each turn the active player draws until they have five cards in hand. They must play either the next card in sequential order or a wild Skip Boss card, using either cards in hand, the top card of their Stock pile, or the top card of any of their four discard piles. If the player can play all five cards from their hand, they draw five more and continue playing. When no more moves are available, the player discards one card to either an empty discard pile or on top of an existing one and play passes to the next player. When a build pile reaches 12, it is removed from the board and that space becomes empty for another pile to be started. The game thus continues until one player has played their final card.
GAME FEATURES:
• Play with no distracting ads.
• Head to head game playing, both players solve the same deck and the player who finishes with the most points wins.
• Large and multiplayer tournaments.
• Win cash and real-life prizes. 
• 100% safe and secure withdrawal via PayPal.
If you have any questions feel free to reach us at dailypuzzle@hotmail.com
If you have any questions about the Skillz® system or cash tournaments please contact: support@skillz.com

bluejetty:00139926:android.description:
The mobile application of the Rosneft gas station retail chain for Android OS 8.1 and higher is a convenient assistant for the motorist that is always at your fingertips. Virtual card of the "Family Team" loyalty program, balance of bonus points, gas station map, information on fuel prices, profitable promotions and special offers, car expenses calculator - all this and much more in our "Rosneft Gas Station" application.
Join the "Family Team" loyalty program:
- Register in the Rosneft gas station mobile application.
- Get a free virtual card for the Family Team loyalty program.
- Accumulate and redeem bonus points using the QR code on your phone screen.
- Track your membership level, bonus points earned, and the amount of points available for redemption.
- Receive a detailed statement of transactions with a loyalty card at Rosneft gas stations and from partners of the Family Team program.
Stay up to date with profitable promotions and special offers:
- Track promotions and special offers in your region.
- Change your region in the “Promotions” section and find out what great deals await you along the way.
- Follow promotions of the Family Team loyalty program and special offers from partners.
The mobile application of the Rosneft gas station retail network is a convenient assistant for the motorist:
- Find the nearest gas stations of the Rosneft network.
- Get directions to the gas station.
- Customize the display of gas stations on the map by type of fuel or additional services.
- Select partners of the "Family Team" loyalty program by category and on the map.
- Add gas stations to your Favorites.
- Systematize the accounting of car expenses. Costs for purchasing fuel at the Rosneft gas station network with a loyalty card will be calculated automatically.
Use user profile tools:
- Manage your registration data.
- Set up to receive notifications and electronic receipts on your phone.
- Ask questions if you need help.
The Rosneft gas station mobile application adapts to the light or dark theme of your device.
Send feedback to hotline@rosneft.ru or contact the 24-hour Customer Support Hotline 8 800 775-75-88. Calls within Russia are free.
Enjoy your use and have a nice journey!

bluejetty:00116620:ios.name: Words of Wonders: Search+
bluejetty:00116620:ios.developer: FUGO BILISIM TEKNOLOJILERI VE YAZILIM TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI
bluejetty:00116620:ios.summary: Welcome to Words of Wonders: Search+ You will go on a journey around the world to explore wonderful cities and discover the hidden secrets of the seven wonders of the world. You will lose track of time and improve your vocabulary while play
bluejetty:00116620:ios.description:
Welcome to Words of Wonders: Search+ You will go on a journey around the world to explore wonderful cities and discover the hidden secrets of the seven wonders of the world. You will lose track of time and improve your vocabulary while playing this (literally!) wonderful crossword puzzle game. As you play this offline crossword game, you will explore the beauty of the English language and improve your puzzle solving skills as you discover the words hidden on the board. Using your intellect, you will be able to combine letters to create words in order to solve the enigmatic puzzles of the crossword genre.
To explore the world of WoW, you will push the boundaries of English to keep on progressing while making use of the various and new hint options when necessary. As boards get larger and it becomes harder to find new words, you will soon realize that you have become much more skilled in such a short time. Your word skills will improve, and your vocabulary will be enriched as you solve puzzles on various and intriguing subjects in each level. You will gain points as a reward for your success, but you will also be able to easily use hints with creative animations for hard-to-find words, and thus solve even the hardest puzzles. The brand new crossword puzzle game WoW: Search+ will help you improve your vocabulary as well as your puzzle solving skills. As fans of previous WoW games know by now, our crossword puzzle games take you on a delightful journey around the world to experience the symbolic landmarks of various countries.
What will be your strategy to find the hidden words? Will you first look for the longer words? Or will you start with the short words, hidden in the depths of the word board? No matter which strategy you choose, you will visit each city in this wonderful word search game! In the meantime, you will also experience the unique blend of modern and popular words together with the rich vocabulary of the English language.
There will be many words that come to your mind based on the subjects of the levels. Let’s see if they match the thousands of words chosen from the most commonly used. How many of the words presented to you by WoW Search are new to you, and how much of them are you well-versed in as a crossword puzzle master? Let your competition with the dictionary begin!
As you think of words for each subject, find the words hidden on the board. Don’t be deceived by the extra letters and use hints to overcome the biggest challenges.

bluejetty:00196265:android.summary: Welcome to the amazing world of Alcana! Play this Match-3 game with unsurpassed graphics and an exciting storyline; restore magical forests and castles; upgrade your fairy-tale creatures and look for ancient artifacts that will help you sol
bluejetty:00196265:android.description:
Welcome to the amazing world of Alcana! Play this Match-3 game with unsurpassed graphics and an exciting storyline; restore magical forests and castles; upgrade your fairy-tale creatures and look for ancient artifacts that will help you solve puzzles!
Your journey will be full of various locations inhabited by fairy-tale creatures and teeming with dangerous mysteries: Enchanted Forest, Burning Lands, Floating Islands, Underwater World, Snow Peaks, Charmed Garden, Forgotten Caves, Other Worlds and many others...
You will be confronted by witches, werewolves, trolls, krakens, dragons... But! Don’t worry! You can strike the right note with everyone, and you can even make friends with them!
A young dragon, a snow yeti, a time keeper and many other characters will take your side, and their help will be indispensable for you while you are completing the game tasks!
Game features:
● Unsurpassed graphics and an exciting story with many twists and turns!
● Unique playable characters, each with their own ability. Young Sparky will help you with his fiery breath, wise Marvin will give you extra moves, and mysterious Forest Spirit will enchant the game field...
● Ability to upgrade characters in exchange for the coins found. The stronger the hero – the more effective their ability!
● Many chapters made in different styles: from the Burning Lands – to the abandoned land of dragons and to the Flying Islands.
● Solve ancient puzzles to find powerful artifacts! Each artifact will provide you with invaluable assistance in completing Match-3 game levels.
● Complete weekly challenges, participate in tournaments, compete with other players in PvP, and discover many other game modes!
Story of Alcana is a free game, but some in-game elements can also be purchased for real money.

bluejetty:00029900:ios.name: Happy Bob
bluejetty:00029900:ios.summary:
Feel better about your diabetes! 
Happy Bob is your personal digital health companion that connects with your continuous glucose monitor and turns your diabetes data into motivating, friendly, and fun experiences — helping you stay in range
bluejetty:00029900:ios.description:
Feel better about your diabetes! 
Happy Bob is your personal digital health companion that connects with your continuous glucose monitor and turns your diabetes data into motivating, friendly, and fun experiences — helping you stay in range while reducing the stress of daily diabetes management.
Designed by people with diabetes, Happy Bob helps you feel like a person, not a patient.
Supported Data Sources
• Dexcom G6, Dexcom G7, and Dexcom ONE+  
 → Real-time glucose updates delivered instantly through Happy Bob. 
• FreeStyle Libre 1, 2, 3, and 3+ (U.S. only)  
 → Data available with a slight delay and intended for wellness purposes only.  When used with Abbott’s Continuous Glucose Monitoring Systems, Happy Bob is intended for non-medical use for wellness purposes only. The information displayed is for reference and you must use your Abbott CGM reader or display device for diabetes management decisions.
Why Happy Bob?
• Glucose tracking made fun: Your values come with humorous, personalized messages that reduce data anxiety.
• Motivating goals: Set a star target and collect stars for every in-range reading.
• Community support: Create a group with your diabuddies, share data, and cheer each other on.
• Apple Health integration: Sync steps and activity for a more complete view of your day.
• Apple Watch compatibility: Check glucose at a glance—plus a smile from Bob.
• Dexcom real-time compatible and supportive of FreeStyle Libre (wellness-only).
New Features
• Monthly Challenges 
Stay motivated with monthly glucose and activity challenges designed to help you build healthy habits one month at a time.
• Happy Mom — Support for Pregnancy & Diabetes
A dedicated experience supporting people who are pregnant or planning pregnancy while managing Type 1, Type 2, or gestational diabetes. Available with Premium Subscription. 
Happy Bob Premium – Try Free for 7 Days!
Free version of Happy Bob can be used to connect to CGMs and view basic glucose data. To unlock the full experience upgrade to Premium version:
•Multiple funny moods — each with a unique character and tone of voice that reacts to your glucose values. (including fan-favorite Snarky Bob)
• In-app glucose & activity statistics
• Dashboard for simplified data insights
What our users are saying:
“Happy Bob helps take the stress out of daily diabetes management.”
“I’ve been a Type 1 diabetic for 35 years—never has trying to keep my blood sugars in range been so much fun!”
“My 9-year-old LOVES Snarky Bob! She loves trying to earn stars.”
“Best thing ever since they invented CGMs.”
“He is always there to remind you of your numbers.”
Who is Happy Bob for?
• People with Type 1, Type 2, Gestational, or Prediabetes
• Caregivers
• Healthcare providers – Supports data sharing between patients and care teams for improved remote engagement.
• Diabetes advocacy organizations
Subscription
Free 7-day trial with Premium subscription. Monthly and yearly plans available. Pricing varies by region. Manage auto-renewal in iTunes Account Settings.
About Happy Bob
Built by people with diabetes, for people with diabetes. Our mission is to support you in feeling like a person—not just a patient—every step of the way.
Note: The data displayed in this app is for informational purposes only and should not be used for medical decisions. FreeStyle Libre data is intended for non-medical wellness use and may be delayed. 
Terms of Use: https://happybob.app/terms-of-use 
Privacy Policy: https://happybob.app/privacy-policy

Join over 30,000 members that trust and rave about UHFCU & sign up today.
AWARDS & ACCOLADES:

WHAT IS QUANTIC?

bluejetty:00061688:ios.description:
WHAT IS QUANTIC?
Quantic is a highly selective, accredited, mobile-first school offering radically affordable degrees in business and technology — built as true alternatives to elite campus programs. From the MBA and Executive MBA to cutting-edge programs in AI and emerging tech, Quantic prepares ambitious professionals for what's next. Download the app to explore free introductory lessons and join a global community of students and alumni accelerating their careers.
WHAT'S DIFFERENT ABOUT QUANTIC?
Forget passive video lectures. Quantic's Active Learning method delivers bite-sized, interactive lessons designed for how people actually learn — fast, engaging, and built for retention. You'll move through complex concepts quickly and actually remember them. Every lesson reinforces ideas with examples, feedback, and real-world context, so you're not just learning — you're developing skills you can apply immediately.
WHAT IS THE QUANTIC COMMUNITY?
Accepted students enter a dynamic social learning environment alongside driven peers from across industries and around the world. Beyond coursework, students connect through events in cities globally, forming a network of business leaders, technologists, and entrepreneurs who are shaping what comes next.
WHAT WILL YOU LEARN WITH QUANTIC?
Quantic's programs span business fundamentals and advanced technology disciplines, with coursework aligned to the world's leading schools. Core business concentrations include Finance, Marketing, Management, and Entrepreneurship. Technology programs go further — covering AI, machine learning, data science, and applied analytics. Lessons are interactive, feedback-driven, and 5–10 minutes each, with topics including:
Reading Financial Statements
Machine Learning & AI Fundamentals
Digital Marketing & Growth Strategy
Statistics & Regression Analysis
Microeconomics & Macroeconomics
Data-Driven Decision Making
Venture Capital & Startup Finance
Mergers & Acquisitions
Supply Chain Management
Equity & Market Valuations
New courses added regularly.
WHO SHOULD DOWNLOAD QUANTIC?
Quantic is for professionals ready to level up — whether you're pivoting careers, moving into leadership, breaking into AI and tech, or building the business acumen to lead in a rapidly changing world.
WHAT ARE PEOPLE SAYING ABOUT QUANTIC?
• "In my 10 years in the education world, Quantic offers the best, most engaging learning experience of anything I've seen." — Michael Horn, Co-Founder, Clayton Christensen Institute
• "Wonderful way of teaching in the best possible way in the least possible time!" — Prerana, Quantic Student
• "The interactive format makes learning so much more interesting and allows for better retention of key concepts. So much better than reading from a textbook!" — Richmond, Quantic Student
• "Love the way the info is divided into digestible chunks. The animations are beautiful, easy, and fun." — Kate, Quantic Student
• "Super interactive — and I love the touch of humor in the cases. It makes everything more fun and interesting." — Valerie, Entrepreneur
• "Excellent on-the-go learning. Exactly the way teaching should be done." — Mohsin, Business Learner
WHAT ARE THE REQUIREMENTS TO USE THE QUANTIC APP?
An internet connection is all you need. A 4G, 5G, or Wi-Fi connection is recommended for the best experience.
