bluejetty:00119645:ios.description:
MISA Money Keeper – Smart expense tracking and budgeting for individuals and families.
Over 5 million people have stopped "guessing" and started mastering their money—with just 30 seconds of daily tracking.
After 10 years of listening to our users, we know the biggest hurdle isn't the lack of tools—it’s the effort of manual entry. That’s why MISA Money Keeper offers Voice Input, AI Invoice Scanning, and Automatic Bank Sync. Whichever you choose, it only takes seconds to keep your finances fully updated.
WHY DO 5 MILLION USERS TRUST MISA MONEY KEEPER?
1. Know where your money goes — Effortlessly
All income and expenses are automatically categorized. Set budgets for each category and get instant alerts before you overspend. Result: On average, our users save an extra $100–$200/month just by visualizing their spending habits.
2. All your finances on one screen
Cash, bank accounts, e-wallets, gold, foreign currencies, savings, and investments—all updated in real-time. Stop switching between 5 different apps to see your total net worth.
3. Family Sharing — Total transparency
Multiple users can log transactions on a single account. Perfect for couples and families to manage shared cash flow, reduce conflict, and increase financial clarity.
4. Never miss a debt or credit card payment
Get smart reminders for upcoming loans, debts, and credit card bills. Say goodbye to late fees and protect your credit score.
5. Understand your finances in 3 seconds
Intuitive visual reports and scientific charts show you spending trends and identify "budget leaks" immediately—no Excel needed.
6. Seamless Data Sync
Your data stays with you across smartphones and tablets (Desktop version coming soon). Log anywhere, view anytime.
7. Trusted by 30 Years of Experience
Developed by MISA JSC—a tech leader with 30 years of expertise and 3,000+ professionals. We provide dedicated customer support you can rely on.
8. A Community of Smart Spenders
Join our community of over 50,000 members to learn smart spending tips, sharing saving hacks, and get support from both users and the MISA team.
SMART UTILITIES TO LIGHTEN YOUR LOAD:
AI Invoice Scanner: Log expenses without typing.
Recurring Transactions: Never miss rent or utility bills.
Smart Reminders: Build a habit without the willpower.
Shopping Lists: Stick to your plan and avoid impulse buys.
Bill Splitter: Easily split group expenses with friends.
Loan Interest Calculator: Know exactly what you're paying.
Excel/PDF Export: Ready-to-use reports whenever you need.
Gold & Currency Rates: Real-time updates within the app.
Personal finance isn't easy—but with just 30 seconds a day, we make it possible.

Fanpage: https://www.facebook.com/sothuchiMISA
Community: https://www.facebook.com/groups/sothuchimisa
Website: https://sothuchi.misa.vn
Email: sothuchi@misa.vn

bluejetty:00066317:ios.description:
New Spades App for beginners and professional players with variations. This game include different exciting spades variations.
Classic Game Mode:
◉ Solo - Whiz - Mirrors - Suicide - Pairs 
Spades Bidding Variations:
◉ Face Off
◉ Aces Up
◉ Homicide
◉ Kiss of Death
◉ Reflection
◉ Copycat
◉ Hang'em
◉ Progression 
◉ Psycho
◉ Chance
◉ Chaos
◉ Succession
About Spades:
Spades is a fun card game for four players, and you can play it either in teams (partnership) or as individuals (cutthroat). The aim is simple: win at least the number of tricks (or "books") you bid before the hand begins.
Spades is part of the Whist family of card games, which also includes popular games like Bridge, Hearts, and Oh Hell. What makes Spades unique is that the trump suit is always spades—no need for bidding or random selection, which is where the game gets its name.

Spades is a fun card game for four players, and you can play it either in teams (partnership) or as individuals (cutthroat). The aim is simple: win at least the number of tricks (or "books") you bid before the hand begins.
Spades is part of the Whist family of card games, which also includes popular games like Bridge, Hearts, and Oh Hell. What makes Spades unique is that the trump suit is always spades—no need for bidding or random selection, which is where the game gets its name.

Wyższe wynagrodzenie? Praca zdalna? Chęć rozwoju? Nowa wizja kariery? Praca dodatkowa, czy potrzeba podjęcia długofalowych, zawodowych wyzwań? 
Powodów do zmiany pracy może
bluejetty:00119475:ios.description:
Szukasz nowej, lepszej pracy? Znajdź ją z aplikacją Pracuj.pl!
Wyższe wynagrodzenie? Praca zdalna? Chęć rozwoju? Nowa wizja kariery? Praca dodatkowa, czy potrzeba podjęcia długofalowych, zawodowych wyzwań? 
Powodów do zmiany pracy może być wiele – i my to rozumiemy!
W aplikacji Pracuj.pl zebraliśmy dla Ciebie tysiące ogłoszeń w Polsce, odpowiadając tym samym na potrzeby zarówno początkujących, jak i doświadczonych ekspertek oraz ekspertów w każdej branży. 
Przeglądaj oferty pracy w dowolnym miejscu i czasie, a następnie wysyłaj aplikacje, które otworzą drzwi do nowych, zawodowych możliwości. Znalezienie nowej pracy jest prostsze, niż myślisz!
Co przygotowała dla Ciebie aplikacja Pracuj.pl? 
- Wygoda. Przejrzysty listing, nowoczesny wygląd, nowy układ filtrów, intuicyjny panel i ekosystem one click apply, który daje możliwość aplikowania jednym kliknięciem. Zmiana pracy może być komfortowa! 
- Obszerna wyszukiwarka ofert. Praca w Warszawie, Wrocławiu, Poznaniu, praca w Łodzi czy praca w Katowicach? Wbudowana „lupka” pozwoli Ci przeglądać oferty pracy w dowolnej branży i mieście. Nie trać więcej czasu na mozolne przeglądanie setek ogłoszeń, które Cię nie interesują i nie pasują do Twoich potrzeb. 
- Strefa ofert pracy tylko dla Ciebie. Spersonalizowana lista ogłoszeń pomoże Ci szybko zareagować i wysłać aplikację do potencjalnego, idealnego pracodawcy.
- Oferty pracy w domu. Marzy Ci się praca tymczasowa lub stała w trybie home office? W apce Pracuj.pl mamy oferty pracy zdalnej, dzięki którym nie tylko rekrutacje, ale także wszystkie obowiązki zrealizujesz z kubkiem kawy, w dresie, bez wychodzenia z domu. 
- Aplikowanie bez CV. W aplikacji Pracuj.pl znajdziesz także ogłoszenia, które nie wymagają CV, a cały proces rekrutacji odbywa się… przez telefon!
- Zapisz swoje CV. Jednym kliknięciem zapisz swoje CV, którym później szybko i łatwo zaaplikujesz na najatrakcyjniejsze oferty. 
- Ulubione oferty pracy. Spokojnie, nie musisz od razu wysyłać swojej aplikacji. Zapisz do „ulubionych” wybrane oferty, a następnie odpowiedz na nie w dowolnej dla siebie chwili. 
- Job Alert. Ustaw alarm w postaci powiadomień, które podpowiedzą Ci o ofertach, idealnie spełniających założone wymagania. Nie pozwól, aby ominęły Cię najlepsze ogłoszenia! 
- Praca dla studenta i/lub początkującego kandydata na rynku pracy. Bez obaw, podjęcie pierwszego zatrudnienia nie musi być trudne! Znajdziesz u nas oferty part-time job lub ogłoszenia niewymagające doświadczenia (np. praca w dowozie) — pamiętaliśmy o wszystkich!
- Dark mode. Bo wiemy, że niektórzy wolą używać aplikacji w ciemnym trybie. Po prostu. 
Praca w IT czy może kreatywne i artystyczne zadania w muzeum? Praca stała i na etat, a może praca przez internet lub dorywcza praca na weekendy? Praca dla kierowcy czy nauczycielki, kelnera, barmanki, mechanika, kosmetyczki, graficzki, fryzjera, pielęgniarza, marketingowca, czy jednak praca dostawcy? A może interesują Cię wszystkie oferty pracy, bo traktujesz je jako inspirację i pomysł na siebie? Bez względu na to, jak widzisz swoją zawodową przyszłość – znajdziesz ją w aplikacji Pracuj.pl. Dla nas praca ma znaczenie! 
Zdradzimy Ci, że to nie wszystko! O pozostałych możliwościach przekonasz się, ściągając aplikację na swój telefon! Pobranie jej nie trwa dłużej niż powiedzenie „Szukam pracy"! 
Podoba Ci się nasza aplikacja? Podziel się z nami swoją opinią.

bluejetty:00200124:ios.name: Tiny Computers
bluejetty:00200124:ios.summary:
A museum of tiny computers. Please touch the exhibits.
Tiny Computers is made for iPhone Duo. Fold your Duo into tabletop mode and it becomes a miniature machine from decades of computing, with the screen above and a working keyboard below
bluejetty:00200124:ios.description:
A museum of tiny computers. Please touch the exhibits.
Tiny Computers is made for iPhone Duo. Fold your Duo into tabletop mode and it becomes a miniature machine from decades of computing, with the screen above and a working keyboard below. Spend a little time with an old favourite — or discover the computer your parents grew up with.
Some computers stay with you long after you stop using them. Now there's room for them on your desk again.
EXPLORE THE COLLECTION
Ten computers are ready to play with, inspired by the Macintosh, Commodore 64, IBM PC, Amiga 500, Windows 95, ThinkPad, iMac G3, iBook G3, PowerBook G4 and Windows XP.
TYPE, DRAW AND PLAY
Enjoy clicking keyboards, working command lines, paint programs, floppy disks and familiar desktop games. Open windows, write a note, draw something small and explore each computer's personality. Hidden files, secret commands and a medal for every computer's game are waiting to be found. Occasionally, even Windows crashes.
MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Tiny Computers was designed around iPhone Duo's two displays. Bend your Duo into tabletop mode to bring each computer to life across the display and keyboard. Browse the collection and choose your next exhibit when your phone is closed.
ALSO ON IPHONE AND IPAD
No Duo? Every computer still works. On iPhone and iPad, Tiny Computers presents each tiny computer with simulated perspective: the same ten computers, keyboards and games. On iPhone, turn sideways and switch between the screen and the keyboard. On iPad, the whole computer fits on your display. For the real tabletop experience, use iPhone Duo.
All ten computers are included. No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

Dive into the ultimate solitaire collection with 250+ Solitaires! Discover an unparalleled world of card games, featuring an astounding 253 unique solitaire games packed into one incredible app. Whether you're a seasoned card player or just starting your patience journey, this is the definitive free solitaire experience you've been searching for.

* Classic Solitaire: Master timeless classics like Freecell, Klondike, Canfield, Golf, Spider, Scorpion, Pyramid, and Tri-Peaks.

* Game Table Backgrounds: Select the perfect backdrop for your game.
* Sound Schemes: Enjoy a personalized audio experience.
Play Anytime, Anywhere – No WiFi Needed!
This incredible solitaire collection offers offline solitaire gameplay, meaning you can dive into your favorite card games whenever and wherever you want, without an internet connection.
Download 250+ Solitaires now and unlock a world of endless solitaire fun!

bluejetty:00129497:ios.description:
Loon is not just another network tool—it's a powerhouse for debugging and optimizing your network connections. With Loon, you're in command, equipped with an array of features to streamline your network troubleshooting experience. Here's what sets Loon apart:
Protocol Support: Loon supports a wide range of protocols including ss, ssr, vmess, trojan, vless, HTTP/S, SOCKS5, hysteria2,Shadow-TLS, and WireGuard. No matter your preferred protocol, Loon has you covered.
Comprehensive Traffic Capture: Capture all HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, and UDP traffic on your device effortlessly and redirect it to your proxy server for thorough analysis and debugging.
Detailed Record-Keeping: Gain insights into your network activity with Loon's ability to record HTTP and HTTPS request and response headers and bodies. With this level of detail, troubleshooting becomes a breeze.
MITM Capabilities: Loon offers Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) functionality over HTTP2 connections, allowing you to intercept and analyze encrypted traffic for deeper debugging insights.
Advanced Routing Options: Take control of your network traffic with Loon's powerful router, which can be configured based on domain, URL, IP, Protocol, Port, and HTTP headers. This granular control ensures that your traffic flows exactly where you need it to go.
Robust Ad-blocking: Loon's ad-blocking capabilities are second to none. Develop custom rules, rewriting, and scripting to effectively block unwanted ads and streamline your browsing experience.
Traffic Usage Monitoring: Stay informed about your data usage with Loon's built-in traffic measurement tools, giving you valuable insights into your network activity.
Cutting-edge DNS Features: Loon boasts full IPv6 support, asynchronous DNS requests, and the ability to query DNS over HTTPS, QUIC, and HTTP3. Record DNS results and ensure a seamless DNS resolution experience.
Extendable Functionality: Unlock limitless possibilities with Loon's support for using JavaScripts to extend proxy functionality. Customize and tailor Loon to meet your specific needs and preferences.
Experience the next level of network debugging with Loon. Download now and take control of your network connections like never before.

bluejetty:00141983:ios.description:
Pick Me: Your Go-To Randomizer!
Ever been stuck deciding where to eat? Or maybe you need to shuffle your playlist or decide which friend pays the bill tonight? “Pick Me” is here for you!
Standard Features:
 • Lucky Wheel Spin: Great for picking tonight’s movie or deciding the next board game.
 • Shuffle Collections: Freshen up your music playlists or photo slideshows.
 • Draw from a List: Ideal for raffles or choosing the next book to read.
 • Finger Picker: A fun game for groups! Who’s buying the next round of drinks? Let the fingers decide.
 • Grouping & Pairing: Perfect for team projects or double dates.
 • Random Numbers & Coin Flips: Handy for quick decisions or bets.
 • Dice Rolling: Roll the dice for games, decisions, or just for fun!
 • Unlimited Lists: Organize and randomize everything!
 • Import & Share: Bring in lists from other apps and share your fun results with friends.
Pro Features:
 • History: Keep track of past picks.
 • Weighted Choices: Increase the odds for your favorite pizza place.
 • Special Grouping Rules: Make sure your two bickering friends aren’t paired for the group project.
 • Tap Mode for Large Groups: Up to 50 players can join the finger-picking fun.
 • Advanced Number Sorting: Ensure no repeats in your number draws.
 • Infinite Pick: Keep the fun going non-stop.
 • Precision Numbers: Need numbers with decimals? We got you.
 • Extended List Sizes: For when you’ve got a LOT to choose from.
 • Realistic Coins: More than 30 coins for authentic coin flips.
 • All DND Dice: Access to all DND dice including D4, D8, D10, D12, and D20.
 • Multiple Dice on Screen: Roll up to 12 dice at once for complex games.
 • Remove Winners: Automatically remove winners after a wheel spin or draw to keep the game fair.
 • No Repeat Option: Ensure previous results aren’t repeated for a fresh experience every time.
 • Custom Wheel and Dice Colors: Personalize your wheels and dice with your favorite colors for a unique look.
Dive into a world of fun and spontaneity with “Pick Me”!
Privacy policy: https://randompick.me/privacy
Terms of use: https://randompick.me/terms

bluejetty:00066284:ios.summary: Skateboard Party is back! This third edition of the popular skateboard sports franchise features professional skater Greg Lutzka. Skateboard Party 3 brings the thrill of skateboarding to your mobile device! Hop on your board, learn new tric
bluejetty:00066284:ios.description:
Skateboard Party is back! This third edition of the popular skateboard sports franchise features professional skater Greg Lutzka. Skateboard Party 3 brings the thrill of skateboarding to your mobile device! Hop on your board, learn new tricks and improve your skills in 8 completely unique locations including skate parks, city streets, and more. 
Complete over 70 level objectives and achievements, gain extreme skateboarding experience and upgrade your favorite skater with the coolest gear. Customize your outfits, shoes, boards, trucks and wheels with licensed skateboarding brands. 
CAREER MODE 
Complete over 70 achievements and level objectives to unlock new items and locations. Gain experience to upgrade your favorite skater’s attributes to perform better tricks and achieve higher scores. 
FREE SKATE 
From ollies and wheelies to 360s and kickflips, practice and improve your skateboarding skills and tricks without any time constraints. 
MASSIVE SELECTION 
Select between 16 skaters and customize each of them to your preference choosing your favorite skateboard gear. A massive collection of outfits, shoes, boards, trucks and wheels are available including items from Osiris, Onnit, Nectar, Jammypack, FKD Bearings and Darkstar. 
LEARN TO SKATE 
There are over 40 unique tricks to master and hundreds of extreme combinations. Follow the new interactive tutorial to get started and progress your tricks as you go. Execute crazy combos and trick sequences to rack up some impressive high scores, gain experience and make a name for yourself. 
GAME CONTROLLER
Compatible with most game controllers available. 
CUSTOMIZABLE CONTROLS 
New fully customizable control system to configure your own button layout. Use the right or left handed control mode, select a control preset or create your own. Use the analog stick or accelerometer option as you wish. Adjust your board’s truck tightness to change your steering sensitivity. 
LOADED WITH FEATURES 
• Supports all the latest generation devices and optimized for high resolution displays.
• New fully customizable control system. You can adjust everything! 
• Learn over 40 unique tricks and create hundreds of extreme combinations. 
• Massive skateboard locations to board including the OC Ramps Skatepark, Venice Beach, Chinatown, San Francisco, Moscow, a Nature Museum, drainage ditch and Medieval Plaza featuring a mega ramp.
• Customize your skater and board with tons of exclusive content including outfits, shoes, boards, trucks and wheels from licensed skateboarding brands. 
• Play often to gain experience and upgrade your skater’s attributes. Complete all level objectives for Greg to reach maximum skateboarding potential. 
• Share your results with your skater friends on Twitter. 
• Extended soundtrack featuring songs from Chaos Delivery Machine, We Outspoken, Voice of Addiction, Templeton Pek, Sink Alaska, Pear, Closer and Melodic in Fusion. 
• Ability to purchase experience points or special items using in-app purchases. 
• Ability to listen to your own songs from your own music library. 
• Game Center support including achievements and online leaderboards.
• Available in the following languages: English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Chinese. 
ABOUT GREG LUTZKA
Originally from the Midwest, Greg moved to Southern California at 18 and became a professional skateboarder. He is known for his technical skills that have won him countless numbers of contests worldwide.
SUPPORT: contact@maplemedia.io

bluejetty:00042636:ios.description:
The Roomba® Home App is compatible with Roomba® 100, 200, 400, 500, 700, 800, and Mini series robots sold after March 2025. For other models, please download the iRobot Home (Classic) app.
Get ready to elevate your cleaning game with the intuitive Roomba® Home app! Easily start, stop, or schedule your robot, adjust cleaning settings, customize detailed maps of your home, and create personalized cleaning routines. Dirty rooms are noted based upon previous cleaning jobs to help you clean more effectively without having to think about it. See where and how your robot is cleaning in real-time, proactive product maintenance, and seamless smart home integrations. From setup to daily use, the Roomba® Home app offers intelligent recommendations and a user-friendly experience to keep your home spotless with minimal effort.
- Easy, Seamless Setup: Easy-to-follow onboarding guides you from unboxing to your first cleaning run with helpful tips along the way.
- Cleaning Routines: Effortlessly create cleaning routines with Routine Builder. Select which rooms to clean, adjust settings, and turn on advanced scrubbing to clean just the way you like.
- Schedules: Easily adjust the days and times your robot cleans so it runs when it’s most convenient for you.
- Cleaning Settings: Choose to vacuum, mop or both, and adjust settings like suction & mopping liquid levels, number of cleaning passes and turn on advanced scrubbing to clean each room just the way you like.
- Maps: Save up to 5 maps, label rooms, add zones and furniture for more targeted cleaning control, and start cleaning specific areas with a click.
- Real-Time Insights: See where and how your robot is cleaning and manage it along the way with real-time controls.
- Voice Control: Hands full? No need to stop what you're doing. Alexa, Siri or Google Assistant-enabled* compatibility allows you to clean with a simple command.
- Robot Maintenance & Health Dashboard: Keep your robot operating smoothly and in tip-top shape with a list of maintenance and troubleshooting suggestions, while the Health Dashboards monitors robot and accessories health.
Note: Roomba® 100 series products require a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi® network. Not compatible with 5GHz Wi-Fi® networks.

bluejetty:00182827:ios.name: King’s Corner
bluejetty:00182827:ios.summary: Move over Solitaire, there's a new king of card games! King’s Corner, or Kings in the Corner, is a great game for all ages—easy to pick up and endlessly entertaining. Play on your own with an AI that’s as challenging as you like: one to thr
bluejetty:00182827:ios.description:
Move over Solitaire, there's a new king of card games! King’s Corner, or Kings in the Corner, is a great game for all ages—easy to pick up and endlessly entertaining. Play on your own with an AI that’s as challenging as you like: one to three opponents can miss moves while you’re still learning and be laser-accurate once you’ve mastered the game. Play with friends online via Game Center or in-person with our pass & play mode that’s all the fun with none of the shuffling and dealing.
King’s Corner 4 is a universal purchase for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS, and has been fully optimized for the latest OS versions. As always, it's fully compatible with VoiceOver so players with limited or no vision are welcome.
Here’s how the game works:
King's Corner uses the same basic rules as games like Solitaire—cards are placed in descending order and in alternating colors. A red 9 can be played on a black 10, or a black ace can be placed on a red 2.
The deck is set up with 8 spaces around the deck; four king spaces (marked with a crown) and four unmarked spaces. You'll get a new card at the beginning of every turn, and the goal of the game is to get rid of your cards first by making as many of the following types of moves as possible:
• Add a card to any existing stack

bluejetty:00032401:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00032401:ios.description:
SURVIVE in a Dinosaur-Infested World
Face off against fearsome dinosaurs in a primeval landscape. Hunt these ancient beasts to gather essential resources like meat and precious metals, which are crucial for your survival and the revival of your tribe.
EMBARK on Quests for Epic Rewards
Take on unique quests from colorful characters across the land. From gathering blue cacti for a parched villager to hunting down dangerous predators, each quest presents new challenges and rewards. Earn tools, gems, and meat to enhance your abilities and gear.
BUILD and EXPAND Your Tribe 
Collect resources and use them to rebuild your tribe’s settlement. Upgrade your equipment and recruit ancient helpers known as "ugabugas". Together, you’ll explore new territories, gather resources, and fortify your defenses against the relentless dangers of the wild.
UNLOCK Ancient Secrets and New Territories
Explore a vast, mysterious world filled with untamed wilderness and hidden treasures. Each new territory you unlock holds secrets and challenges that will test your survival skills and strategic thinking.
UPGRADE and CRAFT Powerful Tools
Enhance your survival capabilities by upgrading your tools and crafting new equipment from the bones and materials you gather. From ancestral knives to stone pickaxes, each tool helps you thrive in this harsh environment.
Immerse Yourself in the Prehistoric World:
• Epic Battles: Hunt and fight dinosaurs, retrieve lost relics, and prove your strength to earn powerful rewards.
• Rich Storylines: Engage with diverse characters and complete their quests to uncover the rich narrative of your tribe's history and future.
• Beautiful Graphics: Experience the prehistoric world in stunning detail, from lush forests to icy wastelands.
Quests Include:
• Thirst for Survival: Gather blue cacti to quench a villager’s thirst and earn a family heirloom knife.
• Madam in Distress: Rescue a bootmaker from serpents and receive gems from her unique collection.
• A Key for a Favor: Help a philosopher find answers with mystical mushrooms and gain a key to your future.
My Little Cave offers a captivating blend of survival, adventure, and community-building. Will you rise to the challenge and reunite your tribe in this dangerous yet wondrous world?
Download My Little Cave now and embark on your prehistoric adventure today!

bluejetty:00087765:ios.summary: Featured in James Nestor’s best-selling book, Breath, Paced Breathing uses visual, audio and haptic cues to guide you through your practice. Whether meditating, strengthening your lungs or simply relaxing - join the thousands who love using
bluejetty:00087765:ios.description:
Featured in James Nestor’s best-selling book, Breath, Paced Breathing uses visual, audio and haptic cues to guide you through your practice. Whether meditating, strengthening your lungs or simply relaxing - join the thousands who love using Paced Breathing everyday!
USES
* Relieve Stress
* Meditate — (especially good for Kundalini, Hatha, Pranayama)
* Strengthen Lungs — (improve lung capacity & aid recovery)
* Falling Asleep
FEATURES
* Adjustable timing for inhale, hold, exhale, & hold
* Heart monitoring: heart rate, HRV, & coherence (PB+)
* Ramp mode: gradually change breath times
* Visual, audio, & vibrate cues
* Reminders / notifications (PB+)
* Background playback
* Playlists for multiple breath presets
* Streaks, goals, & session tracking (PB+)
HEALTH BENEFITS
Regular breathing practices have been shown to help improve your:
* Cardiovascular health [1][2][3]
* Relaxation [2]
* Stress responses [1][4][5]
* Mood [1]
* Attention [4]
* Alzheimer's risk [6] 
FROM THE DEVELOPER
I’m Mihai, an engineer born in Romania & raised in Michigan. My ideal day is working on apps to help others, like Paced Breathing. Someday I hope I can work on apps like these full time! Hearing from users makes my day, so shoot me an email with requests, bugs, things you like, or just your story: mihai@pacedbreathing.com!
USER FEEDBACK
* "The best breathing app out there (I've tried 12 apps, this is the only one that works for me). I have recommended it to over 100 people over the 7 years I've been using it. I use it at least 5 x a week. Gives me instant calm" — R. Hall
* "LOVE this app. Very simple and easy to use. You can set time for inhale, exhale, and pause after each if you wish. You can watch it or listen…Thank you! Ads Not intrusive. Ads turn off when the app is active” — Denise
* "This is a wonderfully simple app. The default sound tone is just right for me and I like that I get to set the volume and it stays there whether or not the volume of the phone ring or other apps are different" — Eleanor
* "I've never written something like this in a review but... I love whoever wrote this app :-) Gets to the point in 0.2 s. No long annoying splash screens. No attempts to extort money... Super reliable, simple and 100% effective. I was looking for something that would let me take some breaks during normal meditation to do some controlled breathing, for example our most natural pattern - continuous 5.5 s inhale, 5.5 exhale. works perfect! BRAVO. A lesson to all developers how to make useful apps!" — Adam
CITATIONS
* [1] Study published in Front Public Health (2017) shows slow rhythmic breathing decreased blood pressure response to stress & improved mood: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC5575449
* [2] Study in PLOS ONE (2019) shows slow paced breathing can improve relaxation & cardiovascular function: https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0218550
* [3] Study in American Journal of Cardiology (2002) shows slow, paced breathing can significantly reduce blood pressure in hypertensive patients: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16129818/
* [4] Study in Frontiers in Psychology (2017) shows diaphragmatic breathing improves attention, reduces negative affect, & lowers stress in healthy adults: https://www.frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/fpsyg.2017.00874/full
* [5] Study in Journal of Alternative and Complementary Medicine (2005) shows benefits of Sudarshan Kriya, a specific yogic breathing practice, in treating stress, anxiety, & depression: https://www.liebertpub.com/doi/10.1089/acm.2005.11.189
* [6] Study in Nature Scientific Reports (2023) shows slow paced breathing counters pathways that lead to Alzheimer’s disease: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-023-30167-0
DISCLAIMER
App not intended to diagnose, treat, prevent medical conditions. Consult a healthcare professional before starting a breathing practice, especially if you have pre-existing health conditions.

bluejetty:00166232:ios.name: Number Paint: Color Puzzle
bluejetty:00166232:ios.summary: Welcome to Number Paint, a unique and visually stunning number-merging puzzle game that combines strategy with creativity. Your mission is to connect numbers in sequential order to unlock hidden artwork beneath the puzzle grid. The challeng
bluejetty:00166232:ios.description:
Welcome to Number Paint, a unique and visually stunning number-merging puzzle game that combines strategy with creativity. Your mission is to connect numbers in sequential order to unlock hidden artwork beneath the puzzle grid. The challenge is to think ahead and plan your path carefully. With every successful connection, you bring the hidden painting closer to life!
In Number Paint, numbers appear randomly on the grid, with empty spaces between them. Your job is to link them in the correct sequence by drawing lines, either adjacently or diagonally. But beware! One wrong connection could stop your progress, so every move must be thought out. Once you connect all the numbers in the correct order, a beautiful hidden image is revealed, rewarding your puzzle-solving skills with a stunning visual payoff.
Whether you're a fan of number puzzles or simply enjoy a creative challenge, Number Paint offers a fresh, exciting twist that will keep you engaged for hours. The fun and visually appealing gameplay makes it a perfect game to enjoy anytime, anywhere.
How to Play Number Paint:
• Link numbers in the correct order: start with 1, find 2, then connect 3, and so on.
• Strategize your path: move adjacent or diagonally between numbers.
• Unlock hidden artwork: complete the number sequence to reveal vibrant paintings.
Key Features:
• Free to Play: Enjoy this captivating puzzle game without any cost.
• Sequential Merging: Strategically link numbers in order to complete the puzzle.
• Reveal Art: Each completed puzzle unveils a hidden painting.
• Offline Mode: Play anywhere, even without an internet connection.
• Visually Stunning: Beautiful artwork is revealed after each successful game.
• No Time Pressure: Relax and solve puzzles at your own pace.
• In-Game Boosters: Enhance your gameplay with powerful boosters.
Challenge yourself to reveal all the hidden paintings in Number Paint! Test your number-connecting skills, relax with the creative visuals, and enjoy the strategic gameplay. Download now and start merging!

bluejetty:00180887:ios.description:
12 YEARS. 1.5 MILLION WORDS. 100% HUMAN-AUTHORED.
Experience the ultimate Fantasy Text RPG! A massive, hand-crafted saga where your choices define your destiny. No "pay-to-choose" gems. No algorithms. Just pure imagination from a lifelong D&D nerd.
Craving an authentic role-playing experience? Step into a world 12 years in the making. From glory-seeking adventurers to parallel-universe conspiracies, this is a deep, branching epic designed for those who love RPGs.
TRUE FANTASY ROLE-PLAYING
* Choose Your Path: Play as a Wizard, Enchantress, Ranger, or Rogue. Each character has a unique personality and goals.
* Stat-Based Consequences: Your choices affect your Life, Mana, Sanity, and Cool. To thrive, you must think like your character, even if their instincts conflict with your own.
* A Massive Campaign: Over 1.5 million words of intricately woven story. It’s like having an entire shelf of epic fantasy novels where you are the protagonist.
* No "Pay-to-Choose": We don't hide the "best" choices behind a paywall. Your success depends on your wits and your strategy, not your wallet.
THE DELIGHT GAMES DIFFERENCE
* 100% Human-Authored: Every twist and every dungeon crawl was written and balanced by a human hand. No AI-generated filler.
* Offline Play: No wifi? No problem. Perfect for long flights or deep dungeons.
* Light & Accessible: A tiny download that’s gentle on your battery, and fully VoiceOver compatible for blind and low-vision players.
TRULY FREE TO PLAY
We believe in the "play well, play for free" model.
* Earn Your Way: Hunt down those achievements, get the high ranks, and choose to watch the rewarded videos as they become available. Not that I don’t appreciate your monetary support and I’m confident that you will find it well worth it, but know that you do not have to.
* The "Luck" System: Use your earned Luck to rewind time and fix fatal mistakes.
* The Premium Option: Want to skip the grind? A one-time purchase unlocks ALL current and future content forever. No ads, no coins, no gates… just the ultimate library.
ABOUT DELIGHT GAMES
If you're new to Delight Games you might say "A text RPG? But I don't like to read." You might even say this in a whiny voice (although we hope not).

bluejetty:00119066:ios.description:
Lead the revolt against a bloodthirsty empire! You grew up under the iron fist of the Hegemony. Now is your chance to end their blood-fueled magic, as you forge a ragtag outlaw band into a rebel army.
"Choice of Rebels: Uprising" is a 637,000 word interactive fantasy novel by Joel Havenstone, where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination. 
As an outlaw rebel in the greenwood wilderness, you must steal to survive your first brutal winter, or watch your people starve if you can't feed them. Win yeomen, helots, merchants, priests, and aristocrats over to the rebel cause...or turn them into your worst enemies. Will you defeat the army of the Hegemony’s Archon and the elite force of evil blood mages sent to destroy you, or will a personal betrayal put an end to your rebellion when it’s just barely begun?
• Play as male or female, gay, straight, or ace.
• Fight as a renegade, aristocrat, or defiant slave
• Lead your outlaw band as a self-taught mage, a general, or a mystic priest 
• Reform the empire’s religion or start your own
• Master the arcane magic of Theurgy and demolish the blood harvesters of the Hegemony
• Find romance amongst your fellow young rebels
• Root out spies, betrayers, and fend off a mutiny
• Survive attacks from assassins, mages, and the mutant Plektoi hounds 
Will you gain a reputation as a compassionate idealist or ruthless insurgent? Can your rebels survive the winter and a vengeful army? 
How much will you sacrifice to rebel, and save your homeland from an oppressive empire?

▶ Explore the essence of the best anime MMORPG game ◀
Adventurer! Your journey across the Maple World begins now in MapleStory M, the iconic gacha fantasy mobile game.
From Henesys and Kerning City to the sky-high Ludibrium—battle through beautiful 2D worlds that combine the nostalgia of classic MMORPGs with the thrill of modern gacha systems. Challenge endless content like Star Force Fields, Mu Lung Dojo, Monster Park, Story Exploration, and Kerning M Tower to grow your hero to greatness in this fun MMORPG game.
________________________________________
▶ Customize your own unique character ◀
Whether you’re a MapleStory veteran or a new MMORPG mobile gamer, this anime RPG lets you stand out. From stylish outfits and fantasy hair dyes to adorable pets—create your story your way.
________________________________________
▶ Stronger together: Multiplayer MMORPG action ◀
Form guilds, go on co-op boss raids, and climb leaderboards in true MMORPG fashion. Whether you're here for anime, fantasy, or social adventure, MapleStory M has it all.
________________________________________
▶ Auto-battle through gacha-rich dungeons—build your strength anytime, anywhere in this anime fantasy world!
▶ Enjoy anime, mobile RPG combat, and deep character growth all in one gacha-friendly MMORPG!
▶ With constant updates and fantasy events, the adventure never ends in MapleStory M!
▶ Download now and rediscover why this anime MMORPG is the best mobile fantasy experience today!

Camera: Taking screenshots to help with customer service inquiries

[Optional Permission]
IDFA: Custom Ad Provision and Service Usage Analysis
Microphone: To record a video clip and enable an in-game voice chat system
[Permission Management]
▶ Settings > Privacy > Select the permission

bluejetty:00121135:ios.name: Cyclop for iPad
bluejetty:00121135:ios.summary:
Cyclop is a monophonic synthesizer. It does one thing very well: delivering cutting-edge digital madness at the low end of the frequency spectrum to unleash monstrous bass sounds to the mobile world.
Cyclop is the master of subs, beautiful
bluejetty:00121135:ios.description:
Cyclop is a monophonic synthesizer. It does one thing very well: delivering cutting-edge digital madness at the low end of the frequency spectrum to unleash monstrous bass sounds to the mobile world.
Cyclop is the master of subs, beautifully controlling even the lowest notes, always sounding stomach-rumblingly thick. It uses mid/side processing to introduce stereo imaging between 250Hz and 4kHz. This ensures wide, interesting sounds that retain their punch and bass. There are no phasing issues, which means Cyclop cuts through the mix very nicely.
Enjoy an incredible depth of sound design possibilities, great real-time control with the Wobble Knob and FX knob. Integrated effects sequencer, vast modulation system and the preset browser will take your inspiration to new levels.
FEATURES AT A GLANCE:
• Audio Unit v3 & Standalone
• Monophonic Bass Synthesizer
• 6x2 Synthesiser Engines, 10x2 Filter Engines
• Analog Sync, FM, Sample Transformer, Spectromat, Saw Regiment, Phase Stressor
• Vowel Filter Mode
• Free Signal Flow for 2 Oscillators, Filters and Distortions.
• Incredibly versatile modulation system
• Multi FX Knob/Sequencer
• Powerful Preset Browser with tagging and rating
• Preset iCloud Sync
• Full MIDI Support (Virtual, Network, External)
• Transformer import: Audiocopy, Audioshare, Music Library
• Ableton Link
DJ Mag: “It is decidedly digital-sounding, but not in a bad way, and as the growing list of fans proves, it can be turned to good use in just about any electronic genre, past, present and (probably) future.”
Rating: 9.5/10
Producer Spot: “Very good for his complexity, very versatile and easy to use if you need sub bass sound for your productions. Sugar Bytes offers High quality and good prices with all their products.”
Rating: 9.5/10
Computer Music: “Anyone will find it powerful and unique-sounding, adding spice to existing tracks and inspiring new ones.”
Rating: 4.5/5.0

bluejetty:00063811:ios.description:
Discover Yourself and Others Through the Power of Numbers
Numerology is a modern guide to the ancient science of Pythagorean numerology. Just enter a name and birth date to reveal deep insights into personality, motivation, destiny, and life’s key turning points.
Whether you’re looking to explore your own life path, check compatibility with a partner, come up with a baby name, or entertain at a party, Numerology makes it easy and fun to decode the numbers that shape our lives.
-----
Key Features:
 • Complete Numerology Chart — Includes life path, destiny, soul urge, expression, and personal year numbers
 • Choose Your Reading Style — Readings available in multiple styles: original, energetic pop culture, new age guru, and random.
 • See Compatibility — Check relationship harmony for romance, friendship, or business
 • Forecast the Future — Get daily, monthly, and yearly readings (subscription unlocks future dates)
 • Forecast Notifications — Get daily personal number alerts so you never miss your numerological rhythm
 • Show Number Widget - Show any number for a profile right on the home screen
 • Share Reports — Send full readings to others via email or text, or other iOS Share option.
 • Create Multiple Profiles — Great for friends, family, clients, or love interests
 • App Intents - Add and Open profiles and open readings with Siri and Shortcuts
 • Spotlight Support - Find profiles and app intents with Spotlight search
 • Import Contacts — Add profiles instantly from your address book (subscription required)
-----
Trusted by Tens of Thousands Since 2008
Numerology has helped people around the world gain insight into themselves and others. Whether you’re a professional numerologist or just curious, you’ll find it powerful, easy to use, and surprisingly accurate.
----
Your Support Means Everything
I’m Rod, a solo developer who’s been building Numerology with care since 2008. If you enjoy the app, a 5-star rating or short review in the App Store helps immensely. Thank you! 
--

bluejetty:00069636:ios.summary:
Looking for a chocolate cake? Here’s your brownie! 
It’s not only a delicious dessert, but also a way to name a house-elf in England! 
Leave a saucer with milk for a brownie, and your house will always be full of love, peace and coziness.
bluejetty:00069636:ios.description:
Looking for a chocolate cake? Here’s your brownie! 
It’s not only a delicious dessert, but also a way to name a house-elf in England! 
Leave a saucer with milk for a brownie, and your house will always be full of love, peace and coziness.
Legends are forgotten, magic leaves our world, but there’s still one mysterious village, where Brownies live in every house. The small elves perform various chores in big people’s houses, but now they are desperately in need of help. The Queen is kidnapped, the Princess is bewitched, and the female brownies disappeared in the whole Brownieland. The King and all the magic land citizens are at a loss. They need a hero! 
Meet Rusty, an ordinary brownie, not a hero, but he’s madly in love with the princess, so he’s ready to give his life for her. The Evil Sorcerer’s Army stands against him: trolls, goblins and snakes. Even pumpkins are dangerous in this world. No time to think. Evil is awake and spreads all over… 
Heroism and glory are good things, but one soldier does not make a battle. Rusty calls his friends from the people’s world! The Smiths are real superheroes for brownies as only sky is the limit for them! Mum, dad, Ellie and Peter are rushing to help again!
Guide to Brownieland: 
- The world of brownies exists! Our ordinary things are gigantic in Brownieland!
- There’s no house without an owner: all the 10 houses are inhabited by a unique people.
- A brownie doesn’t mean an old hairy creature in a hood and a mantle. Northland brownies, nomad brownies, aborigine brownies, farmer-brownies, sage brownies and many more will come your way..
- Evil is awake: Hubrithink, the sorcerer, tears the fabric of the world, summoning trolls, goblins and the mischievous Spectres to help him.
- New vermin attacks : you banished raccoons, spiders and crows in the previous part of the game. But what will you do now? This time you’ll have to deal with goblins and snakes that can be banished only by knights, runes are useless in his case! 
- Brownieland transport system is destroyed: collect magical artifacts and open portals between houses.
- Bring the good and light back: disenchant black statues – make it easier for you to play and the brownies to live.
- Restore the magic land: mend bridges and towers, build mills and sandcastles, put out fires, rescue cows. Brownieland will thank you!
- Get more than 100 medals as a reward: your persistence and industriousness will bring you crystals. 
- Strategy and speed are the key to success: every level is unique and well-thought-out, it will challenge your speed and strategic thinking. 
- Fascinating music and amazing graphics create an exclusive atmosphere of good old England.
Play together with your family. Follow the development of the fairy tale’s plot. All efforts of Rusty and the Smiths are in vain without you!
We are using Apple Terms of Use (EULA) https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

10 minutes, une chaise et votre téléphone suffisent pour vous initier à la méditation gratuitement avec l'application Mind. La pratique de la méditation peut être une aide en cas de stress, d'anxiété, d'insomnie ou de manque de concentration.
L'application Mind vous accompagne dans votre découverte de la méditation. À vos côtés chaque jour pour vous aider à prendre quelques minutes pour méditer et entraîner votre esprit à être pleinement présent.
CONTENU :
Mind vous donne accès à des centaines de séances et podcasts de 10, 20, 30 minutes, conçus par les meilleurs enseignants pour vous apprendre à méditer :

- Des programmes pour les enfants conçus par Eline Snel, auteure du best seller Calme et attentif comme une grenouille.
- Chaque jour à 8h, une méditation Live guidée par un instructeur Mind.
- Des programmes thématiques pour pratiquer la méditation sur des sujets concrets : développement personnel, authenticité, confiance, bonheur, créativité…
- Des séances courtes à écouter en cas de besoin. La méditation peut vous aider à mieux dormir, à réduire votre stress, à gagner en sérénité, à être plus relaxé.e
- Un timer pour effectuer des méditations en silence.
- Des podcasts avec des personnalités inspirantes.
- Des masterclass vidéo
- Des rappels quotidiens pour vous aider à pratiquer la méditation chaque jour.
- Un accès à vos statistiques de méditation pour suivre votre progression.
Mind vous offre également la possibilité de suivre votre évolution sur l'appli Santé d'Apple.

bluejetty:00095235:ios.description:
————■ Game Introduction □————
This is a short surreal psychological horror visual novel, and you are the protagonist.
One day, a mysterious girl suddenly appears in your room...
【Your task is simple】
· Say hello to the girl~
· Respond to "the girl's existence" through hundreds of choices.
· Explore the essence of "being" and uncover the truth of the "world."
【And your mission is even simpler】
· Say hello to the girl~
· As the king, listen to the advice of your subjects—especially your "loyal ministers."
· Bake a strawberry cake, eat the cake, eat the cake—will you really let her eat the cake?
· Stop FONTAINEBLEAU’s plot! Don’t hand over the time machine!
· Travel to the Silvery Forest, defeat the Demon Lord, and fulfill the Dreamer’s mission.
· Go on a date with the girl at the end of the world.
· Take a few pills and have a heart-to-heart chat with them.
· Witness your ending with the girl.
————■ Character Introduction □————
【Lilith】
There’s no such thing as a character introduction here.
Rather than define myself with labels, I’d prefer we come to understand each other through shared memories and experiences.
You exist because you are you. I exist because I am me. And so, here we are, meeting in this very moment...
Of course, how you interpret these words—how you perceive me... isn’t that already my “self-introduction”?
【Sartre】
· Small in stature, always smiling.
· A mandrake researcher with a deep love for writing visual novel scripts.
【Fouco】
· Tall, quiet, and reserved.
· Rhythm game master but also ↑↑↓↓←→←→BA qwq!
————■ Final Words □————
Of course, perhaps none of that is what truly matters.
What does matter is...
I hope you enjoy our time together.

bluejetty:00157267:ios.description:
PDK Access by ProdataKey – Mobile Access Control Made Simple
The PDK Access app transforms your phone into a secure mobile credential, replacing the need for physical cards or key fobs. Instantly send or receive a credential for your property via email. Whether you’re an employee, administrator, or ProdataKey (PDK) installation partner, powerful access control is always at your fingertips.
For Employees or End Users
Unlock doors with Bluetooth credentials by simply moving your phone near a reader. Or, tap a button in the app to unlock a door. Invites arrive by email, or add your email address in the app to retrieve an existing credential. Your organization chooses which unlocking methods are available for your property.
For Administrators
Manage your PDK system from anywhere, anytime. Grant or revoke access, add schedules to lock doors, view reports, and get instant alerts—no need to be at your desk to be in control of building access. Save time and cut costs by emailing digital credentials to any employee or user.
For Integrators & Technicians
Streamline installations, configuration, and service calls. Leave your laptop in the truck—install a PDK system from start to finish on your phone with the same, complete PDK.io look, feel, and feature set. With everything in your pocket, you can manage and troubleshoot customer issues remotely—anytime, anywhere.
Secure. Flexible. Mobile. PDK Access by ProdataKey puts you in complete control of your physical security.
Note: PDK access control solutions are provided exclusively through our network of trained, certified installation partners. For security reasons, all end-user support is handled by these partners, not PDK. If you need assistance, contact your on-site security team or property manager—they’ll work directly with a PDK partner to resolve any issues at your location.

If you're tired of card games dressed up as casinos, you've found your medieval tavern.
Play online with thousands of players worldwide, team up with friends, or enjoy a quiet solo game against AI opponents that actually play like real people. No casino noise. No slot machine gimmicks. Just Euchre.
Why Players Keep Coming Back:
A Mature Community: Moderated and friendly -- sportsmanship comes first
Play Anywhere: Smart AI opponents for solo play anytime, no internet required

Immersive Experience: Stunning environments and high-quality audio

• Sevens Up

bluejetty:00174710:ios.description:
Welcome to Bricks Royale-Brick Balls Game! Helping the king decorate his castle. An exciting Brick Balls Game adventure is calling you! 
If you like classic bricks breaking games, don't miss Bricks Royale-Brick Balls Game!
In order to save the king and princess, you need to break the bricks in a variety of different levels. In this fun journey, you will solve exciting puzzles, earn coins to unlock new areas, decorate the royale castle, and get extra boosters to continue your saga.
Jump into the bricks breaking adventure and play now! We've got plenty of sweet puzzle levels to enjoy. Each new episode comes with free coins, helpful boosters, amazing prizes, challenging tasks and exciting areas.
Bricks Royale-Brick Balls Game is a very innovative 3D bricks balls game. In this bricks games, you can crush all the bricks. Bricks Royale is not only a casual game, but also a brain exercise game. Crushing all the bricks may not help you pass the levels. You need to focus on the level goal and solve all the puzzles and crush all the blocks that prevent you from reaching your goal. Detonating big bombs can help you complete levels quickly.
Bricks Royale is a free Bricks Breaker games of 2023 with unique gameplay and storyline. In this 2023 new puzzle Bricks games, you will not only experience excellent Bricks puzzle levels, you will also enjoy fun mini games. Unique fun Bricks puzzles will be continuously added to this free game. This Bricks puzzle game is designed to get you away from getting bored! Besides, regular update is guaranteed in this new bricks games of 2023. Bricks Royale is ready to offer you an unforgettable experience. Try this 2023 free puzzle Bricks game now!
Introduction to Classic mode:
►By touch, control the direction of the ball launch and it will fly towards your target bricks.
►Move your finger around the screen to find the best position and angle to hit each brick.
►The mission needs to be completed by breaking bricks.
►After launching the ball and hitting the bricks, the bricks will all move down one frame.
►Never let the bricks move to the bottom.
Introduction to rescue mode:
►In a tense and exciting rescue theme, the character is trapped in the middle of dangerous bricks and you have to break the bricks to help him escape.
►Don't worry and be afraid because we have a lot of props that will help you get over the obstacles and break the bricks to get through the difficult levels.
►You can try to use different shooting techniques and strategies to break the bricks as soon as possible to help the character get out of danger.
 Game Features:
- ►Unlock and blast powerful boosters!
- ►Explore new rooms, royal rock parties, gorgeous gardens and many more exciting areas in the princess's castle!
- ►Decorate the areas, including the princess’s room, kitchen, garden, and many other amazing rooms!
- ►Magical chests are in these exciting areas, with great rewards waiting to be discovered!

"This War of Mine isn’t exactly “fun,” but it’s definitely a game worth
bluejetty:00182539:ios.description:
"If you've not already played this brilliant, heart-wrenching game, then mobile is as good a place as any to let it completely destroy you." - , 9/10, Pocket Gamer UK
"This War of Mine isn’t exactly “fun,” but it’s definitely a game worth playing." , 9/10, 148apps
"I'm really excited to go home and download 11 bit studios' title on my iPad" , Game Informer
In This War Of Mine you do not play as an elite soldier, rather a group of civilians trying to survive in a besieged city; struggling with lack of food, medicine and constant danger from snipers and hostile scavengers. The game provides an experience of war seen from an entirely new angle. 
The pace of This War of Mine is imposed by the day and night cycle. During the day snipers outside stop you from leaving your refuge, so you need to focus on maintaining your hideout: crafting, trading and taking care of your survivors. At night, take one of your civilians on a mission to scavenge through a set of unique locations for items that will help you stay alive. 
Make life-and-death decisions driven by your conscience. Try to protect everybody from your shelter or sacrifice some of them for longer-term survival. During war, there are no good or bad decisions; there is only survival. The sooner you realize that, the better.
This War of Mine: Anniversary Edition
It's been two years since This War of Mine global release and we're still expanding the experience. This new free DLC, created especially for the Anniversary Edition, adds new characters, new locations to explore, and most importantly - a whole new ending, leading to a different outcome to the game. bluejetty:00062695:ios.name: Solve - Graphing Calculator
bluejetty:00062695:ios.summary:
Solve is a calculator like no other! Solve solves expressions as you type and features an innovative memory system to store and recall answers. Simply touch the answer to store it and touch the stored answer to use it in an expression.
Sol
bluejetty:00062695:ios.description:
Solve is a calculator like no other! Solve solves expressions as you type and features an innovative memory system to store and recall answers. Simply touch the answer to store it and touch the stored answer to use it in an expression.
Solve has four tabs that select four different calculators each with its own color. Multiply numbers, calculate a tip and find a square root all without clearing your results! 
Plot graphs with a single touch! Solve plots 2D and 3D functions using the x, y and θ variables. When you use the x, y and θ variables in an equation the answer will say Touch to Plot. Touch this label to graph the equation.
GRAPHING
Plot functions using the x variable. For example, "y=sin(x)" is just entered as "sin(x)".
• cos(x)
• abs(x)
• x^2+2x+6
POLAR GRAPHING
Plot polar equations using the θ variable. For example, "r=2θ" is just entered as "2θ".
• 2θ
• sin(2θ)
3D GRAPHING
Plot 3D functions by using the x and y variables. For example, "z=x+y" is just entered as "x+y".
• cos(x)+sin(y)
• x^2+y^2
PLOT MULTIPLE GRAPHS
Graph multiple functions by separating each equation with a comma. 
• sin(x),cos(x)
• x,x^2,x^3
TIME GRAPHING
The T variable is used to create animated or time plots. 
• cos(x+T)
• sin(x+T)*x
• cos(x+T)+sin(y+T)
USER REVIEWS
Really nice calculator by NeedHim
"Having multiple calculators that you can use your calculations in is really a cool function. Prevents you from having to have a pad and paper to figure out multiple calculations. Also the colors are just incredible."
Simply amazing. by oddgoingson
"I was blown away by this app. When I first tried it and the tutorial came up, my first instinct was to skip past it. Then I started... Blown away. This calculator has everything and more. It is so logical for those who always wondered why calculators are sometimes so archaic. Forget copy and paste. Then I got to the graphing.... A must have period!"
Perfect! by Michael
"I've always hated how calculators didn't save answers. It made working out equations very hard and time consuming. But this app does that, and it does it well! Finally, a calculator app that actually works."
Outstanding calculator -- full featured! by ofloveandhate
"I have been using Solve for a few years now. Prompt updates, excellent controls, and a ton of features make it the best calculator I have used. I love having four separate units which I can use in each other and the plotting is easy as pi."
Great app by biosci
"It does everything I need in a 'fun' way that's intuitive to how I think and operate. I'll take it!"
Great Calculator by Carl E. M.
"This is a great calculator, aesthetically and functionally. Having the answer appear as you enter numbers will be the future of all calculators."
I love this calculator by Alan63134
"I work on a shipping dock and it saves me a lot of time and headache. I can have 4 different calculator in one place. I can see the different weights or counts and know where I am if I have to do a lot of weighing or counting on different pallets. I use it every day. I also use it while shopping and can add the price of my shopping list and calculate what things cost. I love this calculator."
Awesome! by smart-music-fan
"This app is great. It easily graphs functions on the xy plane, and adding T as a variable to make the graph move is so fun. Its 3D graphing capability is great - quick, easy (it sets nice bounds on the z axis so you can see things clearly), and helpful for visualizing my Multivariable Calculus homework."
Fantastic by xTricksterz
"This app is beautiful, I use on my iPad and I'm first to answer most of the problems in class. This app shreds TI's calculator OS."
Awesome!!! by llikeadodachacha
"Does just about everything my TI-84 Plus but quicker and much easier to manipulate the graphs. It loads instantly and the 3D function is awesome for higher level math classes (I'm in Calc 3 now and it's already come in hand!)

bluejetty:00134536:ios.description:
LYSSA: Goddess of Rage - Epic Battle RPG & Strategy Game
Dive into the spellbinding world of LYSSA: Goddess of Rage, an unparalleled blend of the best from action, strategy, and turn-based RPG genres. Crafted with precision, this game amalgamates the thrilling aspects of Massively Online Role-Playing Games (MMORPGs) with the tactical finesse required in strategy games. This is not just another RPG; this is the future of strategic role-playing gaming!
Epic Features:
● Navigate through various battlefields, each dotted with random obstacles. With each arena offering distinct challenges, your strategic skills will be truly tested.
● With hundreds to collect and evolve, each hero boasts unique abilities and epic combat skill combinations. Upgrade them, switch up their equipment, and bask in the awe of their evolved powers.
● While mighty heroes can win battles, wars are won by strategy. With thousands of card combinations at your disposal, the onus is on you to plan, strategize, and outwit your enemy.
● Join hands with players globally to form invincible guilds. Together, decimate opponents and bosses, earn the most sought-after loot, and proudly don the victor's crown.
● Upgrade your Commander's appearance and skills, synergizing them seamlessly with your hero deck.
● Take a break whenever you wish. Try being an AFK Hero in battle arenas. But remember, only the game decides if you can be a victorious AFK player.
Additional Features:
Innovative Battle System: Experience a groundbreaking battle system that's both turn-based and fast-paced. A game where genuine strategy and tactics come to play!
Heroes Galore: From the rugged warriors to mystical mages, choose from dozens of heroes and craft your unbeatable squad.
PVP Battles: Engage in real-time player vs. player battles. From ranked matches, brawls, and arena duels to tournaments and more, the PVP system is brimming with opportunities for glory.
Story Campaign: Embark on a single-player journey filled with intriguing narratives and plot twists. Are you ready for this hero's odyssey?
Turf Wars: In this unique game mode, team up with your guild to dominate territories and claim them as your own. Strategy, collaboration, and might - all are needed in equal measure.
Evolve & Dominate: Enhance your heroes through leveling, binding, or even turning them into legends. The battlefield is waiting for its next legend. Will it be you?
Chests, Rewards & More: From Epic to Legendary chests, there’s always a surprise waiting for you. Gather, evolve, and lead your party to dominate both PVP battles and guild alliances. Become the nemesis everyone fears!
Download LYSSA: Goddess of Rage now and rewrite the rules of RPG gaming!
Note: The game is free to download and play. Some in-game items can be purchased with real money. Please ensure password protection for purchases in your App Store app settings. A stable network connection is essential for an optimal gaming experience.
Facing issues? We’re here to help. Navigate to Settings > Support in-game for assistance.

bluejetty:00082539:ios.description:
Our app offers a comprehensive suite of customizable features designed to enhance your wake-up experience and optimize your time management. Beyond basic alarm settings, you have full control over the app's appearance and functionality. You can personalize the background color to suit your aesthetic preferences, ensuring a visually pleasing interface that aligns with your style.
For further customization, the app allows you to choose your alarm icon, enabling a personalized touch to the way your alarms are presented. Additionally, you can set a unique wake-up mission—a task or challenge you must complete in order to dismiss the alarm. These can range from solving math problems, shaking the device, or completing a puzzle, ensuring you’re fully alert when you wake up.
To further tailor your wake-up experience, the app provides the option to record your own sound. Whether it's your favorite song, a motivational message, or a personalized reminder, you can set a unique sound to wake up to, offering a level of personalization beyond traditional alarm tones.
This combination of visual, functional, and auditory customizations makes our app a versatile tool, designed to meet your specific needs and ensure you start your day on the right foot.

bluejetty:00021090:ios.description:
Designed to fill in for the missing calculator app on the iPad with simplicity and functionality.
This app features the modern design of flat UI of iOS which look like original built-in app. Users can make basic calculation in portrait and handy scientific calculation in landscape.
It provides all scientific functions such as root, power, factorial, exponential, divisions, and logarithm are supported. Including trigonometric functions like sine, cosine, tangent, arch, and more.
Unlock the power of binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal math with Programmer Calculator.
Solve fraction math problem quickly and easily with Fraction Calculator.
Includes international currency conversion and variety of units conversion categories.
Tip calculator to calculate tip percentage for food and drink on the fly.
Save time when use bill splitter, and tip exactly what you mean to, no more, no less.
BASIC/SCIENTIFIC CALCULATOR
• All functions like the original calculator app
• Basic calculation in portrait
• Scientific calculation in landscape
• Manual basic & scientific calculator switching in portrait or landscape orientation
• Access result and do calculation on widget
• Switch between Degrees and Radians calculations
• Make more complex calculations with Memory buttons
• Simply swipe on the digits to delete a single wrong digit
UNIT CONVERTER
• Currency converter with daily updated exchange rates in the universal currency
• Freely convert units from variety of categories
• All catalogs in converter include: Currency, Area, Data, Length, Mass, Velocity, Temperature, Time, Volume, Acceleration, Angle, Current, Energy, Force, Illumination, Inductance, Magnitude, Power, Pressure, Radiation and Torque
FRACTION CALCULATOR
• Built-in fraction calculator to solve fraction math
• Display result in proper fraction, improper fraction or decimal number
PROGRAMMER CALCULATOR
• Multi-base calculations with seamlessly switch between binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal
• Perform arithmetic and logical operations
• Directly view and manipulate the individual bits of the binary number with built-in Bit Editor
TIP CALCULATOR
• Calculate tip of bill on the fly
• Split the bill to share with others
• Simply swipe to round any number of total, tip, or per person
• Built-in share function to easily share the number with others
SIMPLICITY
• View whole calculation equation in calculator
• Check previous calculation with history
• Copy and paste numbers from or into display
• Support split view multitasking
• Support external hardware keyboard input
INTERFACE
• Get new feel of different looks with multiple themes
• Easy one-hand usage with resizable and draggable interface
• Pinch to scale calculator size
• Quick actions by tap and hold calculator area
• Buttons feedback sound to ensure you touch the buttons correctly
NOTES:
• To add widget in iOS 14 or later, scroll to the bottom of the widget list, tap Edit, tap Customize, add Calculator widget, and tap Done.

bluejetty:00165702:ios.description:
YOUR LIFE IS MORE THAN A CAMERA ROLL
Storylines brings your photos, videos, voice notes, journals, and memories together into beautiful audiovisual stories you can relive and share for years to come.
Think of it as a photo album, journal, and vlog, all in one.
Create a Storyline for anything that matters: your family, children, pregnancy, travels, fitness journey, relationships, pets, celebrations, school years, personal projects, and more.
CREATE BEAUTIFUL STORYLINES
A photo captures a moment. A Storyline captures the whole journey.
Bring photos, videos, voice notes, journal entries, milestones, locations, and voiceovers together in a beautiful chronological timeline. Smart tools help you organize your memories as your Storylines grow.
Personalize your Storylines with captions, artwork, filters, stickers, voiceovers, and creative touches that make them uniquely yours.
BUILD STORIES TOGETHER
The best stories aren't always captured by one person.
Invite family, friends, classmates, teammates, and others to contribute their own photos, videos, and moments. Everyone can add their perspective while you stay in control of your Storyline.
CAPTURE THE MOMENTS YOU'D OTHERWISE FORGET
The memories you'll treasure years from now are often the little ones.
Capture thoughts, reflections, voice notes, and everyday moments while they're still fresh, preserving not just what happened, but the stories behind the moments.
ORGANIZE LIFE INTO STORYLINES
Life isn't one endless feed. It's a collection of journeys.
Create Storylines for:
• Family & Children
• Pregnancy
• Travel
• Fitness
• Relationships
• Pets
• Weddings & Celebrations
• School
• Sports
• Personal Growth
• Projects
• And anything else worth remembering
PRIVATE BY DEFAULT. PUBLIC BY CHOICE.
Your memories belong to you.
Keep a Storyline completely private, share it only with the people you choose, or make it public when you want others to discover your journey.
No noisy social feed. No algorithms deciding what you see. You're always in control.
TURN YOUR MEMORIES INTO SOMETHING MORE
Transform your photos and videos into beautiful highlight movies and personalized video greeting cards you can watch and share.
Because life's best moments shouldn't disappear into a camera roll.
Document life's journeys. Differently.
Start your first Storyline today.

bluejetty:00066427:ios.summary:
Water Sort Puzzle is a fun and relaxing water sort puzzle on mobile. Try to sort the watercolor in the glasses until all colors in the same happy glass. A challenging yet relaxing game to exercise your brain!
How to Play Water Sort Puzzle
bluejetty:00066427:ios.description:
Water Sort Puzzle is a fun and relaxing water sort puzzle on mobile. Try to sort the watercolor in the glasses until all colors in the same happy glass. A challenging yet relaxing game to exercise your brain!
How to Play Water Sort Puzzle
- Tap any glass to pour and sort its water color into another.
- You can only pour if both glasses match and there’s space to fill the cup.
- Think carefully before each move - bad planning can create a jam.
- Restart freely if you get stuck.
- Complete the level by finishing the water sort puzzle and making each cup a single color.
Water Sort Puzzle Features
- Addictive water sort gameplay that never gets boring.
- Hundreds of levels with unique designs and rising difficulty.
- Fully playable as a water sort offline color game - play anywhere, anytime.
- Bright, smooth, and relaxing animations.
- Inspired by the fun of happy glass, waterpark sort, and magic sort challenges.
- Simple one-finger tap controls to pour and sort the color.
- Engaging mechanics with water color sort, color fill, and fill the cup challenges.
Designed for fans of puzzle games and sorting games, this colorful logic experience will test your brain while keeping you calm. If you enjoy solving tricky levels, separating colors, and watching every glass fill perfectly, then Water Sort Puzzle is the ultimate game for you.
Your goal is simple yet satisfying: pour and sort the water color into their correct glasses. Each move matters, and every level is a brain teasing puzzle waiting to be solved. This isn’t just a typical puzzle game, it’s a clever water sort puzzle designed for players who love strategy and logic. And because it's a water sort offline color game, you can enjoy it anytime, anywhere.
Why You’ll Love It
What makes Water Sort Puzzle special is its perfect mix of relaxation and brain-teasing fun. It’s more than just a water game - it’s a logical, satisfying, and endlessly replayable challenge. Early levels teach you the basics of water sort, but soon you’ll face advanced water sort puzzles with more glasses, tricky layouts, and complex strategies.
Fans of happy glass will enjoy the smooth pouring physics. Lovers of waterpark sort and magic sort puzzles will appreciate the creative twists. And players searching for a relaxing water sort offline color game will find hours of fun with no internet needed.
Every level feels like solving a colorful riddle. As you sort the color and fill the cup, you’ll sharpen your focus, patience, and problem-solving skills. Whether you call it water sort, water color sort, or simply a fun water sort challenge, this game is made to keep you entertained.
Play It for the Holidays
Water Sort Puzzle is also a perfect holiday friendly game you can enjoy with family and friends. Whether you're relaxing at home, sharing challenges together, or taking cozy breaks during the season, this puzzle feels festive and fun for all ages.
If you're searching for a Christmas game, a free Christmas game, or simply games with Christmas themes to enjoy during the holidays, Water Sort Puzzle offers a warm, relaxing experience that fits the season and even includes delightful touches inspired by Santa Claus and Christmas cheer.
Who Can Play Water Sort Puzzle
This game is perfect for:
- Anyone who enjoys water sort and water sort puzzle games.
- Players looking for the best water sort offline color game.
- Fans of sorting games, water color sort, and magic sort challenges.
- Puzzle lovers who want to fill the cup and master every level.
- Casual players who enjoy happy glass style logic puzzles.
- Families and friends wanting a calm, fun holiday or Christmas game to enjoy together.

bluejetty:00119884:ios.description:
Transform Your Music Journey with Anytune! Discover a new way to learn, practice, and teach music with Anytune™ – the ultimate music practice app. Learn faster, transcribe easier, and play along at your pace to make practice more fun. A complete suite of tools to practice better.
For over a decade, Anytune has been changing the lives of musical artists worldwide. With tons of user-requested features, Anytune gives you unparalleled power over your practice sessions, making it easier than ever to learn new songs, perfect challenging pieces, and enhance your musical skills.
Anytune is perfect for singers, dancers, and musicians of all kinds. Adjust the tempo, choose the perfect pitch, repeat loops, and set marks to master every note.
HEAR IT FROM MUSICIANS
 • “Anytune takes you right to the music, it is a game changer … moves everything out of your way … makes you a much better musician.” - Peter Martin
 • “Anytune is my priceless personal trainer, helping me practice parts, songs, or an entire setlist. It organizes my playlists, slows down tricky sections while remembering detune settings, and with LiveMix I can learn Anything, Anytime, Anywhere.” - Phil Soussan
***** “Great App - Anytune Pro is the most-used app on my iPad. It's the best thing for learning tunes that would be too fast or too out of tune to learn easily. Saves me a lot of time. I love it!”
***** The Best!!! - Worth absolutely every penny. Other similar apps don't come close to the quality of this one! It will slow things down to a crawl without a loss of quality. Looping and pitch adjusting at the touch of a finger. If you're looking for better you won't find it!"
GET STARTED FOR FREE
Download Anytune today and discover why it’s a game-changer for musicians worldwide. The free version is fully functional with options for advanced features.
FREE FEATURES
Discover what makes Anytune the top-rated music practice app:
 • Practice at your pace by easily adjusting tempo without affecting pitch
 • Adjust the pitch of your music to your instrument or transcribe directly into a different key
 • Use marks to break down the song into sections for focussed efficient practice
 • Visualize your song to find the part you want quickly and easily
 • Organize tracks into playlists for efficient practice sessions
 • Record and analyze your performance to correct mistakes before they become habits.
 • Play songs directly from your Apple Music Library or import directly
 • Display lyrics or textual TABs, …
Add serious tools for serious musicians and elevate your music practice: 
PRO FEATURES 
Download Anytune Pro+ or incrementally add only Pro Feature Packs you need through in-app purchases.
BASIC PACK
Removes ads, and adds Custom Skins, in-app Lyric editing and Auto Scrolling, and Autoloop between marks.
PRO PACK
Adds the Audible and Visual Count-In, Step-it-Up Loop Interval Trainer, Transcribe Mode, Gain and Pan Control, and Unlimited Audio Marks.
STUDIO PACK
Adds professional tools including; ReFrame™ Audio Isolation to solo and mute vocals or instruments, Amazing HQ audio quality down to 0.05x, Pitch up or down by 24.0 semi, Pinpoint your instrument in the song with FineTouch™ EQ, Feel as though you’re playing in the band with LiveMix™, Queue up a mark for playback with Play Next, and Fade-In or Fade-Out music when playing or pausing. 
IMPORT PACK 
Import your music from the Files app, Dropbox, WiFi, Paste from AudioCopy and Open-In. 
Need a little more? Additional EXPORT AND "REMOTE CONTROL & WATCH APP" Add-ons available for Anytune Free or Anytune Pro+ 
CONNECT WITH US
See us on YouTube: AnytuneApp
Like us on Facebook: /Anytune
Follow us on X (formallyTwitter) or Instagram: @AnytuneApp
Contact us with your questions and suggestions! 
Anytune is a Universal App. Buy it once for all your iOS devices.
Anytune (Mac) is available separately from the Mac App Store.
Learn new songs and perfect your technique faster and more efficiently.

bluejetty:00014176:ios.summary: The Quran by Abdullah Yusuf Ali is a widely respected English translation completed in 1934, known for its clear, poetic language and detailed commentary. It is one of the first complete translations of the Quran into English, offering expl
bluejetty:00014176:ios.description:
The Quran by Abdullah Yusuf Ali is a widely respected English translation completed in 1934, known for its clear, poetic language and detailed commentary. It is one of the first complete translations of the Quran into English, offering explanations alongside the text to help readers understand historical, theological, and legal contexts.
Yusuf Ali’s Holy Quran translation stands out for its eloquent style, though its complexity can challenge some readers. His extensive footnotes provide valuable insights into the meaning of verses and Islamic teachings, making it both accessible and scholarly.
While praised for making the Quran accessible to English speakers, it has faced some criticism for occasional deviations from the literal Arabic text and for the influence of the translator's personal views in the commentary.
Yusuf Ali’s Holy Quran remains a widely used translation, shaping the understanding of the Quran among English-speaking Muslims.
FEATURES:
DAILY VERSES:
After setting the reminder, you’ll get daily notifications to read your daily Quran verses.
QURAN VIDEOS:
Here you can find many Quran videos available.
NEARBY MOSQUE:
The app provides information about nearby mosques based on your location.
QUOTES:
We have Quran quotes in the form of images and text.
MY LIBRARY:
My library has all the highlighted verses, notes, and bookmarks that you make.
CALENDAR:
Contains all the festival dates.
VERSE GRAPHICS:
Quranic verses with images are available; select and share them with friends and family on social media.
WALLPAPERS:
A wide variety of beautiful wallpapers are available.
