listings.name: 마이리틀셰프 - 요리게임 식당 경영 타이쿤
listings.description:
떡볶이부터 초밥, 피자, 햄버거, 케이크, 스테이크까지! 90개이상의 다양한 테마. 
손님 주문에 맞춰 요리하고 나만의 식당을 키우는 힐링 요리게임, 마이리틀셰프예요.
글로벌 1,000만 명이 즐긴 요리게임에서 작은 가게를 손님이 줄 서는 맛집으로 키워 보세요.

▶ 이런 분께 추천해요
- 요리 게임, 식당 경영 게임, 타이쿤 게임을 좋아하는 분
- 귀여운 캐릭터와 예쁜 인테리어 꾸미기를 좋아하는 분
- 카페, 빵집, 맛집을 하나씩 열며 모으는 재미를 원하는 분

▶ 요리하고, 서빙하고, 키우고
- 몰려오는 손님의 주문에 맞춰 시간 안에 요리를 내고 팁을 받으세요
- 식재료와 조리도구, 인테리어를 업그레이드해 레스토랑을 키워요
- 레스토랑에 어울리는 코스튬을 입으면 쿠킹 스킬이 올라가요
- 친절하고 빠르게 손님을 맞다 보면 단골손님의 비밀 에피소드를 볼 수 있어요

▶ 90개 넘는 세계 레스토랑
- 그릴 하우스, 초밥 하우스, 라멘 하우스, 멕시칸 하우스, 카페, 베이커리 등 세계 각국의 레스토랑
- 한식 하우스, 떡볶이 하우스, 불고기 레스토랑, 냉면 하우스, 김치 하우스까지 한식도 가득
- 600가지 넘는 메뉴와 1,000가지 넘는 식재료
- 실제 레스토랑처럼 재현한 조리 과정과 침이 고이는 음식 그래픽

▶ 늘 새로운 재미
- 업데이트마다 새 레스토랑과 테마, 이벤트가 열려요
- 다양한 브랜드와 함께하는 제휴 이벤트도 놓치지 마세요
- 일반·마스터 모드에 미션을 깨 나가는 쿠킹 월드까지, 다양하게 즐겨요
- 매주 열리는 세계 셰프 대회에서 우승에 도전하세요
- 카카오 계정으로 연동하고 친구들과 실력을 겨뤄 보세요

기본 무료 게임이며, 일부 유료 아이템이 있어요.
지금 마이리틀셰프에서 나만의 식당 경영을 시작하세요!

bluejetty:00070513:ios.description:
معجم المعاني لكلمات القرآن، نسخة كاملة عن  صفحة  ‏معجم المعاني لكلمات القرآن في موقع المعاني http://www.almaany.com/، لمن أراد الحصول على نتائج  سريعة  من دون الحاجة إلى اتصال بالشابكة ( الشبكة العنكبوتية). ربما تحتاج إلى العودة للموقع حيث تكون التحديثات والإضافات هناك أكثر.  ينبني هذا المعجم على تحليل الكلمة القرآنية واستخراج جذع الكلمة وجذرها بعد تجريدها من السوابق واللواحق. فمثلا  كلمة فأسقيناكموه  تحلل إلى  ف + أسقي + نا + كم + و + ه  ،  فالجذع يكون  "أسقي " والجذر سقي.   ونورد هنا معنى "أسقى"  و "سقي" وكذلك معناهما باللغة الأنجليزية لمن يدرس القرآن من غير العرب.  ونورد كذلك كل الكلمات التيي تحمل نفس الجذر.  ونورد تفسير الآية من التفسير الميسر وتفسير الجلالين. لا نورد أكثر من هذا، لأن البرنامج موجه للمتعلمين ومن يريدون 
معرفة المعنى  البسيط بدون تفصيل، وليس لمن يريد الاختصاص والتعمق، فهذا مجاله  الكتب والبرامج المتخصصة.
أولا : للبدء في البحث، اتبع الخطوات التالية
أمامك خياران لاستعمال المعجم
• الخيار الأول
• اختر السورة ثم رقم الآية وبعد ذلك انقر على الكلمة المراد معرفة معناها وتحليلها
• ينقلك البرنامج فورا الى صفحة التحليل، وبامكانك من هناك ان تعود للصفحة الأولى.
• الخيار الثاني
• وضع المؤشر في صندوق البحث
• إدخال الكلمة حرفًا حرفًا
• إثناء الإدخال ستظهر قائمة بالكلمات المتوقعة.
• اختر إحدى هذه الكلمات وستظهر الآيات التي تحتوي على هذه الكلمة او ما يشابهها ممن تحمل نفس الجذر
• انقر على أي كلمة تريد وستنتقل إلى صفحة التحليل كم ذكر سابقا.
ثانيا : تعليمات عامة
• بإمكانك الرجوع إلى التطبيق بالنقر الى زر العودة في جهازك أو إغلاق المتصفح.
• بإمكانك في أي وقت مسح الكلمة من صندوق البحث بالنقر على زر المسح غي مربع البحث  وإدخال كلمة أخرى.
• جميع الكلمات التى بحثت عنها ستخزن في صفحة سجل البحث من القائمة الرئيسة.
• بإمكانك حفظ الكلمة في المفضلة بالنقر على النجمة بجانب  كلمة البحث.
• بأمكانك حذف اي كلمة من المفضلة بتحريكها الى اليمين وعندها  اضغط على صندوق المهملات
• بأمكانك حذف اي كلمة من  السجل بتحريكها الى اليمين وعندها  اضغط على صندوق المهملات، ويمكنك حذف جميع كلمات السجل مرة واحدة بالنقر على أيقونة الفرشاة
لاي استفسارات أو اقتراحات لا تتردد بمراسلتنا على البريد الاكتروني التالي:
mail: info@almaany.com

bluejetty:00099459:ios.description:
This time, we’re continuing the humorous storytelling and brain-teasing design of the first game, bringing you an even richer and more surprising puzzle-solving experience.
In this brand-new sequel, you'll follow quirky plot lines and make clever use of clues and interactive elements to crack a series of bizarre yet cleverly constructed levels.
Each scene is packed with carefully designed puzzles, unconventional logic, and unexpected twists—making you think outside the box and enjoy a perfect mix of reasoning and creativity.
No complex systems needed—just tap, swipe, and explore! It's a fun and accessible brain challenge that anyone can enjoy. And if you get stuck, don’t worry—our trusty “Brain Buddy” will give you playful hints to spark new ideas and help you move forward.
Game Features:
Bigger, Weirder Stories – Absurd scenarios mixed with trending jokes and clever twists, sparking laughs and wild creativity!
Think Differently – These puzzles aren’t what they seem... flip your logic and find the unexpected solution.
Simple, Fun Controls – Tap, drag, and solve. No learning curve—just dive in and play.
Unlimited Hints – Stuck? Get as many helpful hints as you need.
Join us now and challenge the limits of your imagination! Use your creativity and wit to conquer this absurd and delightful puzzle adventure, and feel the thrill of every solution.
This is just the beginning! More levels and crazy stories are on the way—stay tuned!
Contact Email: xiaobuinfo2019@gmail.com
Website: https://www.smallstepinfo.com

bluejetty:00038492:ios.description:
Let your dog stay with a real family while you're away. Find a reliable dog walker to walk your dog while you're at work, or search for a loving pet sitter to visit your home to feed the cats.
Pawshake connects pet parents with thousands of trusted and experienced pet sitters and dog walkers in over 15 countries (and counting), including Australia, UK, Canada, Germany, Italy, New Zealand, Singapore, Hong Kong and many European countries.
To get started, download the app and start your search for the perfect sitter. Contact and meet sitters for free before booking. 
Pawshake for owners:
• Browse five-star-rated pet sitters in your neighbourhood.
• Detailed pet sitter profiles - learn more about them, their experience and qualifications.
• Vetted pet sitters - each sitter profile is manually checked to ensure they meet our high standards.
• Free contact and meet and greets (no subscription fees!).
• Found the perfect match? Book and pay securely straight from your mobile device.
• Read and write reviews to help other pet parents in finding a great sitter.
• Get daily updates from your pet sitter
• All bookings on Pawshake is covered by The Pawshake Guarantee which includes free veterinary coverage.
• For added security, sitters will only get paid after the booking is complete. 
Pawshake for pet sitters:
• Accept or decline bookings on the go.
• Check and manage upcoming reservations.
• Instant notifications and alerts (check out the friendly woof!).
• Fast and reliable messaging system.
• One-click photo sharing and photo update reminders.
• Update your calendar and availability.
• Edit profile, photos and description.
• Easy access to contact information and message history.
Pet parents rely on Pawshake for home dog boarding, dog sitting, doggy day care, dog walking, cat sitting, small animal sitting and house sitting services. Pawshake sitters are experienced pet lovers who will look after your pet just like you would.
Download the app to find a loving sitter or dog walker today.
Learn more about Pawshake by going to Pawshake.com and visit your country website.
© 2026 PAWSHAKE USA LLC

bluejetty:00168054:ios.description:
Discover the Beauty of Flowers with FloralWhisper
FloralWhisper is your gateway to crafting exquisite and personalized flower bouquets right from the comfort of your device. With an extensive selection of wallpaper templates, a rich variety of flower stickers, and innovative new features, your creative ideas can effortlessly blossom into stunning floral backgrounds.
Holiday Special: Celebrate the Christmas season by decorating festive scenes and designing holiday-themed wallpapers to share the joy of the season with friends and family.
New Feature – Nail Filter: Unleash your creativity with our Nail Filter! Explore a variety of nail designs inspired by ""Nail Language,"" allowing you to personalize virtual nails with unique styles and colors. This feature lets you design beautiful, expressive nails to match your floral backgrounds or stand out on their own. Discover nail art that truly speaks your style!
Key Features:
- Home: Immerse yourself in a vast collection of wallpaper templates. Begin your floral journey by choosing a background that resonates with you and start creating your unique bouquets.
- Create Flower Wallpaper: Unleash your creativity with an abundant selection of flower stickers. Design breathtaking bouquets, add delicate ribbons, and select the perfect background to enhance the beauty of your creation. Every design is a canvas waiting to be filled with your imagination.
- Christmas Special: Decorate your screen with festive Christmas wallpapers and designs. From holiday lights to winter-themed floral scenes, add a touch of Christmas magic to your device.
- Nail Filter: Create expressive nail art using the Nail Language feature. Select from an array of nail designs, styles, and colors to craft a look that’s as unique as you are.
- New Themes: Explore delightful new content themes including Teddy Bear Language, Space Language, Cat Language, and Cake Language. These themes add a playful and imaginative touch to your floral creations.
- Camera Feature: Capture moments and incorporate them into your floral designs. The camera feature allows you to take photos and seamlessly integrate them into your bouquets, adding a personal touch to your creations.
- Auto-Align: Simplify your design process with the auto-align feature, which helps you create perfectly balanced bouquets automatically. This tool ensures that your arrangements look professional and aesthetically pleasing.
- Save & Share: Preserve your personalized flower wallpapers by saving them directly to your photo gallery. Share your enchanting creations with friends and family, spreading the joy and beauty of your floral masterpieces.
- Gallery: Conveniently review and manage all your saved wallpapers in one place. Relive your creative moments and find inspiration for new designs.
Turn Your Name into a Floral Masterpiece with FlowerArt: FloralWhisper's distinctive FlowerArt feature allows you to transform your name into a blossoming floral masterpiece. Each letter of your name is represented by a meaningful flower, creating a unique and beautiful representation that lets your name bloom in an extraordinary way.
FloralWhisper invites you to explore a world where your creativity can truly flourish. Download the app today and begin your journey into the captivating realm of flowers. Create, save, and share your floral masterpieces, letting each bouquet tell its own unique story. With FloralWhisper, let your imagination and the timeless beauty of flowers come together in perfect harmony.
▸Check out our privacy policy and terms of use:
Privacy policy: https://volio.store/privacypolicy
Terms of use: https://volio.store/termsofuse

bluejetty:00162335:ios.description:
Hakbah: Social Savings that help & collaborate!
Saudi Arabia's largest savings app just got a whole lot better!
Trusted by over 1.2 million real users across Saudi Arabia, Hakbah offers social saving through monthly financial Jameya in a modern, digital way with a new, AI-powered savings engine.
In this update, we bring you new features, enhanced performance, and unprecedented control to achieve your financial goals faster and smarter. Whether you're saving for a car down payment, a well-deserved vacation, tuition fees, house rent, or simply want to save your money in a way that helps others and earns you savings rewarding in cash back – Hakbah is for you.
Why Hakbah is the Best Choice for Social Saving in Saudi Arabia:
Largest Community: Join the biggest network of savers in Saudi Arabia! Over 1.2 million real users on their social saving journey with Hakbah.
Unmatched Control: We listened to you!
Pay all future monthly payments anytime: Enjoy unprecedented flexibility! You can now pay all upcoming Jameya payments whenever it suits you, putting you in complete control of your payments.
Receive the Jameya amount whenever you want: Your money, your rules! You now have full control over when to transfer your Jameya funds directly to your bank account in your receiving month.
Automated Jameya Withdrawal: Faced an emergency? Or simply changed your mind? You can withdraw from a Jameya automatically, with full transparency.
(Imhal) Service: You can request a grace period for your next payment from within the app and easily pay the fees.
Individual Jameya: You can join an individual Jameya and pay the full amount upfront, enjoying unprecedented savings rewards.
Blazing Fast Performance: Enjoy a smoother, faster, and more responsive app. We've implemented significant improvements and performance enhancements, making your saving journey seamless and enjoyable.
Secure & Transparent: Your financial security is our top priority. Hakbah provides a transparent and secure platform for all your saving needs.
And Much More! We've packed this release with numerous enhancements and features to boost your overall experience.
How Hakbah's Jameya Work:
Join a Jameya: Browse available Jameya every Monday and choose the one that suits you.
Set Your Goal: Define your saving goal and monthly payment amount.
Enjoy: Your Jameya is ready to start. Commit to monthly payments and receive your funds on your specified date.
Download Hakbah today and join the leading savings community in the Kingdom! Save... Be proud.

listings.name: clir: Denoise & Transcribe
listings.description:
Record speech, remove noise and get a searchable transcript.
Works offline. Your audio is never uploaded.

A sound studio in your pocket. Use clir Voice on iPhone and iPad for meetings, lectures, interviews, podcasts, voice notes and video clips. Import call recordings or keep a record of client and patient sessions.

CHOOSE HOW YOUR RECORDING SOUNDS
Plus removes background noise from cafés, traffic, wind and rooms. The voice stays as recorded.

Ultra removes background noise and reverb or echo, then rebuilds the voice with AI for studio mic sound. Use it for echoey halls, distant speakers and audio you want to publish. AI voice reconstruction can occasionally change a word.

Ambience mode does the opposite: remove the voices and keep the background sound.

CLEAN UP WHAT YOU SAID
Remove Fillers takes out the ums and uhs, and Tighten Pauses shortens long silences, from Gentle to Snappy. clir Voice finds them on your iPhone, and you can listen to each one first. Exports keep your edits, for audio and video.

READ AS YOU RECORD
Follow live captions while recording. Get a full transcript with speaker labels so you can see who said what.

Transcription follows the spoken language automatically, even when speakers switch languages mid-recording. Supported languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch and Portuguese.

FIND THE EXACT MOMENT
Search across all your recordings. Tap a word in the search results to jump to that exact second. Add marks while recording or listening to flag a quote, decision or idea.

CLEAN UP VIDEO SOUND
Import a video clip, clean up its sound with Ultra and export the video ready to post. Bring in recordings from Voice Memos, messaging apps, Files or your camera roll.

GET THE KEY POINTS
Generate AI summaries with key points and action items on your device. Requires an Apple Intelligence-compatible device.

RECORD FROM YOUR WRIST
Record on Apple Watch. The recording transfers to your iPhone for transcription and, with Plus or Ultra, audio cleanup.

Your watch can also start, mark and stop a recording on your iPhone and show live captions.

WORK OFFLINE
Noise removal and transcription run on your device. Your audio is never uploaded. Record, clean up and transcribe even in airplane mode.

Record, import and play audio, and preview the enhancements. Plus, Pro and Ultra are subscriptions.

bluejetty:00185283:ios.name: KORG iM1
bluejetty:00185283:ios.summary:
A complete reproduction - and more - of the legendary M1 that defined an era. Mobile Digital Synthesizer for the iPad.
● Selected by Apple as "App Store Best of 2015"
● Ranked #1 on the App Store on Top Paid Music category in more than 20
bluejetty:00185283:ios.description:
A complete reproduction - and more - of the legendary M1 that defined an era. Mobile Digital Synthesizer for the iPad.
● Selected by Apple as "App Store Best of 2015"
● Ranked #1 on the App Store on Top Paid Music category in more than 20 countries! (15/5/27)
Since it went on sale in 1988 the legendary M1 music workstation rapidly achieved record-breaking sales, becoming a mainstay of the music scene from the late 1980s and beyond. The common element of electronic instruments that have left their name in history is that they had a unique sound that was difficult if not impossible to replicate. Sounds such as the “M1 Piano” is instantly recognizable and have appeared on countless hit records over many years, and yet these are sounds that could only be produced by the M1. And that’s what you can now have on your iPad!
● A faithful reproduction of the original M1 Sound
The PCM data provides the library of the original M1. For the hardware, we analyzed the circuit diagram of the original design, and completely replicated it in software down to the last detailed parameters. Engineers with an exhaustive knowledge of the M1 made careful adjustments in order to obtain the sound of the original unit, something that cannot be obtained simply by sampling the original sounds.
● A continued evolution of the M1
Not content with simply reproducing the original, iM1 provides further evolutionary developments. Synth parts now have the Filter Resonance that was requested at the time of the original. The effect parts, originally consisting of only two effects, have been powered-up to 18 effects. The user interface has also been refreshed with additions such as a KAOSS pad. iM1 is the ultimate version of the KORG M1.
● A gigantic library encompassing 3,300 sounds and 34 cards*
In addition to all 19 of the ROM cards originally released for the M1, iM1 also covers the sounds of the M1EX which expanded the internal PCM of the M1, as well as the sounds of the T-series which appeared as an evolution of the M1. There’s also “BEST OF M1”, a selection of 100 great M1 programs. The new “Smart Sound Browser” makes it quick to find the desired sound. You can also view the sounds ranked by how often they are selected by iM1 users around the world.
*with all the expansion card installed via in-app purchase
● KAOSS pad lets anybody perform
iM1 features a KAOSS pad from the popular KAOSSILATOR, allowing you to perform intuitively just by touching the screen. By using the dual KAOSS pads to play phrases or adjust the sound, even people who are not accustomed to keyboard instruments or knowledgeable about synthesizers can enjoy performing the iM1. There’s also a conventional keyboard, as well as the “Smart Keyboard”, which lets you specify a scale setting and play phrases with a single finger.
● Use with KORG Gadget for song production
iM1 can be used together with Gadget, the music production DAW app that won the App Store Best App of 2014 award in Japan. If both apps are installed, you can use iM1 as a sound module within Gadget, taking advantage of the program sounds in iM1 for music production. iM1 also supports Audiobus and Inter-App Audio, so it can also be used for GarageBand etc.
● Connect a MIDI keyboard and use as a sound module
In addition to enjoying iM1 on its own, you can connect a USB MIDI keyboard* via a Lightning adaptor and play the iM1 as an external sound module. You can easily take along an even more powerful workstation sound module as part of your iPad-based compact mobile system.
*microKEY, nanoKEY etc.
● Interchangeable with the KORG Legacy Collection and the original M1
Sounds that you create in iM1 can be sent from your iPad via iTunes to a Mac/PC. If you have the Legacy Collection M1, you can use those sounds in a DAW.
More info at korg.com

bluejetty:00174930:ios.description:
Kill the monsters! Steal the treasure! Stab your buddy!
Go down to the dungeon. Kick in the door. Kill everything you find. Backstab your friends. Steal the treasure and run.
With millions of copies sold around the world, Munchkin is the mega-hit card game about dungeon adventure...with none of that stupid roleplaying stuff. You and your friends compete to kill monsters and grab magic items. Don the Horny Helmet and the Boots of Butt-Kicking. Wield the Staff of Napalm...or maybe the Chainsaw of Bloody Dismemberment. Start by slaughtering the Potted Plant and the Drooling Slime, and work your way up to the Plutonium Dragon!

You're a Munchkin...and Munchkins love treasure! But a stack of pesky monster and Curse cards are between you and your hard-earned loot!
Munchkin is played in a series of rounds using Door cards and Treasure cards to explore a dungeon.
Build a character by combining Race and Class cards, then gear up to face the lurking monsters!
Kill monsters and collect Treasure to level up! The first Munchkin to reach Level 10 wins!
But wait...there's more!
Cross-platform, online multiplayer shenanigans!
Learn the tricks of the adventuring trade in a dungeon-delving tutorial!
Sharpen your blade in Solo Challenges with special rules!
Go looking for trouble in Munchkin. Hey, we're all going to get roasted and eaten sometime.

bluejetty:00185353:ios.description:
Indian Rummy has been one of the favourite traditional games of Indian families. On special occasions and festivals, family members and friends gather together to enjoy a game of rummy cards.
Any get-together is just incomplete till the time a game of Indian Rummy is not played. Be it kids or grownups, every one enjoy this game of cards and find it interesting
Rummy, when first introduced, was associated with the word ‘rum,’ which is a common slang in the UK for ‘odd’ or ‘peculiar.’ This slang highlighted that the card game was unusual or odd.
The objective of the popular game Indian Rummy is to match cards of the same rank or sequence and same suit. In Indian Rummy you have to create melds which consists of sets of three or four of a kind of the same rank, runs, or three or more cards in sequence of the same suit.
The game of Indian rummy is a game that requires mental agility to play as the player has to arrange all the 13 cards into a particular sequence so that he can win the round of game. It requires lot of practice, guessing the cards of player on the other side, reading hands, and to keep in mind in Indian Rummy is that all the cards that have been either thrown or picked from the pile of cards. 
In short, the Indian rummy is game that improves your memory power, changes your mood, and relaxes your mind from giving you a required break from the hectic daily schedule.
To win a hand at Indian Rummy one must require a minimum of two sequences, one of which must be "pure", that is, made without any jokers. The other sequence may contain jokers. 
The other melds can be sets (three or four of a kind).
Indian Rummy, which varies little from the standard Rummy game, is also called as Paplu in some parts of India. 
This Classic Indian card game helps in boosting your memory power, uplifting your mood, gives you a mental break from your hectic schedule and relaxes your mind.
**** Indian Rummy Features ****
1. Online Multiplayer support
2. Watch video to earn coins
3. Completely Free to Play
4. Intuitive, smooth Graphics and Game-play
5. Smart AI with adaptable intelligence
6. Create Private Room and Invite Friends and Family
This Indian Rummy card game is fun and it can give you a memorable experience if you win.
Please don't forget to review Indian Rummy! We would like to know your feedback.
You will never deny the fun and excitement associated with our Indian Rummy. So keep playing, keep winning and keep enjoying Rummy.

bluejetty:00074063:ios.description:
Never miss a birthday again with Birthday Reminder, a simple and elegant app that helps you keep track and view a countdown of upcoming birthdays.
15 REASONS TO USE BIRTHDAY REMINDER
• Easily import birthdays from existing contacts
• View a countdown of upcoming birthdays
• View the name, photo, and age of your contacts at a glance
• Customize the day and time for birthday notifications
• 6 different widgets to choose from
• Keep birthdays in sync across devices
• Add birthdays to your calendar
• A clean and elegant design
• Supports Dark Mode
• Easily export birthdays
• A custom ringtone to alert you of upcoming birthdays • Choose between two different app icons
• Shop for a birthday gift directly from the app
• Highly rated with an average of 4.7 stars
• Stop forgetting your friends and family’s birthdays
Download it now and give it a try, or read on for more details…
REAL REVIEWS FROM REAL USERS
"So many birthdays to keep track of. So nice to organize it in this app, it is amazing and easy!" - by geegeemomma
"I was able to sync all of my contacts to the app; love the layout, love that my pictures from my contacts go with the birthdays, and love that it can sync across devices!" - by Nkala99
"Just what I've been searching for. I'll never miss a birthday again with the notifications and widget. I like that it tells me how old the person will be so I can plan for milestone birthdays. Just perfect." - by kat3748
EASILY ADD BIRTHDAYS
• Automatically import birthdays from your Contacts app
• Manually add birthdays (perfect for adding birthdays for kids and babies in your family that aren’t necessarily in your contacts) 
VIEW AT A GLANCE
• Whose birthday is coming up next
• Their photo
• How old they’re turning
• In how many days 
CUSTOM REMINDERS
• Set default reminders that apply to all your contacts, or
• Customize reminder settings for specific birthdays, or
• Entirely disable reminders for specific contacts
6 HANDY WIDGETS
• See upcoming birthdays on your Lock or Home screens
EXPORT BIRTHDAYS
• Export birthdays to an Excel, CSV, or PDF file
• Add specific birthdays to your Calendar app
BIRTHDAY REMINDER CAN ALSO BE USED FOR
• Anniversaries
• Holidays
• Vacations
• Graduations
• And more…
A CAREFULLY CRAFTED APP
• Very evocative yet elegant app icon
• App name showing below the app icon is simply “Birthdays”
• Clean and easy-to-use interface
• Custom-made ringtone alerts you of birthdays 
• A beautiful Dark Mode version
DESIGNED WITH YOUR PRIVACY IN MIND
• Your privacy is very important to us
• Unlike other similar apps we never ever access your contacts in any way, shape or form
SYNC BIRTHDAYS ACROSS DEVICES (Pro version only)
• Enable iCloud Sync to automatically backup birthday information 
• Easily import birthdays to a new iPhone or iPad
• Keep birthdays in sync across all your devices
BIRTHDAY REMINDER Pro
Upgrade to the Pro version of Birthday Reminder to:
• Remove ads
• Export birthdays
• Enable birthday syncing between your devices
• Support the ongoing development of this app
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will auto-renew at the same price every year, unless canceled in your iTunes account settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your account settings after purchase.
Terms of use: https://www.sixstarapps.com/terms/ 
Privacy policy: https://www.sixstarapps.com/privacy/ 
HAVE QUESTIONS OR NEED HELP?
If you have any question about the app, or need help about something, please do not hesitate to contact us at www.SixStarApps.com. We’ll be happy to help!

bluejetty:00042945:android.description:
"'World' is a place where you can find your true wish." - Hatsune Miku
The game tells the story of five groups of music-loving teenagers and girls who entered the virtual world born of wishes by mistake, and with the help of virtual singers such as Hatsune Miku, they found the story of their true wishes.
In the game, you will meet "popular virtual singers", get "a refreshing and excellent audio game experience", listen to "rich popular VOCALOID music library", enjoy "audio-visual sensory feast", meet friends in "virtual LIVE", There are more surprises waiting for you to discover.
Join the virtual singers, discover the wishes of boys and girls, and step onto the stage of "The World"!
[Hatsune Miku joins hands with popular virtual singers to arrive! 】
Together with six virtual singers, Hatsune Miku, Kagamine Ren, Kagamine Rin, Patron Ruka, MEIKO, and KAITO, enjoy the stories of two different stages, the real world and the "world"!
[Familiar yet refreshing excellent audio game experience]
Eclectic key width, accurate chart determination, crossed strip notes, restore the classic chart design of game consoles!
The "swipe up" operation is introduced, and the operation may be synchronized with the character's performance action!
There are 5 difficulty levels from "EASY" to "MASTER" to choose freely. Whether you are a novice in audio games who like Hatsune Miku, or an audio game expert who wants to challenge your limits, you will definitely be able to gain a lot.
Using the AUTO LIVE function, you can automatically pass the LIVE, freeing your hands to collect rewards with one click.
Together in LIVE mode, perform LIVE with other players on the same stage! After completing the FEVER/SUPER FEVER time, there will be additional rewards for dropped items!
【Popular VOCALOID Music Library】
VOCALOID hall songs, as well as new original songs released in cooperation with VOCALOID Producer.
Hatsune Miku's Disappearance (Lyricist: cosMo (Rampage P) Composer: cosMo (Rampage P))
Inferior over Superior (Lyricist: Reol Composer: Giga)
Tell Your World (Lyricist: kz (livetune) Composer: kz (livetune))
ヒバナ -Reloaded- (Lyricist: DECO*27 Composer: DECO*27 )
恨やむと书いててらイ (Lyricist: まふまふ(mafumafu) Composer: まふまふ(mafumafu))
セカイ (Lyricist: Akita Horie (kemu) Composer: DECO*27)
ワーワーワールド (Lyricist: Mitchie M Composer: Giga & Mitchie M)
Self-injury without color
ロキ (Lyricist: みきとP Composer: みきとP)
【Common Witness, Virtual LIVE】
Watch virtual LIVE with other players! You can also join private rooms with your friends!
Valentine's Day/Halloween/New Year's Eve LIVE, carnival parties on important days; Hatsune Miku and everyone's blessings, I have received them well!
Don't be bored during the waiting period, use expressions and actions to interact, and meet enthusiastic friends with the same interests.
Tap the screen to wave the support stick, slide or tilt the screen to move the angle of view freely, use your favorite way to cheer!
Think the clothes don't stand out enough? It doesn't matter! Change my look, today I am the most in supporter!
[Audio-visual integration, sensory feast]
The music notes on the music sheet directly present the lyrics and patterns, adding extra fun and surprises during the performance.
3D LIVE performance synchronized with the music sheet, feel the passion and dreams of the characters in 360 degrees!
Watch the well-choreographed 3D MV dance video, freely choose your favorite members to play.
【Immersive, personally feel】
Childhood friends who are drifting away, unlucky girls who failed in the selection, shy girls with musical dreams, stage actors who are not taken seriously, and members of online music clubs who have never met. The stories behind five groups of boys and girls who love music are waiting for you to discover.
Recruit characters, organize them freely, cultivate them carefully, and increase the character's level limit and overall strength!
You can enjoy the plot dialogue scenes presented by LIVE 2D technology, and you can also unlock new costumes to dress up the characters.
7 real-world scenes and 5 "world" scenes, while exploring the relationship between characters, you can also unlock extra rewards!
※The content of this game involves sex (the game characters wear clothing or dresses with prominent sexual characteristics but does not involve sexual hints). According to the game software classification management method, it is classified as a 12-year-old tutoring class, and only people over 12 years old can use it.
※This game is a free game, but the game also provides paid services such as purchasing virtual game coins and items. Please make moderate consumption according to your personal interests and abilities.
※Please pay attention to the game time and avoid addiction. Playing games for a long time will easily affect your work and rest. It is advisable to rest and exercise moderately.

bluejetty:00164547:ios.description:
Rozum — Learn a New Language Faster with Spaced Repetition and an AI Tutor.
Create a personal learning plan, learn essential vocabulary, and practice speaking with Linoo, your AI Tutor.
Rozum helps you build a strong vocabulary foundation in multiple languages — starting from the most important everyday words. Whether you’re a beginner or want to strengthen your language skills, Rozum focuses on the words you actually need to understand, speak, and communicate with confidence.
With support for 15 languages, Rozum adapts to your level and helps you progress naturally — from basic words to more advanced, real-life usage.
Why choose Rozum?
Rozum brings together three core parts of language learning and combines them into one personalized learning plan — so you always know what to learn and how to practice.
1. Discover new words
2. Learn them with spaced repetition
3. Practice with the AI Tutor
Who is Rozum for?
Rozum is built for anyone who wants to learn a new language or strengthen their foundation:
— Beginners: Start from scratch with the most essential words and build confidence step by step.
— Travelers: Learn practical vocabulary to communicate easily abroad.
— Professionals & Job Seekers: Improve your language skills for work, relocation, and interviews.
— Language Learners & Enthusiasts: Explore new languages and grow your vocabulary every day.

- Explore stylish displays designed for charging moments.

 100% Moroccan app designed for your lifestyle
 Available in major cities: Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Agadir, Tangier, and more
 Instant food delivery, meal delivery, grocery delivery, parcel delivery, and more
 Restaurant meals, fast food, and local favorites delivered to your door

Choose your favorite meals or snacks
Place your order in seconds
Track it live — and enjoy!

 Fresh produce
 Beverages and snacks
 Sweets and treats

 Household essentials

 Parcels
 Documents
 Gifts
 Forgotten items
 Same-day delivery
 Pickup and drop-off scheduling
 GPS tracking and live updates
 Safe, reliable couriers
MORE THAN JUST FOOD DELIVERY
DONE isn’t just a fast food delivery app — it’s your personal delivery assistant.

bluejetty:00061211:ios.description:
Discover timeless biblical wisdom and comforting grace for everyday life.
Daily Wisdom brings together the rich devotional writings of J.C. Philpot into a quiet, contemplative reading experience. Each day provides thoughtful reflections on Scripture, exploring themes of God’s sovereignty, grace, humility, and steadfast faith through life’s seasons.
DEEP BIBLICAL MEDITATIONS
- Read a daily devotional reflection grounded in Scripture
- Meditate on key Bible verses from Old and New Testament passages
- Find pastoral encouragement, spiritual discernment, and comforting truth
- Use the calendar to explore readings from any day of the year
LISTEN, REMEMBER, AND RETURN
- Listen to devotional readings with test-to-speech
- Play gentle background music to foster a peaceful reading atmosphere
- Set daily reminders to maintain a steady devotional rhythm
- Bookmark impactful readings and favorite passages
- Create and share elegant images from verses and quotations
MAKE THE EXPERIENCE YOUR OWN
- Choose from available Bible translations, including BSB, NET, and WEB
- Adjust font styles, text sizing, and layout for comfortable reading
- Read easily in dark mode during morning or evening quiet time
- Personalize your theme with app-inspired colors: Wisdom Gold, Proverbs Amber, and Hearth Bronze
- Rearrange the Today view to highlight the content you use most
Whether in times of joy, seasons of trial, or ordinary daily routines, Daily Wisdom provides a steady source of spiritual nourishment and godly insight.
Open your heart to timeless wisdom and grace each day.

bluejetty:00080755:ios.description:
Travel back to olden times and become Director of your own city!
Attract new residents and try to become the greatest city in the land! Add buildings like restaurants and teahouses to make your town a place where samurai and commoners alike will want to live.
This is the past, so don't forget to add some touches of traditional culture! Features like temples and gaming halls can give your city a lot of personality, especially when arranged in harmony with the surrounding environment. You might end up attracting tourists to the town, who will move in if they like it enough.
It's not all fun and games in the mists of history. Sometimes ghost, demons, and other baddies will come to attack your city. You'll have to summon your own Guardian Spirits to banish the evil ones and keep your townsfolk safe. Consider your spirits' abilities and placement for the best effects - strategy is the key word!
With a whole host of land expansion options, facilities, and residents to collect and customize, it's never been easier to create a city that will go down in history.
Start building your ancient city today!
--
Supports drag to scroll and pinch to zoom.
Search for "Kairosoft" to see all of our games, or visit us at http://kairopark.jp
Be sure to check out both our free-to-play and paid games!
Kairosoft's pixel art game series continues!
Follow us on X (Twitter) for the latest Kairosoft news and information.
https://twitter.com/kairokun2010

bluejetty:00172608:ios.description:
How much will that road trip really cost? Fuel Calculator gives you the answer in seconds. This fast, lightweight tool estimates your travel cost, calculates fuel consumption and economy, and works out exactly how much fuel you'll need — wherever you are in the world and whatever units you use.
Whether you drive a car, motorcycle, truck or van, Fuel Calculator helps you understand your vehicle's efficiency, compare fill-ups and plan smarter, cheaper journeys. Switch effortlessly between metric, imperial and US units to match your region.
WHAT YOU CAN CALCULATE
• Trip fuel cost — estimate what your journey will cost before you set off.
• Fuel consumption — see how much fuel your trip or vehicle uses.
• Fuel economy & efficiency — measure how far you go per liter or gallon.
• Fuel needed — work out how much to put in for the distance ahead.
• Road trip distance — factor distance into every calculation.
SUPPORTED UNITS
• Efficiency: l/100km, l/10km, l/km, l/mi, mpg (US), mpg (UK), mpl, km/l, km/US gal, km/imp gal, US gal/100mi, imp gal/100mi.
• Distance: kilometers (km) and miles (mi).
• Volume: liters (l), US gallons and imperial gallons.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE FUEL CALCULATOR
• Truly global — imperial, metric and US customary units all supported.
• Many efficiency formats — from l/100km to miles per gallon and beyond.
• Adjustable decimals — control the precision of every result.
• Helpful content — useful information about cars, motorcycles, trucks and more.
• Lightweight & fast — quick answers with zero clutter.
• Works offline — no internet connection required.
• Light & dark themes — a clean, minimalist design.
• 70+ languages — built for drivers worldwide.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose what you want to calculate — cost, consumption or efficiency.
2. Enter your distance, fuel price and vehicle figures.
3. Get an instant, accurate result in your preferred units.
PERFECT FOR
• Planning road trips and budgeting fuel costs.
• Comparing the real economy of different vehicles.
• Drivers, commuters, couriers and fleet owners.
• Anyone who wants to spend less at the pump.
Fuel is one of the biggest costs of driving, and small savings add up fast. By understanding your true consumption and planning trips with real numbers, Fuel Calculator helps you drive more efficiently, budget with confidence and keep more money in your pocket.
WHY EVERY DRIVER NEEDS FUEL CALCULATOR
Fuel prices change, routes vary, and every vehicle sips or guzzles differently. Guessing leaves you over- or under-budget and in the dark about your real efficiency. With accurate, unit-flexible calculations you can compare cars before you buy, decide whether to drive or fly, split costs fairly on a shared trip, and spot when your vehicle suddenly starts using more than it should.
MADE FOR EVERY ROAD AND REGION
From liters per 100 km in Europe to miles per gallon in the US and UK, Fuel Calculator speaks your local language of distance and volume. Mix and match units freely, set the number of decimals you need, and get results you can trust whether you're planning a daily commute, a cross-country haul or a weekend getaway.
Fuel calculator and gas mileage tool: estimate trip fuel cost, calculate consumption, economy and efficiency in l/100km, MPG or km/l, convert between liters and gallons, and plan cheaper journeys for any car, motorcycle or truck.
Download Fuel Calculator today and take control of every mile and every dollar.
Privacy Policy: https://www.shpavda.com/products/fuel-calculator/privacy/
Terms & Conditions: https://www.shpavda.com/products/fuel-calculator/terms/ios/

bluejetty:00125532:ios.description:
Of je nu wilt verrassen of alleen even wilt laten weten dat je aan iemand denkt: er gaat niets boven een échte kaart. Download daarom de gratis Greetz-app! Daarmee maak en verstuur je in een handomdraai de leukste kaarten en cadeaus. Voor de jarige job, kersverse mama of die lieve vriendin die wel een steuntje in de rug kan gebruiken. Greetz is er voor ieder moment, voor jou.
Voordelen van de app:
· Snel een kaart of cadeau versturen? Via de app heb je het zo geregeld. Het is zo eenvoudig als kiezen, schrijven, en sturen. Allemaal on-the-go!
· Tussen onze duizenden wenskaarten vind je altijd de perfecte kaart voor íeder moment. Van de leukste verjaardagskaarten tot lieve beterschapskaarten en nog veel meer: in onze app vind je altijd een passende wenskaart.
· Zoveel vrienden en familie, zoveel belangrijke data om te onthouden! Gelukkig houdt onze Greetz-kalender het allemaal voor je bij. Die werkt net zoals je vertrouwde WC-verjaardagskalender, maar dan mét handige reminders. Zet jouw belangrijke momenten erin en ontvang voortaan bij iedere verjaardag, elk huwelijksjubileum en andere grote momenten een herinnering. Handig!
· Bezorg iemand een nog grotere glimlach en verstuur een kaart met cadeau! In ons assortiment kies je uit honderden cadeaus, van bonbons en beautypakketten tot ballonnen en verjaardagstaarten.
· Met een fotokaart maak je het nóg persoonlijker! Maak bijvoorbeeld een verjaardagskaart met een collage van jullie leukste foto’s samen, neem een trip down memory lane met mooie kinderfoto’s, of zet jullie gekste selfie samen aan de voorkant of juist aan de binnenkant van je kaart. Bij Greetz vind je fotokaarten in diverse maten voor ieder moment. En met hetzelfde gemak maak je een persoonlijk fotocadeau zoals een mok, doos bonbons of een ballon!
· Zelf creatief aan de slag? Maak dan je eigen kaart of uitnodiging! Personaliseer een van onze vele wenskaarten en fotokaarten of upload je eigen ontwerp. bluejetty:00087927:ios.description:
Speak their language. Change your life. Learn languages with an AI tutor that speaks back. Practice Spanish, Korean, Japanese, French, Chinese, Mandarin, Tagalog, Russian, and English with real AI conversations.
Victor AI is built by two real polyglots who've mastered 10+ languages combined. Whether you want to connect deeper with someone you love or unlock what the world really has to offer, fluency is the key that opens every door.
HOW TO USE VICTOR AI*
---
REAL-LIFE DIALOGUES, NOT TEXTBOOK PHRASES
3,500+ dialogues built around situations that actually happen. First dates. Job interviews. Negotiating rent. Apologizing to a neighbor. From day one to full fluency across 33 languages.
60-DAY SPEAKING CHALLENGE
Daily speaking practice with AI feedback. No judgment. Track your streak. Build the habit that makes fluency stick.
AI TEACHER THAT ACTUALLY LISTENS
Speak naturally. Get corrected gently. The AI responds in real-time and keeps the conversation flowing so you build real confidence.
43,000+ WORDS. NATIVE AUDIO. YOUR LANGUAGE
Every word has native audio, example sentences, and verb conjugations. Tap to hear it. Long-press to save it. Drill it until it sticks.
LANGUAGES: Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, German, Russian, English, and Tagalog.
*All lessons, dialogues, and vocabulary tools require a subscription.
Built by polyglots. Used by learners in 60+ countries. Your turn.
---

Victor AI is a premium app that offers auto-renewing subscriptions. Subscribe to gain access to video courses, vocab builder tools, language tutor tools, time tracking, analytics widgets, and more. And 33 language course with a total of 3,200 Structures lessons, 1,600 Review sheets, and 43,000+ Vocab words.
Victor AI uses OpenAI and Google Cloud AI to power language coaching features like speech recognition and conversation practice. These providers act solely as data processors on our behalf and do not use your data to train their models.

- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
- You may cancel or manage your subscription from your Apple account settings. By continuing, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use found at:

bluejetty:00144361:ios.description:
تُعد لوحة مفاتيح تمام الحل الذكي والمتكامل للمستخدم العربي، حيث تدمج بين دقة الكتابة وسرعة التواصل في تصميم عصري واحد. يوفر التطبيق تجربة كتابة متطورة تعتمد على تقنيات التنبؤ الذكي، مما يضمن سلاسة فائقة في المراسلة اليومية، يتميز التطبيق بتصميم عصري بمكتبة إبداعية ضخمة تشمل خلفيات متنوعة ومئات الملصقات التعبيرية والخطوط المزخرفة، بالإضافة إلى حزمة حصرية من الصور المتحركة (GIFs) المستوحاة من الثقافة ومشاهير العالم العربي. 
 لماذا "تمام"؟
لأنها تجمع بين المحتوى الغني من ملصقات وإيموجي، وبين الكفاءة التقنية التي تسهل التواصل مع الآخرين بأسلوب راقٍ ومنظم.

اشتراك سنوي (1 سنة): استمتع باشتراك سنة كاملة مقابل 9.99$ USD فقط مع تجربة شاملة، تجديد تلقائي وحرية الإلغاء في أي وقت.

bluejetty:00172448:ios.description:
CycleFinder is now PBSC!
Your City Your App!
PBSC app is for all the urbanites around the world who make bike sharing part of the pulse of healthy city life. Our friendly app has all the features you need to locate a station, quickly rent a bike, and enjoy happy journeys.
Download today to join users worldwide and discover the joy of bike-sharing!
PBSC app allows you to:
 • Find the nearest available bike or dock based on your geolocation.
 • Mark stations as your favorites to easily see their availability.
 • Create a new bike share account directly in the app or login to an existing account (for systems that allows it) to be able to:
 ○ Rent bikes directly from the app in just a few seconds
 ○ Request extra time at full stations to be able to dock your bike at a nearby station
 ○ See details of current trip and trip history

bluejetty:00014041:ios.description:
This is the AdelFi Mobile—Original AdelFi Member version for Members Prior to 2026. 
AdelFi's Mobile Banking App allows you to easily and securely manage your accounts anytime, anywhere. With just a few taps, you can deposit checks, transfer funds, and access financial wellness tools to track your credit score, income, and expenses. Our state-of-the-art encryption methods and two-factor authentication ensure your information is always safe and secure. 
•Transfers: Move money between accounts. 
•Bill Payments: Set up and manage payees, schedule payments, and track due dates. 
•Check Deposits: Deposit checks directly into accounts. 
•Wire Transfers: Initiate and manage wire transfers. 
•Loan Payments: Make a payment from your AdelFi account or a linked external account. 
•Debit Card Management: Block/unblock, request a replacement, set up alerts, and place travel notes all online. 
•Live Account Activity: Monitor real-time account balances and transactions. 
•Transaction History: Access and search through posted transactions. 
•Security and Activity Alerts: Customize notifications for changes, transactions, and account activities. 
•Business Accounts: View transactions, make transfers, mobile deposits, send a wire to an existing payee, view statements, manage alerts, access bill pay. 
•ATM Locator: Find nearby ATMs and Shared Branch Locations. 
•Customer Support: Contact customer support directly through the app. 
To sign in to mobile banking, use your AdelFi username and password. If you are not a member, apply now at www.adelfibanking.com. 
If you need any help with our app, contact us by calling 800-634-3228. 
Push, email, and SMS alerts and notifications must be enabled to be received. Message and data rates may apply.

bluejetty:00171470:ios.description:
Summary
Alice as a child, she heard stories about adventures in Wonderland. Yet, she journeyed through time to a Fairyland she dreamed of. As Alice navigated Wonderland, she encountered residents and resolved their issues. Over time, Alice has come to know the truth about Wonderland's destruction.
What will she do when she encounters bizarre situations and new challenges?
Features
A vast worldview
The scenery ranges from fresh fields and mysterious woods to a royal palace. During Alice's adventures, players will see classic scenes from Alice's Adventures in Wonderland.
Delicate scenes
Speaking plants, giant mushrooms like wise men... The classic scenes have been redesigned and presented to the players in a brand-new way.
Merge and scene repair
Each item player merged can be used to repair scenes with the storyline of Wonderland's destruction and rebuilding. By merging items to a higher level, players gradually restore Wonderland to its former glory.
Order System and Magic Cuisine
The residents will provide Alice with magic cuisines as a thank-you gift for rebuilding their home. Besides being delicious, the cuisine has magical effects. According to original stories, Alice shrank to her original calf size after drinking liquid marked "DRINK ME.". A bite of bread could also cause her to grow as large as Mr. White Rabbit's house. Other effects require you to explore!
Download and explore the world of Merging and Fairy Tales now! This is the best merge game! Let's play wih your friends. Friends are waiting for you to match,morph,and merge!

bluejetty:00040846:ios.name: Cadence: Bike & Run Tracker
bluejetty:00040846:ios.summary: Why spend $300+ on a dedicated Garmin, Wahoo, or Hammerhead device when Cadence brings those features to your iPhone and Apple Watch? Record workouts, follow routes, view live metrics, and analyze every effort with detailed stats and charts
bluejetty:00040846:ios.description:
Why spend $300+ on a dedicated Garmin, Wahoo, or Hammerhead device when Cadence brings those features to your iPhone and Apple Watch? Record workouts, follow routes, view live metrics, and analyze every effort with detailed stats and charts.
“In a sea of fitness apps, Cadence stands out.” - Outside Magazine
“Absolutely blown away – replacing my Garmin.” - App Store Review
“I’ve never had a better support experience for a service or product in my life.” - App Store Review
TRACK OUTDOORS & INDOORS
Effortlessly track both your outdoor and indoor workouts using GPS, Apple Watch, and Bluetooth sensors.
Build unlimited, fully customizable data screens with up to 24 metrics each, and swipe through as many as you like.
Choose from 250+ metrics, including charts, elevation profiles, maps, and more, so your most important data is always in view.
CONNECT YOUR BLUETOOTH SENSORS
Use the devices you already own, including heart rate monitors, power meters, speed and cadence sensors, bike trainers, Shimano Di2, tire pressure sensors, ActiveLook AR glasses, and more.
ROUTES & NAVIGATION
Never get lost with custom routes and turn-by-turn voice navigation.
Import GPX routes from Strava, Komoot, Ride with GPS, and other sources, or create your own directly in the app.
Stay on course and keep recording whether your phone is mounted on your handlebars or tucked away in your pocket.
APPLE WATCH SUPPORT
Leave your phone behind and use Cadence on Apple Watch for standalone running and cycling activities with fully customizable screens.
You can also use your Apple Watch as a heart rate monitor while connected to your iPhone.
ANALYZE EVERY EFFORT
Review every workout with detailed statistics, colorful charts, lap and mile splits, heart rate and power zones, and more.
Your activity history stays on your device by default for privacy and control. Share to services like Strava, Intervals.icu, Apple Health, and Garmin Connect only when you choose.
----------
Unlock advanced features without spending $300+ on another device:
BIKE RADAR SUPPORT
Ride with added awareness using supported bike radars including Garmin Varia, Cycplus, Giant, Magene, Magicshine, and others.
Get visual and audio alerts plus advanced radar metrics like car speed and time to pass, giving you more time to react.
TRAINING PLANS & STRUCTURED WORKOUTS
Follow structured workouts with a focused, customizable workout interface built for interval training.
Choose from 400+ workouts or build your own with the detailed workout editor.
ESTIMATED POWER
No power meter? No problem. Cadence estimates your cycling power on outdoor rides from your speed, weight, the grade, your riding position, the road surface, and the wind. See live power, zones, and charts without buying a power meter, and add estimated power to rides you’ve already recorded.
STRAVA LIVE SEGMENTS
Compete against your best and most recent Strava efforts with a detailed, customizable live segment experience. View nearby segments and switch between them during your workout.
OFFLINE MAPS
Download maps for reliable navigation and tracking even in remote areas without cell service.
LIVE TRACKING
Share your live location, route, and workout stats with friends and family using a private link. Built with privacy in mind, you stay in control of what gets shared and when.
----------
There’s much more to explore, from advanced training tools to deep sensor support. Visit getcadence.app to learn more.
FREE TO USE
Cadence is free to use with some feature limitations.
UNLOCK MORE WITH PRO OR ELITE
Upgrade to Pro or Elite for advanced features. See plan details in the app. Yearly plans include a 7-day free trial.
Subscriptions are managed through your App Store account.
Privacy Policy: getcadence.app/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: getcadence.app/terms-and-conditions

Welcome to Standards of Care, the veterinary clinical decision support tool from the team behind Plumb’s and Clinician’s Brief, with Plumb’s built in. 
Subscribed to Plumb’s?
If you’re subscribed to the veterinary drug reference, Plumb’s, you can access all your prescribing information and tools in this app. 
Included in Plumb’s:
- Comprehensive, continually updated veterinary drug and dosing information
- Veterinary drug interaction checker with animal-specific guidance
- A conversion calculator for quick math in the app
- Notes feature for saving favorite notes and protocols
- Convenient favorites feature for making your own quick reference list
Visit plumbs.com to learn more.
Subscribed to Standards™?
If you’re subscribed to Standards of Care™, you can access all your Standards features (including Plumb’s) in this app. 
Included in Standards:
- All the features of Plumb’s (see above)
- Practical, peer-reviewed diagnosis and treatment monographs
- An extensive library of diagnosis and management algorithms for step-by-step support
- Peer-reviewed differential diagnosis lists
- Shareable clinical handouts to support client education
Visit standards.vet to learn more.
DISCLAIMER 
Standards of Care and Plumb’s are online clinical resources to be used only for information purposes at the discretion of trained veterinary medical and pharmaceutical professionals to support diagnosis and treatment of small animal veterinary conditions. Learn more at standards.vet or plumbs.com.
APP SUPPORT
If you have feature requests or suggestions or simply need help, please visit help.plumbs.com and click on the chat icon to submit a request. Our responsive support team will be in touch with you.
Privacy policy: https://plumbs.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00015118:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00015118:ios.description:
Your mind changes every day. Some days feel clear. Others feel harder to navigate.
CogniFit brings a new daily approach to brain health, helping you understand how your mind performs, adapts, and evolves over time. Built on more than 20 years of published research, CogniFit combines cognitive assessment, adaptive training, and daily guidance into a single system designed to support mental clarity, focus, and long-term cognitive wellbeing.
‣ Your Brain Age
At the center of the experience is your Brain Age: a simple way to understand how your mind is performing today, and how it changes over time. Monitor your daily and weekly cognitive scores, set goals, and build a personalized training plan around your own rhythm.
‣ Five Abilities, One Evolving Picture
Memory, focus, coordination, reasoning, and perception are measured over time to reveal patterns in how your mind performs day to day, alongside up to 22 other cognitive abilities, including processing speed and reaction time.
‣ Built Around You
Training sessions adjust gradually, adapting difficulty, pace, and cognitive focus based on how you perform. The more you use CogniFit, the more the experience adapts to you.
‣ Guidance Throughout the Day
Gentle reminders, reflections, and quick check-ins help support consistency throughout the day, especially during moments when focus or energy feels lower.
‣ Grounded in Cognitive Science
Developed by neuroscience experts, CogniFit's patented Individualized Training System (ITS) is used by the scientific community, universities, hospitals, families, and medical centers around the world.
‣ The Benefits
 • Track your cognitive score (0-100) daily and weekly
 • Personalized training sessions based on the areas you want to focus on
 • A custom weekly plan, built around your routine
 • Scores across cognitive domains, including reasoning, coordination, memory, perception, and attention
 • Compare your Brain Age to your actual age
 • Guided mindfulness techniques to support your mental wellbeing
 • More than 100 interactive games, including Penguin Explorer, Mahjong, and Reaction Field
 • Video Coaches to guide you through every step
 • Brain games and brain teasers for adults and children alike
‣ Designed for Everyday Life
A complete redesign brings a calmer, more intuitive experience that fits naturally into your routine. Short sessions, clearer feedback, and a more focused interface make daily cognitive care simple, approachable, and sustainable.
Small moments, repeated daily, that's how real change happens. Are you ready to understand your brain a little better, every day?
Pricing and Conditions
CogniFit offers monthly ($9.99/mo) and annual ($59.99/yr) subscription packages. All amounts are in USD. All subscriptions are processed through the user’s app store account. Currency conversions for user’s outside of the US may apply. All subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. For complete details, please review: https://www.cognifit.com/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00031460:ios.description:
Are you overwhelmed with all of the fitness & nutrition noise out there? Are you tired of feeling confused about which diet and exercise regimen is best for you? Then, welcome! You’re in the right place. Amy, a certified personal trainer with a M.A. in exercise science, and Vivian, a registered dietitian nutritionist, are ready to help you embark on your wellness journey. Our experts have extensive and accredited training, so you only get the most proven and evidence-based approaches to fitness & nutrition. 
BodyFit by Amy reimagines the gym as an international online community that provides expertise, encouragement, and accountability in your fitness & nutrition journey. What makes us special is that we are a community of real people with real lives who love joyful movement and all foods. Our goal is to be the last fitness journey you embark on. We are in the business of positive fitness, nourishment over numbers, nutrition by addition, and simple strategies to improve your health without sacrificing your sanity. We’re helping people learn to love their bodies, heal their relationship with food, and shift their overall mindset towards sustainable and realistic health habits that last a lifetime. 
Join the BodyFit Athletic Club and receive unlimited access to workouts, monthly fitness challenges, access to experts, nutrition guidance, a supportive community, and so much more. 
Workouts 
Access to hundreds of on-demand workouts. 
New workouts every week.
A variety of formats.
Effective, positive, fun, and adaptable for ALL fitness levels.
Live Streaming
Get direct access to Amy & Vivian with weekly livestreams. 
We answer questions about your fitness & nutrition journey and cover hot topics.
We host occasional happy hours, group video calls, and LIVE Q&As!
Challenges & Programs
Access to the current monthly challenge.
Other programs (including pre/postnatal) are always available. 
Includes monthly nutrition challenges to step up your eating game! 
Nutrition Materials
Full access to The Method by BodyFit by Amy (our comprehensive nutrition guide) and weekly dietitian-approved recipes and meal ideas that are delicious, easy, and calorie-controlled.
Easy-to-digest videos teach you how to eat healthy and shop for food like a dietitian.
Mindset
We help you conquer all-or-nothing thinking, self-sabotage, food labeling, and overgeneralizing so that you can stop dieting forever. You deserve to be free of food and fitness drama, and we are ready to help you conquer this! 
Community 
We are a safe & supportive community with fitness and nutrition experts ready to help you reach your goals in a positive, sustainable, and compassionate way. 
---
BodyFit by Amy includes a Fitness Tracker for Apple Watch: ▷Monitor Stats during Workouts: View heart rate/calories burned on your watch & video player. ▷HEALTH App: Apple Watch integrates with Apple's Health app (Healthkit) to track workouts, duration, calories burned, heart rate, and active energy. You choose the data you want stored, and you can change it anytime in the Health app. ▷FITNESS App: Apple Watch integrates with Apple's Fitness App, and workouts contribute to your daily goals. View stats and share your activity. ▷Use your Watch as a Remote: Play, stop, & rewind videos without interrupting workouts
▷ Already a Member? Sign-In to access your subscription.
▷ New? Subscribe in the app to get instant access.
BodyFit by Amy offers auto-renewing subscriptions.
You'll receive unlimited access to content on all your devices. Payment is charged to your account at confirmation of purchase. Pricing varies by location and is confirmed prior to purchase. Subscription automatically renews each month unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period, or the trial period (when offered). Cancel anytime in Account Settings. 
For more information see our: 
-Terms of Service: https://bodyfitbyamy.com/tos/
-Privacy Policy: https://bodyfitbyamy.com/privacy-policy/

TPB is your personal financial advocate. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what you can do with TPB:
- Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
- Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
- Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
- Transfer money between your accounts
- View and save your monthly statements
- Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode or biometric on supported devices.

bluejetty:00178181:ios.description:
Mister Battery helps you calculate each charging detail for your device. 
With different chargers and charging cables, your device's charging speed varies greatly. Using the Mister Battery, we can help you find the best charging device combination!
Mister Battery provides the following features:
1. Measure the maximum watts of the current charging system, the number of milliamps per minute charged.
2. Record the duration and effect of each charge to help you compare the results.
3. Calculate the speed of each charge you got.
4. Check if your device supports PD(Power Delivery)
. 
Find your best charging device and let your battery charge up!

bluejetty:00183850:ios.description:
MoneyCoach is a budget planner, money tracker and financial planner helping millions of people with their spending habits and finances. MoneyCoach creates healthy financial habits that reduce your financial stress, increase your financial knowledge, and develop your financial skills.
Want it all? Get MoneyCoach Premium and unlock the full power of financial mindfulness from the beginning, including Individual Smart Budgets which will save you potentially up to $2.000 every year.
APP FEATURES:
√ Family Sync - Share your data with your wife, husband. partner or any other user using different Apple IDs
√ Personalised Budgets - Smart budgets that will help you save money every month, personalized to your needs
√ Smart Goals - Individual goals to work towards and develop your financial habits
√ Real-time Net Worth - Track much money you have in total, in real-time, and the progression since you started using the MoneyCoach
√ Credit Card Tracking - Manually add and manage your credit cards, set up reminders to pay them and more
√ Widgets - Glance at your budgets & goals directly in the Home Screen
√ Intuitive Reports - Track your progress and measure your financial improvements
√ iPadOS Enhanced - iPad-specific enhancements make for a truly unique experience
√ Mac Version - Sync your data via iCloud and use MoneyCoach on your Mac
√ Apple Watch App - Your financial mindfulness is one glance away
√ CSV Import - Import your data from any previous app or bank via CSV and start your journey towards money & happiness
√ Data Sync - Sync your finances on your iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch
√ Savings Accounts - Setup savings accounts and reduce your financial stress
√ Siri Conversational Shortcuts - Ask Siri to add transactions quickly or about your financials
√ Live & Custom Exchange Rates - Perfect for multi-currency accounts and people who travel a lot
√ Ludicrous Speed - Just 2 seconds to enter a new transaction... that's Tesla fast
√ Dark Mode - MoneyCoach looks stunning with true black background
√ Context Menus - Get quick access to different actions via the context menus
√ TouchID & FaceID - Safe, private, and secure
√ Optimized for the latest iOS, iPadOS, macOS and watchOS devices
√ And so much more…
Financial mindfulness apps can be scary and you probably won't understand how helpful they can be immediately after you open them. 
MoneyCoach is here to do just that, help you create healthy financial habits, reduce your financial stress, and increase your financial knowledge.
Download MoneyCoach today, and create healthy financial habits.

Breadfast is a supermarket in your pocket — fresh groceries and daily essentials delivered to your door in minutes, or scheduled for whenever suits you.
From dairy, eggs, fresh bread, fruits and vegetables, to household supplies and specialty coffee, everything you need is available 24/7 and one click away. - Restaurants — order from a wide range of restaurants near you

Plus more from the Breadfast ecosystem: Chef on-Demand for fresh homemade meals, Journeys by Breadfast for travel, and the Breadfast Card to manage your spending with rewards on everyday purchases.
Breadfast delivers across Greater Cairo (Cairo and Giza), Alexandria, and Mansoura, and is expanding across Egypt and the MENA region.

Summon HEROES from the Chinese THREE KINGDOMS era, lead them on the battlefield to match and blast a way out through the chaotic time of Han Dynasty - Join us now to start the thrilling adventure of RPG Match-3 battle, building a magnificent island!
◆Match Pawns
Simply swipe, match and blast the Pawns to generate fantastic attacks!
◆Summon Heroes
More than 70 famous warriors, strategists and generals from the Three Kingdoms are waiting to follow your command!
◆Special Skills
Each Hero has special skills that give different advantages on the battlefield!
◆ Battle Adventure
Go on the expedition map to explore nearly 200 battle sections!
◆Build Stronghold
Be the master of the Wavy Island and build your stronghold there!
◆Craft Items
Gather materials and craft various battle items!

Make good use of the five elements Fire/Water/Wood/Yin/Yang and their restraint relationship to dominant your enemies!
Three Kingdoms & Puzzles is a Match&Battle RPG game that sets its story in the time of Three Kingdoms. Come now to collect historic heroes, develop your island, have expedition battles and thrive in the chaotic Han Dynasty!
Please note:
1. The game is free to play, but some of the items in the game can be purchased with real money.
2. The game requires a network connection.

With Universal+, your phone becomes the ultimate remote control, enhancing how you watch TV and interact with media.

bluejetty:00084192:ios.name: Probably Smut
bluejetty:00084192:ios.summary: Welcome to Probably Smut, a smutty romance book club community like no other, where book lovers unite to connect, discuss, and indulge in their passion for all things smut. This is a highly inclusive community that believes in reading whate
bluejetty:00084192:ios.description:
Welcome to Probably Smut, a smutty romance book club community like no other, where book lovers unite to connect, discuss, and indulge in their passion for all things smut. This is a highly inclusive community that believes in reading whatever you want–whether you're obsessed with stalker MMCs, swooning over shadow daddies, or just looking for a 10/10 love story, Probably Smut is the community for you!
Join us for a unique experience that goes beyond just reading. Engage in author chats, make friends with fellow readers in bookish and non-bookish chat rooms, earn engagement points and climb the leaderboard by posting and commenting, and dive into forums where you can post content, share recommendations, and explore all things bookish.
Chat Rooms
At Probably Smut, we know that life is about more than just books! That’s why our app features bookish and non-bookish chat rooms where you can engage with friends and fellow members about all kinds of topics. Whether you're discussing the latest Probably Smut book of the month pick, debating the best fictional couple, or chatting about TV shows, movies, hobbies, and personal interests, there’s a room for every kind of conversation. Fan art, ARC sign-ups, audiobooks, advice & venting, and currently reading are just some of the different spaces you can engage in.
Author Chats
Join us for a live stream with our featured authors where you can get to know them and learn more about their books. Readers can submit questions, engage in the discussion and partake in our group pictures!
Friends & Community Building
Probably Smut is all about building meaningful connections within the bookish community. Whether you’re swapping recommendations, planning local meet-ups, or just looking for someone to chat with, you’ll always have a group of friends by your side. 
Personalize Your Experience
At Probably Smut, we believe that everyone’s smut journey is unique, and you are able to customize the app to get exactly what you’re looking for out of the community. This means you can join or leave any room, turn on the notifications you want, and personalize your feed to show you only the content you want to see.

bluejetty:00114651:android.summary:

Are you ready for new challenges and endless levels? The second installment of the series continues the story of the nameless stickman who has found himself in a wo
bluejetty:00114651:android.description:
Explosions, robots, and hardcore gameplay return in "Deadroom 2: Rebirth"!
Are you ready for new challenges and endless levels? The second installment of the series continues the story of the nameless stickman who has found himself in a world full of traps and deadly robots. The game works offline, so you can immerse yourself in this adrenaline-filled world anytime, anywhere!
Deadroom 2: Rebirth is the sequel to the hardcore platformer where you have to not only avoid traps but also fight killer robots. The game combines elements of arcade, platformer, and strategy, adding new ways to interact with the environment. Now our stickman can use mines, containers, and other objects to destroy enemies and clear his path.
What's New in Deadroom 2:
50 Unique Levels
The game includes 50 original levels, each a real maze filled with dangers. You'll need to be agile to avoid traps and enemies, and clever to find secret passages and open hidden chests.
Level Generator
Levels will never end! With the level generator, you have access to an infinite number of challenges. Each new level is a unique maze full of robots and traps. Become a master of completion and prove that you can survive in the most difficult conditions.
Stickman Now Fights Back
Unlike in the first part, now the stickman can stand up for himself! Grab everything you find—mines, containers, bombs—and use them to destroy robots. You can even make enemies destroy each other if you direct their attacks correctly.
Deadly Killer Robots
Robots are your main enemies in Deadroom 2. Flying drones, homing missiles, lasers, and explosive devices will attack you at every turn. Their cunning attacks and maneuvers will not leave you alone. Use your agility and wits to outsmart them and find their weak spots.
Arcade Gameplay
Real arcade adventures where every second counts. Jump, dodge, slide along walls, and attack to overcome deadly traps and defeat robots. This game is not for the faint-hearted!
Complete Freedom to Play Without Internet
"Deadroom 2: Rebirth" works entirely offline! Now you can play anytime and anywhere—on the road, during a break, or even on an airplane. The small game size makes it ideal for installation on any device.
Key Features:
Endless Levels and Complex Mazes
Each new level is an unpredictable maze filled with deadly traps and robots. Use your skills and strategy to survive in this world.
Connection to the First Part
If you enjoyed the first part, Deadroom 2 will give you even more hardcore gameplay. The second installment adds new mechanics, such as fighting robots, but retains the spirit of the original.
Escape from Deadly Traps
Your goal is to find the exit from each maze, avoiding robots and destroying them with found items. It's a real escape from a deadly world.
Stickman Customization
Collect currency and unlock cool skins for the stickman. Create a unique style for your hero and stand out among other players.
Why "Deadroom 2: Rebirth" Is Your Ideal Choice:
Love Hardcore Games?
Deadroom 2 is created for those who love tough challenges and aren't afraid of difficulties. Every mistake can cost you your life, but only the most persistent will make it to the end.
Did You Like the First Part?
The second part expands and improves the original mechanics, adding new levels, opportunities, and deadly enemies.
Like Arcade Gameplay?
Jumping, dodging, sliding, and attacking—all this makes Deadroom 2 a true arcade where every second counts.
Want to Play Without Internet?
Deadroom 2 is the ideal game for those who love engaging platformers but don't want to depend on an internet connection. Play whenever and wherever you want.
The stickman needs your help again. Are you ready to go through all the deadly traps and robots? Install "Deadroom 2: Rebirth" and take on the challenge right now!

bluejetty:00065784:ios.description:
Your bag is packed and you’re ready to go, but as fate has it, you’re stranded in Rome with only 500 coins in your pocket. What now?
Show the world what you’re made of in Backpacker, a new globetrotting trivia game! 
Save up enough money to continue your travels by going on various missions and applying for odd jobs! 
At the end of each day, either splurge on a hotel or risk sleeping in the streets. 
Discover new cities and maybe even learn a thing or two along the way.
Backpacker Features:
* Test your trivia skills! 
* See the world, one city at a time!
* Complete your memento collection with tokens from each city! 
* Collect job diplomas and earn cash for traveling! 
* Help strangers around the world for secret rewards! 
* Stamp your passport in each city, can you collect them all? 
* Which mini game will become your new favorite?
Conquer the world, become a Backpacker!
Backpacker has been lovingly created, we take fun seriously.
We really value your feedback, go to www.facebook.com/BackpackerGame and say what's on your mind!
More about WeAreQiiwi Interactive at www.qiiwi.com
Backpacker Premium Subscription:
Some items in the app require Backpacker Premium, such as no waiting time when traveling. Backpacker Premium is a weekly auto-renewing subscription at $3.49. 
Backpacker Premium will renew within 24 hours before the subscription period ends, and you will be charged through your iTunes account. You can manage and cancel your subscription in your iTunes Account Settings at any time. If you purchase new Backpacker Premium subscription during a free trial you will forfeit any free trial period remaining from your first purchase.
Our privacy policy and terms of service can be found at http://www.qiiwi.com/user-data

PBDL Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.

Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the PBDL Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a Peoples Bank of Deer Lodge Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.
